1001.name: Goth Annie
1001.description: Her mother is dead. Her father is dead. But Annie remains, seeing beauty in the dark.

1002.name: Red Riding Annie
1002.description: Over the river and through the woods, to grandmother's house Annie went—not once suspecting that Warwick the Wolf was waiting for her. Of course, Warwick didn't know Annie could shoot balls of magic flame or summon a fiery bear, so really this was a larger issue with communication.

1003.name: Annie in Wonderland
1003.description: Down the rabbit hole Annie went, following the White Tibbers she had spied at the riverbank, until she emerged in a world much more curious than the one she had left. “Perhaps I shall stay,” she said to herself—and so she did.

1005.name: Frostfire Annie
1005.description: Annie is a Winterlands prodigy—a child born with both innate magic and a spirit guardian, the first of her kind in many generations. Though still young, she has already become a joyous fixture in the halls of the Poro King.

1007.name: FrankenTibbers Annie
1007.description: He's a towering abomination of science and magic. She's an eight year old with a beehive hairdo, and undiagnosed pyromania. Name a more iconic duo. I'll wait.

1008.name: Panda Annie
1008.description: Annie is a big part of Lunar Revel festivities, using her pyromancy to set off scores of high powered fireworks. Her panda bear Tibbers hauls the rockets for her, mauling anyone who tries to make off with even the smallest sparkler.

1009.name: Sweetheart Annie
1009.description: Sugar, spice, and everything nice: that's what Sweetheart Annie is made of! Tibbers is made of fire-resistant cotton blend and the insatiable hunger of a shadow bear, but he's still good for a hug or two. Probably just one, actually.

1010.name: Hextech Annie
1010.description: A scientific prodigy even among the intellectuals of the Hextech renaissance, Annie's beautiful, living warbears are among the most prized innovations of the era. Her most mysterious creation, Tibbers, is always close at hand—her confidant, friend, and monstrous bodyguard.

1011.name: Super Galaxy Annie
1011.description: The youngest human ever to be named a Super Galaxy cadet, Annie proved her mettle the day she turned her teddy bear into a self-piloting mech. Despite serious concerns over her highly combustible designs and volatile programming, Annie's Mecha-Tibbers went into full production. Desperate times call for destructive measures.

1012.name: Annie-Versary
1012.description: Ten years of epic outplays, last second turnarounds, and brutal throws - and we couldn't have done it without each and every one of you. Annie is ready to usher in the festivities, and Teemo… has been lifting, I see. Happy 10!

1013.name: Lunar Beast Annie

chromas.name: Lunar Beast Annie

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Lunar Beast Annie

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Lunar Beast 2021 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Lunar Beast 2021 event.

1013.description: Everyone was shocked when Annie was chosen as Ox Clan's tech operative. A precocious prodigy, Annie serves as the team's recon strategist, making sure the parade route is clear of civilians.

1022.name: Cafe Cuties Annie

chromas.name: Cafe Cuties Annie

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

1022.description: Daughter of the cafe's owner and an accomplished pastry mage wunderkind, Annie has a sweet tooth to be reckoned with. Though her occasional hangry tantrums send her enchanted gummy bear scouring the cafe for any morsel of food fit for his master, with a full belly Annie is as sweet as sugar!

1031.name: Fright Night Annie

chromas.name: Fright Night Annie

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

1031.description:
Awful Orphan Annie comes home from school each day
A lonely little lady with whom no one will play
Now all her family's fled (or dead or gone away)
She can depend on Mr. Tibbers to make her new friends stay!

1040.name: Winterblessed Annie

chromas.name: Winterblessed Annie

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Winterblessed Annie

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Winterblessed event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Winterblessed event.

1040.description: Senna set off to search for the Aurora, only to encounter the child, Annie, outside her estate. Her most cherished friend was her family's pet bear, who recently died. Annie wished for Polaris to bring him back to life, but Senna refused, and instead presented the bear in toy form. "Loss is a part of life, but his memories will live inside this gift.

1050.name: Battle Princess Annie

chromas.name: Battle Princess Annie

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

1050.description: Annie revealed her magical talents before Telum's royal court, transforming her dear teddy bear into a knight of steel and flame. Though a near-fatal display for many aristocrats, Queen Fiora embraced the child's potential and named her successor. Annie trains to triumph in a future Coronation… and causes a fair amount of mischief for her regal mentor.

2002.name: Glacial Olaf
2002.description: The villagers thought it was an avalanche. Then they saw the axe.

2003.name: Brolaf
2003.description: Bro. You think like, there's another version of me somewhere else not having a cold Graggy? Haha nah me neither.

2004.name: Pentakill Olaf
2004.description: Good drummers have rhythm, huge body counts, and are accursed vikings with an insatiable desire to kill. PENTAKILL's Olaf is a very, very good drummer.

2005.name: Marauder Olaf
2005.description: Marauders are the remnants of a brutal regime known as the Magelords, who conquered more than half the world at the dawn of civilization. Though their empire has long since crumbled, its remaining armies now wage endless wars, seeking death and glory wherever they may find it.

2006.name: Butcher Olaf
2006.description: He's the maestro of meat, the barbarian culinarian, the great northern butcher of the Winter's Claw. He's here for alimentary victory or literal death. Give it up for Olaf!

2015.name: SKT T1 Olaf
2015.description: Honoring Bengi's winning performance as Olaf during the 2016 World Championship. This is Bengi's third World Champion skin, following his wins with SKT at the 2013 and 2015 World Championships.

2016.name: Dragonslayer Olaf

chromas.name: Dragonslayer Olaf

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

2016.description: A savage berserker from the hinterlands, Olaf sought a warrior's death in slaying dragons. One by one, the horrid beasts fell to his axe, and rumors even tell of him consuming the heart of a dragon he beheaded. Truth is, this act has only fanned the fire of his rage, driving him to bring about the end of dragons.

2025.name: Sentinel Olaf

chromas.name: Sentinel Olaf

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Sentinel Olaf

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

2025.description: After a vicious encounter on the Freljordian front, Olaf is convinced to join the Sentinels to satiate his hunger for battle. Only then would he have the power to challenge Viego, the greatest threat the world has ever known, and satisfy his urge to fearlessly face death in glorious combat.

2035.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Olaf

chromas.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Olaf

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

2035.description: All hail, Olaf, the Blastbeat Barbarian, and Chosen of Stentorus! As wild as a tempest, as brutal as an earthquake, he laughs in the faces of his enemies, his pounding drumbeats shaking the very foundations of the world.

2044.name: Infernal Olaf

chromas.name: Infernal Olaf

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Infernal Olaf

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

2044.description: As self-destructive as he is deadly, Infernal Olaf fervidly embraced the Infernal flame. Giving himself over to it, body and soul, he lives to serve the Ashen Lord and will destroy anything and everything in his path.

3002.name: Hextech Galio
3002.description: Sensing a shift in the marketability of Hextech items, several of Piltover's largest industrial families pooled resources to create Galio, a massive golem donated to the city and her people. While he is ostensibly a walking advertisement, the protective creature is both curious about the world, and proud of his responsibility.

3003.name: Commando Galio
3003.description: Issues with the military industrial complex notwithstanding, why would a government put all its petricite resources into a giant statue that punches things? Or a pair of sunglasses big enough for one to wear?

3004.name: Gatekeeper Galio
3004.description: One of the great dukes of Hell, Galio stands before his kingdom's black gates as the judge of all sinners, casting souls into their proper torments. Attempting to invoke him generally ends in tragedy, as he's several hundred feet tall and refuses to shrink in the service of mortals.

3005.name: Debonair Galio
3005.description: Savor that elixir. Highlight that heavenly white tux with a royal purple reserved for kings and queens who just don't deserve it. Because when you're an eighty foot tall petricite gargoyle, you're always the center of attention.

3006.name: Birdio

chromas.name: Birdio

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

3006.description: A proud and noble salesman of delicious fried chicken, Birdio is the regional manager (and salesman of the year) for one of the world's largest chicken restaurants. Not one to be beaten at literally anything, he and Sivir have a well documented rivalry over who is the better employee.

3013.name: Infernal Galio

chromas.name: Infernal Galio

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

3013.description: A black-hearted monstrosity leading the hellish Infernal hordes, Galio is titanic even by the standards of his fiery kin. His steps melt the very bedrock beneath him, swallowing entire armies without so much as a second thought.

3019.name: Dragon Guardian Galio

chromas.name: Dragon Guardian Galio

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

3019.description: A great dragon of old, who protected dragonkind's ancestral nesting grounds from those who might do it harm. Tricked by the mad knight Kayle so she could destroy every clutch of eggs under his charge, he has followed her back to human society, so he might exact his vengeance personally.

3028.name: Mythmaker Galio

chromas.name: Mythmaker Galio

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Mythmaker Galio

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.name: Mythmaker Galio

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive drop from The Sanctum.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive drop from The Sanctum.

3028.description: The Great Beast Galio is a fearsome creature: proud, powerful, and worthy of the myth that bears his name. Yet each year he is bested, as the story goes, so when Irelia comes to him and tells him that their fates are not writ in stone, Galio listens. If helping her means crafting a new future, he will lend her all his beastly strength.

4001.name: PAX Twisted Fate
4001.description: A special event skin given away at PAX 2009.

4002.name: Jack of Hearts Twisted Fate
4002.description:
Second, the Jack, with a thunderous crack
Trounces fate in the blink of an eye!
In winnings he counts all the hearts of the court
Who will swoon every time he walks by.

4005.name: High Noon Twisted Fate
4005.description: Resident cardsharp of every dice parlour and gambling den on the high frontier, Tobias 'Twisted Fate' Felix likes to split his time between Buzzard Gulch, and the more civilized border towns. He specializes in breaking the hearts and bank accounts—in either order—of amiably naive debutantes.

4006.name: Musketeer Twisted Fate
4006.description: Twisted Fate was never supposed to be among the Order of the Musketeers, especially coming from a lowborn family. But his charm and quick wit—along with his skill in combat—helped him save the monarchy from a dastardly plot, earning him a place among the elite. Unfortunately for them, he prefers swashbuckling adventures to his actual duty.

4007.name: Underworld Twisted Fate
4007.description: For those dreading their inevitable meeting with Death, Twisted Fate offers another path. If they win his game of chance, a life of luxury awaits them. If they lose, he gladly adds yet another card to his ever-growing deck of doomed souls.

4008.name: Red Card Twisted Fate
4008.description: Tobias spends much of his spare time as a sanctioned referee for Order United matches. Sure, there are card games to cheat at, and gambling parlors to swindle, but it just doesn't compare to a heated game of soccer.

4009.name: Cutpurse Twisted Fate
4009.description: Looking to hire some muscle for an above-the-board, highly legitimate business venture? Look no further than Twisted Fate and his furry companion Graves, two men who will do anything (and we mean anything) to anybody (and we mean anybody) for the right price (any price). Inquire within!

4010.name: Blood Moon Twisted Fate
4010.description: The Blood Moon cult's true leader is shrouded in whispers and hearsay. It is he who first passed the trial of the masks, and he who unraveled the secrets of surrendering one's flesh to the demon spirits. Whether he is still human, none can say—but he is ever present, and always watching.

4011.name: Pulsefire Twisted Fate

chromas.name: Pulsefire Twisted Fate

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

4011.description: Swindling his way past the chrono-enforcers, Twisted Fate has made himself known by pulling off grand heists, across various timelines. Always just moments ahead of the law, with stolen riches in his pocket, he knows the alleyways of time make for the quickest of getaways…

4013.name: Odyssey Twisted Fate

chromas.name: Odyssey Twisted Fate

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Odyssey Twisted Fate

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Worlds event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Worlds event.

4013.description: A space smuggler erroneously known for discretion, as well as his impractically famous ship, The Wildcard, Twisted Fate was hired by Karma to free some templars from some space pirates. He has only just begun to notice that the other mercs on the job are better known for wetwork than simple heists...

4023.name: DWG Twisted Fate

chromas.name: DWG Twisted Fate

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2021.

4023.description: Honoring ShowMaker's winning performance as Twisted Fate during the 2020 World Championship.

4025.name: Crime City Nightmare Twisted Fate

chromas.name: Crime City Nightmare Twisted Fate

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Crime City Nightmare Twisted Fate

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Crime City Nightmare event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Crime City Nightmare event.

4025.description: No one knows if the Mysterious Gentleman is human or something Else, but he has somehow injected himself into every crime family in Valoran City. With honeyed words and a conman's grin, he convinced them all to embrace the horrors of the Beyond... Now the only thing to do is sit back and watch them tear each other apart.

4036.name: Space Groove Twisted Fate

chromas.name: Space Groove Twisted Fate

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

4036.description: He may be a scoundrel, but Twisted Fate is known the galaxy over as someone who gets things done. But even he can't find a trace of his long lost partner, Graves. So when some cats offered him intel on Graves' whereabouts in exchange for the location of the legendary underground disco, The Jam, he happily obliged. What's a few party crashers, anyway?

4045.description: Victorious Twisted Fate was earned by players who accumulated enough split points in Ranked. The commotion in the high roller room seemed to be a celebration, until a man flew out the door onto a card table. Sticking out of his far-too-ritzy suit is a joker card—its wide smile only matched by the man who deployed it.

5001.name: Commando Xin Zhao
5001.description: An expert at jungle warfare, Xin Zhao can harpoon a fruit from the rainforest canopy at a hundred yards. He just chooses not to, because it gets fruit chunks all over his spear.

5003.name: Viscero Xin Zhao
5003.description: No name packed the arena stands like “Viscero.” Other Reckoners would showboat to garner applause, bleeding their enemies out for the drama—but there was a different kind of entertainment in watching the Ionian legend execute a violent craft with ruthless precision. Whether or not Viscero himself liked it, he wasn't just good. He was one of the best.

5004.name: Winged Hussar Xin Zhao
5004.description: A member of the vaunted winged hussars, Xin Zhao is one of the last standard bearers of a military order tracing its roots back to the late 17th century. Of course, his progenitors didn't ride an army of armored black pegasi into battle, but you know how it is.

5005.name: Warring Kingdoms Xin Zhao

chromas.name: Warring Kingdoms Xin Zhao

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2019 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2019 Lunar Revel event.

5005.description: Legendary warrior and proud general both, Xin Zhao fights across the Warring Kingdoms to preserve peace for the common man. His spear is said to be sharp enough to pierce the sky, striking with the force of thunder.

5006.name: Secret Agent Xin Zhao
5006.description: Most people who come into contact with Xin Zhao have a gap in their memory where the encounter once was. This is probably for the best as most encounters he's involved in tend to include close encounters of the third kind, protecting civilians against terrifying extraterrestrial invaders, or evading aggressive UFO dive bombers.

5013.name: Dragonslayer Xin Zhao
5013.description: The sorceress called a great mountain her home, and from it, reborn dragons poured endlessly into the sky. Though dragonslayers fell all around him, Xin Zhao struck into the monster's lair, determined to end her evil once and for all.

5020.name: Cosmic Defender Xin Zhao

chromas.name: Cosmic Defender Xin Zhao

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

5020.description: Great horrors are attracted to the light of newborn stars—from the corruptants of the Dark Star, to squirming, ancient things yet unknown. Xin Zhao is the steadfast protector of these cosmic cradles, driving off any that would devour them.

5027.name: Marauder Xin Zhao

chromas.name: Marauder Xin Zhao

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

5027.description: Though brutal, the Marauders still follow a martial order established during the era of the Magelords. These commanders seek only to reclaim the might with which their order once ruled. Xin Zhao is one half of the pair of current leaders. Pragmatic and measured, he has resurrected an ancient Magelord to destroy his foes once and for all.

5036.name: Firecracker Xin Zhao

chromas.name: Firecracker Xin Zhao

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Firecracker Xin Zhao

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

5036.description: Xin Zhao is a popular man at the New Year's festival— and not just because he hands out lots of red envelopes. He is the reliable protector that keeps his more chaotic friends from getting into often-explosive mischief, and does it all with a cool, casual grace that leaves everyone swooning.

6001.name: Giant Enemy Crabgot
6001.description: Emerging from the deep sea as the first of the kaiju menace, Crabgot has never been completely defeated by the forces of humanity. The best result when it emerges is to temporarily halt its advance, sending the massive crustacean back into the sea... until it can rise once more.

6003.name: Battlecast Urgot
6003.description: A titanium juggernaut used to crush pockets of particularly stubborn resistance, the Battlecast Urgot model is rarely seen but widely feared. Its extensive weapons systems are complemented by a massive, flesh-grinding spike mill, which it pulls fleeing opponents into for sheer spectacle.

6009.name: High Noon Urgot

chromas.name: High Noon Urgot

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

6009.description: Jeremiah James was once a famed railroad baron and millionaire industrialist, who bet his own heart on a game of chance… and lost. Left alone in the desert to die, he bargained with a passing devil, trading his immortal soul for a twisted, monstrous body of gears and iron.

6015.name: Pajama Guardian Cosplay Urgot

chromas.name: Pajama Guardian Cosplay Urgot

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

6015.description: A Star Guardian superfan of almost impossible proportions, Urgot worked really hard on this outfit for the fan meet, so please be respectful.

6023.name: Fright Night Urgot

chromas.name: Fright Night Urgot

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

6023.description:
Unctuous Uncle Urgot has no nose to smell
No feet or toes to stink, but he's still feeling swell
'Cause visitors arrive and ring the household bell
With new parts not so rotten for him, and tummy snacks as well!

6032.name: Urgot the Clogfather

chromas.name: Urgot the Clogfather

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

6032.description: The Clogfather isn't just a janitor—he does all sorts of wetwork. He stalks the stalls, sanitizes the sinks, tidies the toilets... So it's not his fault if he's a little flush-happy. It comes with the territory.

7002.name: Prestigious LeBlanc
7002.description: LeBlanc is currently evading an international manhunt after making a jet liner filled with passengers disappear, then realizing she had no idea where they went or how to bring them back.

7003.name: Mistletoe LeBlanc
7003.description: LeBlanc's wicked illusions grow only more powerful during Snowdown, when the season of giving takes hold, and people are at their most gullible. Her enchanting looks only serve to draw more victims in, becoming pawns in her inscrutable games.

7004.name: Ravenborn LeBlanc
7004.description: LeBlanc loves nothing more than showing up her high society rivals at the annual holiday gala. Besides, taking a spin as the season's most fashionable witch will teach those Du Couteaus not to upstage her garden parties.

7005.name: Elderwood LeBlanc
7005.description: When the Coven first rose to power, they craved the living enchantments of the Elderwood—a tool, they believed, for the resurrection of their dark patrons. Thus did they fall upon the great forest, and slaughter its children… until a lone sylvan stood against them, stealing the witches' lives, their magic, and even their names.

7012.name: Program LeBlanc

chromas.name: Program LeBlanc

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.name: Program LeBlanc

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

7012.description: Marketed as a diplomat-software avatar, LeBlanc is in fact a duplicitous intelligence that can interact seamlessly with human users. Created only to deceive, she has infiltrated a number of the most powerful corporations on the planet, and quietly awaits her final orders.

7019.name: iG LeBlanc
7019.description: Honoring Rookie's winning performance as LeBlanc during the 2018 World Championship.

7020.name: Coven LeBlanc

7020.description: They came to LeBlanc as if in some forgotten melody -- songs of the Black Crane, and its titanic heart long-imprisoned within the deepest reaches of the Elderwood. Her sisters fell before the forest's defenders, but LeBlanc did find her prize... and now her patron has begun to wake, stirring itself from a dreamless slumber of unhallowed centuries.

chromas.name: Worlds 2020 LeBlanc

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

7033.name: Prestige Coven LeBlanc
7033.description: Resurrected by the Black Crane, LeBlanc has rejoined her sisters with renewed purpose—yet the gifts of the Old Gods do not come without a price. As her body twists into new and strange forms, LeBlanc has discovered that she is the vessel through which her own dead god will return, and that it has granted her impossible power.

7035.name: Debonair LeBlanc

chromas.name: Debonair LeBlanc

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Debonair LeBlanc

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Debonair event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Debonair event.

7035.description: Seemingly at every event in the city at once, LeBlanc is a ubiquitous presence throughout the strip—her unparalleled ability to shmooze matched only by her mysterious origins. There was a time when certain naysayers connected her to Crime City, but as they say… never cross Lady LeBlanc.

7045.name: Bewitching LeBlanc

chromas.name: Bewitching LeBlanc

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

7045.description: Everyone shares spooky stories of LeBlanc, the host of this year's celebration! It's said she delights in causing misery; she can turn any Jack-o'-lantern's smile upside down. But there's a softer side to her as well, one she tries to keep hidden, even from herself.

7055.name: Risen Legend LeBlanc

chromas.name: Risen Legend LeBlanc

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive reward for players who completed the 2024 Hall of Legends Battle Pass honoring Faker.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive reward for players who completed the 2024 Hall of Legends Battle Pass honoring Faker.

chromas.name: Risen Legend LeBlanc

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive reward for players who obtained the 2024 Hall of Legends Signature Edition Collection honoring Faker.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive reward for players who obtained the 2024 Hall of Legends Signature Edition Collection honoring Faker.

7055.description: Remember your duty as my Keeper of Patience, LeBlanc. You embody all that is strategic, methodical, and clever, as you deceive those who think themselves worthy of my power. Our power. Above all else, guide my chosen through their trials and influence the masses in the name of the Unkillable Demon King.

8001.name: Count Vladimir
8001.description: Once upon a time, in the heart of a dark and gloomy castle, there lived an eternally youthful count who the people greatly feared. Every night, a terrible red mist would seep into the villages, and some poor soul would vanish without a trace—another life lost to Vladimir's growing appetites.

8002.name: Marquis Vladimir
8002.description: At the last ball he attended, Vladimir stole everyone's heart. Strangely enough, no one has heard or seen those attendees since…

8003.name: Nosferatu Vladimir
8003.description: Look, the guy is a film buff. So what? Hemomancers can like things, too.

8004.name: Vandal Vladimir
8004.description: Leader of the notorious Vandals, Vladimir's exposure to residual radiation has given him control over the blood of living organisms. If he wanted to, he could cure every creature in the wasteland of disease—instead he rides around with his crew ransacking settlements. Priorities.

8005.name: Blood Lord Vladimir
8005.description: Former leader of a Bloodstone cult, Vladimir took part in a ritual that sacrificed his humanity—along with the blood of several victims—to transform the once foppish noble into a terror of the night. To satiate his sanguine cravings, he stalks the urban labyrinth in search of hapless prey.

8007.name: Academy Vladimir
8007.description: NOTICE FROM THE DEAN: Vladimir is henceforth suspended from Academy grounds for behavior including (but not limited to) extreme snobbery, hiring other students to finish his exams and attend his classes, and putting an unnecessary strain on our janitorial department after “that” incident.

8008.name: Dark Waters Vladimir
8008.description: In his younger days, Vladimir practiced at a school of medicine known for magically manipulating the humors of a patient's body. Turns out in Bilgewater there's more coin to be made killing than saving, and now he's found himself in a much more lucrative—if not messier—line of work.

8014.name: Nightbringer Vladimir

chromas.name: Nightbringer Vladimir

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: Nightbringer Vladimir

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: Nightbringer Vladimir

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

8014.description: The chaotic king of the night, Vladimir exists as the personification of uncertainty and revelry. He thrives in the unknown shadows, feeding on the life essence and darkness found in mortal hearts.

8021.name: Cosmic Devourer Vladimir

chromas.name: Cosmic Devourer Vladimir

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

8021.description: Pompous, arrogant, and isolated from his cosmic brethren, Vladimir drinks the essence from dead worlds to infuse dying ones with life. Yet as of late his hunger has begun to grow…

8030.name: Cafe Cuties Vladimir

chromas.name: Cafe Cuties Vladimir

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

8030.description: Vladimir spent years searching for the elixir of life—only to discover that it is, in fact, tea. Since then he has steeped himself in the art of the perfect cup. Though he pretends to frequent the cafe solely to advance his Tasseomancy, Vladimir has grown fond of the ragtag group that allowed him to take up residence among their ranks.

8039.name: Broken Covenant Vladimir

chromas.name: Broken Covenant Vladimir

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

8039.description: The ultimate Neverghaast, at least to himself, Vladimir cares only about feeding himself and his ego. Though he is not above helping someone for the right price, like that "idiot" Rakan, he has no stake in the war beyond finding the fabled well of Aspira within the congregation. Such power, he smugly reasons, would surely be better in his hands.

8048.name: Masque of the Black Rose Vladimir
8048.description: Lord Vladimir, your presence is requested at the upcoming Silken Danse. You might consider such a gathering beneath you, or unfavorably compare them to the carousals you host. Worry not, this masque will not be an intrusion upon your territory. Our matron simply has need of your boldness, to draw in new blood for our grand designs. –Lady Elise

9001.name: Spectral Fiddlesticks
9001.description: A gruesome spectre, rumored to stand eternally watchful over a peculiar book of fables. Brave knights and cruel sorceresses alike have tried in vain to reach the tome, but none have ever returned. Perhaps that lost queendom of old isn't so fictional after all…

9003.name: Bandito Fiddlesticks

chromas.name: Bandito Fiddlesticks

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

9003.description: If the day ever comes, riding those dusty trails, when a thin man in a wide hat appears far in the distance… run. Ride hard and fast and never look back, lest the horror known as Fiddlesticks drag you to from your saddle, and into darkness.

9004.name: Pumpkinhead Fiddlesticks
9004.description: Carriage drivers are cautioned to stick to well-traveled highways, especially during the witching season. Strange things can happen on those old, moonlit roads, where no birds sing, and something enormous moves within the fog.

9006.name: Surprise Party Fiddlesticks

chromas.name: Surprise Party Fiddlesticks

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

9006.description: Everyone told you hiring a clown would be a good idea. “Clowns are great for parties,” they said. But now everyone's missing, and the power is out, and something's laughing just down the hall...

9007.name: Dark Candy Fiddlesticks
9007.description: As lights go out across the Winterlands in preparation for Snowdown season, something ancient and terrible rises from the darkest corners of the Poro King's lands. Devoid of thought or purpose, it hunts for holiday revelers as if possessed, cutting down anything that crosses its path.

9008.name: Risen Fiddlesticks
9008.description: Once upon a time in a faraway land, a jealous young emperor invoked profane summoning rites in exchange for power. Yet when the ancient horror Fiddlesticks stepped forth, it did not aid the boy--and in an instant, his empire was utterly destroyed. The fiend was trapped beneath the ruins… until now.

9009.name: Praetorian Fiddlesticks

chromas.name: Praetorian Fiddlesticks

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

9009.description: The Remembrancers' worst fears have been realized. Emerging from tears in the fabric of spacetime, hordes of faceless, robotic marauders appear across the multiverse, destroying everything in their path. Fiddlesticks is only a single unit in this endless invasion force, assimilating any technology it comes across, and eradicating all life.

9027.name: Star Nemesis Fiddlesticks

chromas.name: Star Nemesis Fiddlesticks

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Star Nemesis Fiddlesticks

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Star Guardian event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Star Guardian event.

9027.description: The creature known as Fiddlesticks has fed on Star Guardians across every era, hunting those on the verge of falling before finally consuming their light. Its connection to the Guardians, and the reason it is drawn to them, is not well understood... but the familiar seemingly trapped within it suggests a truly disturbing origin.

9037.name: Blood Moon Fiddlesticks

chromas.name: Blood Moon Fiddlesticks

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Blood Moon Fiddlesticks

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

9037.description: A demon of fear and chaos, Fiddlesticks was summoned directly into the mortal realm by Aatrox himself. It craves violence and the taste of blood, driven purely by instinct and compulsion as it tears through Ionia. Other demons follow in its wake, scavenging what remains of its carnage.

10001.name: Silver Kayle
10001.description: Given to players who purchased the Retail Collector's Edition of League of Legends.

10002.name: Viridian Kayle
10002.description: Forest Elves are long lived compared to the humans they live among, and many delve into centuries-long explorations for even a scrap of their empires' lost magic. Those who find it, such as Kayle, are gifted with incredible powers over the natural world.

10003.name: Transcended Kayle
10003.description: Having cast aside her humanity, Kayle has transcended and fully assumed her mother's mantle as the divine Aspect of Justice. She is aware of her mortal origins, but views it as something distant that she left behind very long ago.

10004.name: Battleborn Kayle
10004.description: Kayle is a benevolent goddess in times of peace, and a terrifying battle spirit in times of war. She wears the traditional warpaint of her people as a living record of their victories and power.

10005.name: Judgment Kayle
10005.description: Those poor souls accused of crimes are brought before the all-seeing entity Kayle, where their deeds are judged with cold dispassion. Few are absolved, and fewer still escape their sentence.

10006.name: Aether Wing Kayle

chromas.name: Aether Wing Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Aether Wing Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

10006.description: Authorized pilot of the X07-Gevurah combat exosuit, Kayle is a justicar of the Royal Space Military operating deep in the heart of lawless space. Though her mission is to uphold the fragile postwar peace, years of violent conflict have radicalized her—now she acts as heartless judge, jury, and executioner for anyone or anything that falls beneath her gaze.

10007.name: Riot Kayle
10007.description: A Riot Games skin obtained by either meeting a Rioter or attending an official Riot event in 2014.

10008.name: Iron Inquisitor Kayle
10008.description: To be crowned inquisitor was to take a stand against the darkness, and at the head of the order stood Kayle, for her light shone the brightest. But darkness comes in many forms, and when the city fell, even its greatest champion would eventually turn upon her sisters.

10009.name: Pentakill Kayle
10009.description: When PENTAKILL needed a female vocalist, the heavens parted and a literal angel of rock fell to earth, taking up her sword-mic for the eternal glory of heavy metal.

10015.name: PsyOps Kayle

chromas.name: PsyOps Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: PsyOps Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 PsyOps event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 PsyOps event.

10015.description: A self-described “savior” and powerful psionic swordswoman, Kayle views herself as an impartial judge in world affairs, appearing on wings powered by psychic energy as an angel of war. Her understanding of the world is black and white to a frightening extreme, and she has joined the paramilitary BRG to see her twisted vision realized.

10024.name: Dragonslayer Kayle

chromas.name: Dragonslayer Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

10024.description: A famous dragonslayer who vanished into the distant mountains, obsessed with destroying the dragon lineage utterly. Many years later she has returned, so changed by the carnage that she has begun to resemble a dragon herself.

10033.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Kayle

chromas.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

10033.description: All hail, Kayle, the Bringer of Woe! With the strength of a self-righteous angel, she claims justice and judgment soar on her wings of wrath. Surely, if any can rally the warrior host of metal, it will be her.

10042.name: Sun-Eater Kayle

chromas.name: Sun-Eater Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

10042.description: The hated sun-eater, Kayle wished to be one with the divine she loved, devouring the primordial sun and steeping the land in an eternal eclipse. Driven mad with light and unable to contain her power, she passed fragments down to an army of witch-knights, who slew the other gods in an act of unforgivable blasphemy.

10057.name: Immortal Journey Kayle

chromas.name: Immortal Journey Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

10057.description: The Grounded Foresight School teaches power in knowing one's surroundings, but as Kayle nears immortality, doubt has crept in. Her parents' random deaths fostered a desire to exert as much control as possible in her life, but with her teacher Zed's banishment, the ground is now shaky. Immortality, she hopes, will finally give her solid footing.

10066.name: Empyrean Kayle

chromas.name: Empyrean Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Empyrean Kayle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Empyrean event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Empyrean event.

10066.description: Royal life for Kayle was one of blissful ignorance, while her sister pursued justice and equality for their subjects. After becoming the sole survivor of her realm, Kayle was awoken, and saw her fate as punishment for years of indifference. Now she doles out justice across the realms in tribute to her sister, though her methods are far more... severe.

10067.name: Prestige Empyrean Kayle
10067.description: When flames swept through Kayle's studio, at first she was overcome with grief. She had lost everything, but then realized that the fire freed her to do—and be—more. Now she returns to the Gala with her new line, Neon Flame, crossing styles, materials, and forms. Kayle has been reborn, and she will transcend everyone.

11001.name: Assassin Master Yi
11001.description: Ever since Yi gave up the ideals of Wuju style, he's been a terror to Noxian forces. A blade in the night, he strikes at the foes of Ionia with deadly precision. With every whisper of the leaves they shudder, expecting the next moment to be their last.

11005.name: Headhunter Master Yi
11005.description: Hunters use many tools: the bowgun, the rifle, the knife, the mind. Master Yi's tool of choice is a five foot long serrated blade forged from meteoric alloy.

11009.name: PROJECT: Yi
11009.description: One of the first concepts, Yi was held by PROJECT for extensive experimentation, and then finally freed by the G/NETIC rebels. His psyche may still contain some glitches, but his experimental hyperlight “alpha” blade serves the resistance with its precision balance.

11010.name: Cosmic Blade Master Yi
11010.description: Gliding effortlessly from star to star, Yi flashes through the night sky with celestial grace, his blade arcing with crystalline precision through the fabric of the universe itself.

11011.name: Eternal Sword Yi
11011.description: A pupil of a famous martial arts school, Yi has dedicated his life to the purity and art of combat. And yet, in his heart, he knows he is worthy of the fabled sword of jade, and a power beyond mere mortality…

11017.name: Snow Man Yi

chromas.name: Snow Man Yi

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

11017.description: A humble snowman brought to life by the magic of the Poro King, Yi strives to become the most gallant knight in all the land… and with the imminent invasion of Ice King Twitch, he might just get his chance.

11024.name: Blood Moon Master Yi

chromas.name: Blood Moon Master Yi

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

11024.description: The cultists of the Blood Moon have begun a dread metamorphosis, as the boundary between the demon realm and the human world is rapidly erased. Yi is among those first blessed by this new darkness, the demon within his blade arm driving him to ever greater spectacles of violence.

11033.name: PsyOps Master Yi

chromas.name: PsyOps Master Yi

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 PsyOps event.

11033.description: A legendary psychic swordsman and elite leader of the PsyOps unit. Yi is calm, professional, and always gets the job done, making him a terrifying bogeyman among rogue militaries, and a target for those harboring resentment towards the global war machine.

11042.name: Debonair Master Yi

chromas.name: Debonair Master Yi

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Debonair event.

11042.description: A powerful businessman of few words, often seen staring down on “his” strip from the comfort of his posh presidential suite. Despite his cold demeanor, Yi enjoys the finer things in life, and demands only the finest fits for his world-famous evening attire.

11052.name: Spirit Blossom Master Yi

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Master Yi

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Master Yi

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

11052.description: Legends speak of Master Yi, a swordsman who took but one student in his lifetime. After an unceremonious betrayal, Yi perished—not from a blade, but from a broken heart. Now the Spirit of Legacy roams the spirit world, searching for a pupil. He is lost, anyone that joins him destined to face the same fate.

11053.name: Prestige Spirit Blossom Master Yi
11053.description: Yi arrives at the Spirit Blossom Fashion Festival, donning tinted shades and the finest fabrics. While others prefer to celebrate with close family and friends, Yi revels in the attention his outfit brings, intent to cement his style "legacy".

11089.name: Inkshadow Master Yi

chromas.name: Inkshadow Master Yi

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Inkshadow event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Inkshadow event.

11089.description: Master Yi's family refused Cabal control, fleeing Rabadon City—only to be snuffed out. To fight back, he became one of the first Inkshadow Warriors, sacrificing his lifespan for a magical tattoo that grants him the power to raise his sword against the Cabal. He doesn't know how long he has left to live; still, he will save his city… and get his revenge.

11096.name: Heavenscale Master Yi

chromas.name: Heavenscale Master Yi

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

11096.description: A prince requires a master of the highest caliber to teach him martial arts, and there is no dragon of greater skill than Master Yi. A true master must be both warrior and poet, champion and artist—and in the spirit of learning, must always be ready for anything.

11106.name: Victorious Master Yi
