26014.description: Sage Zilean bowed his head in supplication as he took the Hunter's place before the Aurora's judge. His request was for more power to help calm the spirits of his followers. As he talked, he was oblivious to the Aurora sheen of Polaris' hair flickering red as she watched his pronounced humility. Something was stirring inside her, a roiling winter storm.

27001.name: Riot Squad Singed
27001.description: A limited Riot Games skin given away at 2010 and 2011 events.

27002.name: Hextech Singed
27002.description: Zaun's early forays into Hextech were critical to the movement, but not all were met with success. The scientist known as Singed warped his mind and body as he looped noxious, magically-infused chemical byproducts into his veins, twisting himself into a monster.

27003.name: Surfer Singed
27003.description: Sure, the haircut is dated, and the off-brand sunscreen is a little dodgy, but Singed held out on the Tiki mug—and look what came roaring back into fashion! The man is a visionary.

27004.name: Mad Scientist Singed
27004.description: Everyone thinks Singed is crazy. In reality, he's just a normal scientist with a penchant for bright neon colors.

27005.name: Augmented Singed
27005.description: A dastardly villain lurking in the dark corners of New Valoran, the mild-mannered Dr. Peter Singed was transformed by a volatile chemical of his own invention—becoming the superhuman criminal known only as… Singed! Can anyone stop this vile malefactor before it's too late?!

27006.name: Snow Day Singed
27006.description: Even deranged chemists need a day off, and Singed is no exception. Riding into battle with his recently sharpened sled and (patent pending) Portablizzard backpack, he is ready to dominate the snowball game, one crushing victory at a time.

27007.name: SSW Singed
27007.description: Honoring Looper's winning performance as Singed during the 2014 World Championship.

27008.name: Black Scourge Singed
27008.description: The doctor Singed induced many dreams with his mastery of science, and in these dreams the queen would gaze across the whole of creation, unraveling its secrets. But the shadow soon found her, and as she so hungered for its power, Singed turned to the craven arts to speed her corruption.

27009.name: Beekeeper Singed
27009.description: At first Singed wasn't certain he wanted to be a master beekeeper. But the moment he put on the protective suit, he knew it was destiny. Nowadays he can be found tending his hives, eating honey, or flipping any hapless wanderers that stop to gaze upon his work.

27010.name: Resistance Singed

chromas.name: Resistance Singed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

27010.description: Though many in the Resistance find Singed unsettling, few can deny his efficacy in pushing back the machine threat. For Singed, the only thing that matters is driving back Viktor's creations, whatever the means.

27019.name: Astronaut Singed

chromas.name: Astronaut Singed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

27019.description: No space adventure would be complete without a navigator. When Singed isn't creating special concoctions to keep his team safe, he's steering the crew's ship through the galaxy, masterfully guiding them to wherever his captain's whimsical orders lead them (and collecting any adorable meeps along the way).

27028.name: Arcane Shimmer Lab Singed
27028.description: Singed's experiments spit in the face of scientific ethics, each unleashing a new terror onto Zaun. But there is a method to Singed's madness. To make strides in the field of science, one must be willing to do whatever it takes, no matter the cost—and he is happy to pay the price.

28005.name: Blood Moon Evelynn
28005.description: A seductive demon summoned on the night of the Blood Moon, Evelynn moves between isolated villages, wooing the residents until they fall deeply in love with her. One by one these poor souls will surely perish, their hearts torn from their still-living bodies.

28006.name: K/DA Evelynn
28006.description: No one is as deliciously volatile as Evelynn. She's a diva who drives divisiveness in the media—they love her one day and hate her the next, her name a permanent fixture of tabloid headlines. She is a born superstar, and the foundation of K/DA's sound.

28007.name: Prestige K/DA Evelynn
28007.description: With that wild in her veins, K/DA Evelynn stomps into the spotlight, shimmering in a custom golden outfit from the Pop Music Awards. Only 'winning, winning' now.

28008.name: Sugar Rush Evelynn

chromas.name: Sugar Rush Evelynn

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

28008.description: In a world where every tooth is sweet, Evelynn's sugary bite is deadly.

28015.name: K/DA ALL OUT Evelynn

chromas.name: K/DA ALL OUT Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Worlds event.

28015.description: With a single devastating glance, Evelynn can ensure that all eyes are on her—when she wants them to be. K/DA's success has ensured that this provocative diva's name will be on everyone's lips, but Evelynn is intent that her killer fashion sense will keep it there.

28024.name: Coven Evelynn

chromas.name: Coven Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Coven Evelynn

28024.description: The covens of the south join their sisters for the great resurrection, as old things stir once more, and old grudges are at last repaid in full. Evelynn, daughter of the Great Harrier, gladly joins her sisters for the darkness to come—a trail of brutality and death always in her wake.

28031.name: Prestige K/DA Evelynn (2022)
28031.description: With that wild in her veins, K/DA Evelynn stomps into the spotlight, shimmering in a custom golden outfit from the Pop Music Awards. Only 'winning, winning' now.

28032.name: Spirit Blossom Evelynn

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

28032.description: Come. Leave your flesh behind and pass into the Spirit World. Bring with you only your desires, your vices, your painful memories. Let the Spirit of Love feed on these unwanted temptations, for her hunger is ravenous. Evelynn will show you peace at last.

28042.name: Soul Fighter Evelynn

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

28042.description: Most awaken their souls through hard work, but this fighter... no! All it took was a stop by the Department for the Eradication of Manifested Anomalies and boom! Cobra powers. SURE, apparently the procedure involves the "worst pain one can possibly imagine." But look at her now! Here to hunt down a daughter with nowhere left to run... it's Evelynn!

28052.name: High Noon Evelynn

chromas.name: High Noon Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: High Noon Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 High Noon event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 High Noon event.

chromas.name: High Noon Evelynn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 High Noon event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 High Noon event.

28052.description: The poor man looks haunted. Perfect. Evelynn leans over the bar top towards him with a sweet smile curling her red lips: “Tell me your woes, handsome.” And he does. He tells her of his brother, and a raw deal, and how he thinks he might be dead now but ain't sure... and the devil drinks deep. “It's alright, darlin',” she coos. “I've got you now.”

28053.name: Prestige High Noon Evelynn
28053.description: Ateliers near and far always ask Evelynn to wear their haute couture, but for this Gala, she's bringing her edgy elegance to a rowdier line of Western wear instead. What is fashion if not a wild new frontier? If there's anyone who knows how to take style by the reins and ride it into the sunset, it's this rodeo queen.

29001.name: Kingpin Twitch
29001.description: Many in Bilgewater get called a filthy rat, but none deserve the title more than the Kingpin himself. While other crime bosses in the port city may loathe to get their hands dirty, Twitch revels in wading into the filth himself—crossbow in hand, and a finely aged egg in his pocket.

29002.name: Whistler Village Twitch
29002.description: Whistler Village is an idyllic mountain hamlet known for spiced cocoa, competitive winter sports, and rumors of an insane man-rat living in the woods. Attempts to appease the creature with spiced cocoa and competitive winter sports have been unsuccessful.

29003.name: Medieval Twitch
29003.description: An assassin-for-hire living beneath Dread Fortress Zaun, Twitch is a disgusting malefactor who has tipped every one of his killing implements in moist, toxic garbage. He excitedly awaits each contract, eager to kill, steal, and destroy as much as he can.

29004.name: Crime City Twitch
29004.description: Deeply violent and severely paranoid, Twitch runs one of the largest crime syndicates in the nation. His orders are carried out by a literal army of rat-men, the only creatures he even comes close to trusting.

29005.name: Vandal Twitch
29005.description: An irradiated humanoid rat with an appetite for wanton collateral damage, Twitch is the number one provider of putrefied nuclear slime grenades to unsuspecting settlements everywhere. Equal parts audacious and paranoid, it is nearly impossible to stop his reckless rampages.

29007.name: SSW Twitch
29007.description: Honoring imp's winning performance as Twitch during the 2014 World Championship.

29008.name: Omega Squad Twitch
29008.description: Squad medic—and deranged lunatic—Twitch has been deeply and irreversibly affected by war. It's been a long time since he was a competent medical professional, as he no longer abides by the adage “do no harm.”

29012.name: Ice King Twitch

chromas.name: Ice King Twitch

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

29012.description: Twitch is a bitter, hateful creature who has jealously watched the Winterlands from his frozen burrow since time immemorial. Finally driven to the surface by twisted delusions of grandeur, he now seeks to usurp the Poro King, corrupting his subjects with an ancient, icy curse.

29027.name: Twitch Shadowfoot

chromas.name: Twitch Shadowfoot

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

29027.description: An extremely aggravating presence both in-game and at the table, Twitch Shadowfoot is the adorable Rift Quest counterpart to the actual Twitch, who is insane. Unsurprisingly, the cuddly rat-man rogue spends nearly every turn stealing his companions' equipment, mumbling of a vast conspiracy to overthrow him from his 'toilet kingdom'.

29036.name: Dragonslayer Twitch

chromas.name: Dragonslayer Twitch

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

29036.description: A lesser dragon who has learned to blend in among humans… poorly. Twitch worships the true dragons and plans to one day become one himself, though he isn't sure how just yet.

29045.name: High Noon Twitch

chromas.name: High Noon Twitch

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: High Noon Twitch

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

29045.description: It starts like this: An ill wind blows across the desert, dessicated rats turn up in the streets, rotting under the hot sun. Then the traveling undertaker arrives. No one knows who (or what) he is, nor where he hails from… But it seems even Death has a bone to pick with the King of the Sulfur Rail. Another Harbinger arrives.

29055.name: Cheddar Chief Twitch

chromas.name: Cheddar Chief Twitch

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

29055.description: During a daring heist at the local cheesery, Twitch dove headfirst into a wedge of aged Swiss and was trapped. He escaped, but with his head encased! Over time food and rat became one, and Twitch now revels in his role as the "big cheese" of the criminal underworld, proclaiming to all who question his dairy dominance: "Brie-ware!

29064.name: Pool Party Twitch
29064.description: No one told Twitch that there's rotten cheese under the ocean! It's awfully colorful and hard-looking, with tropical fish swimming around and plants growing out of it—but that must just make it even more delicious. He's got a plan: step one, steal a snorkeling mask. Step two… eh, he'll figure out step two later. Step three? Sea cheese.

30002.name: Statue of Karthus
30002.description: At the entry point of one of the world's most powerful nations stands the three-hundred-and-five-foot-tall statue of an evil, undead preacher holding a giant torch. Sometimes it comes to life. It's fun. Statues are fun.

30004.name: Pentakill Karthus
30004.description: Lead singer of heavy-metal sensation PENTAKILL, Karthus sings in the voice of a fallen angel made of freshly polished chrome and dynamite that eats other dynamite. His vocals explode the sun in the sky, igniting the flame of metal within the hearts of all who hear.

30005.name: Fnatic Karthus
30005.description: Honoring xPeke's winning performance as Karthus during the 2011 World Championship.

30009.name: Karthus Lightsbane
30009.description: Dark sorcerer, master of forbidden magic, aspiring lich—all could describe Karthus Lightsbane, a high level spellcaster with shadowy motivations. The rest of the party is convinced he'll eventually betray them, since nothing in the Riftquest rules says he can't.

30010.name: Infernal Karthus

chromas.name: Infernal Karthus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

30010.description: The disciples of Karthus usher this infernal harbinger into the world by singing his discordant chorus, a pledge that beckons pillars of flame unto them. On his arrival, the deathsinger's chant summons columns of hellfire that descend from the heavens above. Few live to tell of the dirge they heard before flames swept the land.

30017.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Karthus

chromas.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Karthus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

30017.description: All hail, Karthus, the Voice of Doom, and Chosen of Perpetuum! His songs are bleak murder ballads, a bitter reminder that all things must die. Though, perhaps, not him?

30026.name: Elderwood Karthus

chromas.name: Elderwood Karthus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

30026.description: Karthus was a brilliant scholar once upon a time. But when a disease nearly eradicated his people, he researched forbidden Coven magic, hoping to resurrect his loved ones... with catastrophic consequences. Now, he roams the Elderwood as a decaying creature, spreading his plague throughout the forest and inviting its inhabitants to transcend through death.

31002.name: Gentleman Cho'Gath
31002.description: Prior to indulging in the delectable taste of his victims, Cho'Gath prefers to invite them to his humble 40-acre mansion. There, he offers scones and jam, with a spot of tea… so his guests may savor their last meal before becoming one themselves.

31003.name: Loch Ness Cho'Gath
31003.description: Citing nothing more than a blurry photograph, the locals in one isolated town insist on the existence of a large, predatory marine animal that grows in size every time it feeds. The reports are otherwise unsubstantiated, but the spike in tourism has been great for the local economy. Not the disappearances, though. Those are bad.

31005.name: Battlecast Prime Cho'Gath
31005.description: The gold standard of Battlecast shock troopers, Prime Cho'Gath implements self-replicating nanites that reinforce its frame as it consumes living tissue. It has become a common and terrifying sight in occupied cities, where it feeds on civilians who won't submit to conversion.

31006.name: Prehistoric Cho'Gath
31006.description: A titanic beast feared for its massive size and endless appetite, no sane hunter would ever think of taking on Cho'Gath. Seeing as there are no sane hunters, Cho'Gath enjoys a steady supply of lightly armored food.

31007.name: Dark Star Cho'Gath
31007.description: Spawned from the remnants of a star system crippled by famine, Cho'Gath is driven to feed on any celestial body that crosses his path. These feasts swirl into the twin black holes at his heart—as endless and ageless as his hunger.

31014.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Cho'Gath

chromas.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Cho'Gath

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

31014.description: A mythical, titanic beast painted within the mysterious Shan Hai Scrolls, whose gluttony resulted in eternal karmic punishment, Cho'gath has seized upon the Scrolls' connection to the multiverse and plans to devour both his own world and then all others.

31023.name: Broken Covenant Cho'Gath

chromas.name: Broken Covenant Cho'Gath

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

31023.description: A living weapon of Nocturne's design, Cho'Gath is meant to cleanse the world of the Neverghaast. Empowered by sacred artifacts from the congregation's crypts, it has remained dormant while Nocturne feeds it prisoners to build its power. Despite its maker's intentions, nothing will be able to sate the monster's hunger once it fully awakens.

31032.name: Toy Terror Cho'Gath

chromas.name: Toy Terror Cho'Gath

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

31032.description: Snuggle up with Cho'Gath, your favorite plush pal! Squeeze his soft belly and watch him scare away bad dreams for a guaranteed good night's sleep. Extendable claw arms included for double the fun! Not suitable for children under 5 years of age. Some assembly required.

32001.name: Pharaoh Amumu
32001.description: Boy-king of the southern wastes, Amumu's mummified body still haunts the halls of his ancient tomb. His mournful sobbing can be heard over the brutal desert winds, luring in unwitting adventurers.

32002.name: Vancouver Amumu
32002.description: The Vancouver Board of Public Safety would like to assure citizens that no cursed mummies have been spotted within the city limits. Cursed mummies are not native to the Vancouver area. Please do not touch cursed mummies, spreading their mummy curse.

32003.name: Emumu
32003.description: When your friends let you down, the best thing to do is start a rock band driven by hard emotions.

32004.name: Re-Gifted Amumu
32004.description: Like decorative soaps or a fifth pair of socks, Amumu has been passed back and forth between disgruntled family members for generations. For some reason nobody seems to want the sobbing, accursed mummy boy.

32006.name: Little Knight Amumu
32006.description: A diminutive knight whose heart is brave and true, Sir Amumu of Shurima wants only to see peace reign the land in his lifetime. Considering that he's an undying, mummified princeling, he'll probably succeed.

32007.name: Sad Robot Amumu
32007.description: What's worse than a robot without a heart? A child without a friend.

32017.name: Infernal Amumu

chromas.name: Infernal Amumu

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.name: Infernal Amumu

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

32017.description: When ancient pyromancers unleashed the malevolent Infernals upon the world, they also unintentionally summoned younger, lonelier creatures. A mere spark compared to the fiery monsters now ravaging the land, Amumu seeks only friendship… unwittingly incinerating all those he touches.

32023.name: Hextech Amumu
32023.description: A mechanical boy intended as a playmate for wealthy children, Amumu has been long forgotten in the advent of newer and more advanced Hextech innovations. But a child has feelings, and within his artificial mind something has begun to awaken that will change the history of Hextech forever.

32024.name: Pumpkin Prince Amumu

chromas.name: Pumpkin Prince Amumu

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

32024.description: A lonely lad and prince of the patch, Amumu watches year after year as his people are decimated by possums and rowdy teenagers.

32034.name: Porcelain Amumu

chromas.name: Porcelain Amumu

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Porcelain Amumu

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

32034.description: Eternally young due to his bond with the Rat Relic, Amumu's innocence belies centuries of existence. He's been lonely in ages past, but no more: Lux is like his big sister, and Kindred is his… Kindred? Companionship hasn't stopped his occasional tantrums, of course, but at least now there's someone to shine his porcelain eyes after a nice cathartic cry.

32044.name: Heartache Amumu

chromas.name: Heartache Amumu

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

32044.description: Dear Amumu, I see you around the halls, and at the battle of the bands. I'm afraid I'm just too shy to ask you to hold hands, I think you're really cool and I'd love to be your friend. I can't wait to finally meet you! Love, Your Secret Friend-mirer 'Til the End

32053.name: Dumpling Darlings Amumu

chromas.name: Dumpling Darlings Amumu

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

32053.description: Lonely soul Amumu traveled the world to find a cafe that he could call home. Despite his best efforts to win over his fellow chefs as an apprentice dumpling maker, all of his concoctions end up just a little too salty. Yet he holds onto hope that his dreams of friendship—and the perfect prawn recipe—are within reach one day.

33003.name: Molten Rammus
33003.description: An unstoppable warbeast drummed up from the Infernal hordes, Rammus simply chooses a direction and begins spinning—through homes, armies, and nations alike, burning everything to ashes.

33006.name: Full Metal Rammus
33006.description: Those who make it to the Full Metal Robot Fighting League—the premier institution for gear-crunching, robot-on-robot violence—must often face off against the fearsome Full Metal Rammus. It is an initial rite of passage, faced by every contender-bot, that leaves entire arenas in tremors...

33007.name: Guardian of the Sands Rammus
33007.description: Rammus, the skewering wheel—ancient guardian of the sands, we invoke thee to protect us from an evil of our own making. Let no man tread upon these hallowed grounds, lest they be broken beneath your unforgiving carapace.

33016.name: Hextech Rammus
33016.description: Even the most renowned Hextech artificer must bow to the creativity and perfection of nature. After crafting each of Rammus's arcs to mimic the golden spiral, the creature proved so efficient at rolling... it escaped the moment its creator put down her wrench.

33017.name: Astronaut Rammus

chromas.name: Astronaut Rammus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

33017.description: Rammus was supposed to be the Space Program's core asset for terraforming new planets, and he was—until his digging unearthed a purple surprise no one was ready for. Now he has become something wholly different, his power turned to nefarious ends at the hands of the evil invader-meeps.

33026.name: Durian Defender Rammus

chromas.name: Durian Defender Rammus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

33026.description: Rammus roams the land in a pungent peel, and though he may look adorable, he gives new meaning to the phrase “silent but deadly.” Some say the effluvial enigma's armor reeks of sewage and sweaty socks, but strong-willed warriors know how sweet he can really be—if you can get past the smell.

34001.name: Team Spirit Anivia
34001.description: Despite her festive colors, Anivia is an incredibly poor sport. She has been known to wall off the exits to locker rooms and fire icicles at her teammates when faced with a loss, behavior that would would be disciplined... if she hadn't frozen the judges and referees.

34004.name: Hextech Anivia
34004.description: Early hextech lifeforms could barely be considered sentient... until the development of Anivia, an artificial avian capable of limited speech. Her birth was the foundation of the modern Hextech movement, and the multitude of creatures that came after her.

34006.name: Prehistoric Anivia
34006.description: A gargantuan beast capable of creating vast ice fields, Anivia is a nightmarish opponent for even the most seasoned hunters. She is drawn to the sound of hunts, dive bombing the area before retreating with a hunter or two to snack on.

34007.name: Adarna Anivia
34007.description: For one week a year, Anivia takes a break from being a prophetic ice spirit of the Freljord, and takes off for warmer climes… somewhere people will appreciate her samba.

34008.name: Papercraft Anivia

chromas.name: Papercraft Anivia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.name: Papercraft Anivia

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

34008.description: At the tallest paper mountain in the whole paper world, Nunu and Willump found a great paper phoenix. “You cannot go to the top of the mountain,” said the phoenix, “or your mother will be very angry.” So Nunu and Willump thought and thought, but they couldn't find any way to get past…

34017.name: Cosmic Flight Anivia

chromas.name: Cosmic Flight Anivia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

34017.description: A regal and truly ancient being, whose swirling energies give birth to entire galaxies. She has begun to wall off her creations, fearing the return of an ancient, golden foe that her kind has long sought to forget…

34027.name: Divine Phoenix Anivia

chromas.name: Divine Phoenix Anivia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Divine Phoenix Anivia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

34027.description: The legendary fenghuang watches over the world, awaiting the rise of selfless champions. Anivia grants power to those who fight for others with bravery and kindness in their hearts.

34037.name: Bewitching Batnivia

chromas.name: Bewitching Batnivia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Bewitching Batnivia

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

34037.description: Enchanted by LeBlanc herself, Batnivia flies along with a coven of witches, shrouding the night sky in darkness and chaos. Though she was once an ordinary bat, Leblanc sensed the spirit of the season in her; now she helps to spread terror to the children below and glee to the partygoers who follow her flight.

34046.name: Victorious Anivia

chromas.name: Victorious Anivia

descriptions.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 1600 Split Points and reached Bronze rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2023 - Split 1

chromas.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 1600 Split Points and reached Bronze rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2023 - Split 1

chromas.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 80 Split Points and reached Diamond rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2023 - Split 1

chromas.name: Victorious Anivia

descriptions.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 80 Split Points and reached Grandmaster rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2023 - Split 1

chromas.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 80 Split Points and reached Grandmaster rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2023 - Split 1

chromas.name: Victorious Anivia

descriptions.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 80 Split Points and reached Challenger rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2023 - Split 1

chromas.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 80 Split Points and reached Challenger rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2023 - Split 1

34046.description: Victorious Anivia was awarded to players who earned the requisite ranked split points in Season 2023 Split 1. Rising from the ashes covered in crystalline armor, Anivia's opulent feathers reflect her heightened nature. She is perseverance personified, an undying wish granted to those that need her most.

35001.name: Mad Hatter Shaco
35001.description: “It's always tea time,” said Shaco, cleaning his knife. “You can't drink tea without a nice, clean knife.” No one else responded, of course, because they were dead—which Shaco much preferred.

35003.name: Nutcracko
35003.description: A terrifying, evil nutcracker from an unknown time and place, Nutcracko's nightmarish appearance and dagger-hurling boxes of death are a curse on Snowdown festivities. He wishes to eliminate all Santas, ushering in a new age of stale fruitcake and creepy wooden toys.

35006.name: Masked Shaco
35006.description: A practitioner of masked dance drama, many of Shaco's performances begin as social commentary on the plight of the working class, and end with a random audience member being stabbed in the spine. It's a show worth seeing if you don't think about that last part.

35007.name: Wild Card Shaco
35007.description:
Last is the Jester, the wiliest sort
Obscured and forgotten by time,
Yet always much nearer than one might expect,
Stalking, closely, behind.

35008.name: Dark Star Shaco

chromas.name: Dark Star Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: Dark Star Shaco

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

35008.description: Shaco was once a region of space known for raucous celebration, wiped clean by the Dark Star and reborn into the mocking visage of a jester. His twisted cackling reaches inhabited systems long before he does, provoking visions of destruction, and societal breakdowns that will soon feed his endless hunger.

35015.name: Arcanist Shaco

chromas.name: Arcanist Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

35015.description: Vile warlock and wanted criminal, Shaco is a dangerous creature whose mind was shattered during experimental soul duplication rituals. At some point he came into possession of a rare and powerful book of spells, amplifying the threat of his monstrous arcane sorcery.

35023.name: Crime City Nightmare Shaco

chromas.name: Crime City Nightmare Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Crime City Nightmare Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Crime City Nightmare event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Crime City Nightmare event.

35023.description: Once a mere courier for the Twitch syndicate, Shaco is now barely human. The eldritch corruption has stripped him of reason and identity, turning him into a chittering horde of knife-wielding monsters that haunt the boroughs of Valoran City. None of them are sure which is the “real” Shaco anymore. None of them care.

35033.name: Winterblessed Shaco

chromas.name: Winterblessed Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Winterblessed Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Season 2023 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Season 2023 event.

35033.description: The Automaton Shaco felt nothing toward the quarreling leaders until Polaris snapped her fingers and ordered her “gifts” to corner the trio. “Winter is cruel,” she boomed, “and warmth is meant to be shared. Let this punishment serve as a warning.” In a flurry of snow, Polaris disappeared, leaving the Automaton and Beast to dispense her judgment.

35043.name: Soul Fighter Shaco

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

35043.description: I know very little about this fighter... and I've been told by our host to say EVEN LESS! (They've GOT to be friends... or mortal enemies?) His desires are hidden—just like his face—and his style in the ring remains to be seen! We just LOVE a mysterious and not-at-all creepy combatant, don't we, folks? Here he is... Shaaaaaaaacoooooo!

35044.name: Prestige Soul Fighter Shaco
35044.description: Shaco is never predictable; his unique (and often terrifying) looks make him a hit with judges year after year. Now adorned in gold and ivory lace, Shaco claims to be making a statement about fast fashion and the constraints it puts on designers and models. Or maybe he just wants an excuse to show off his soul-power arms.

35054.name: Fright Night Shaco

chromas.name: Fright Night Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Fright Night Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

35054.description: Cast beneath the floorboards with contraband and mold, confined within a simple toy, Shaco plotted worldwide doom. All he needed was a fool to spring him from his bindings and perform the ritual rites, but he should have known—never trust a Creepaway camper to get a ritual right!

chromas.name: Cat-in-the-Box Shaco

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

36001.name: Toxic Dr. Mundo
36001.description: Mundo not toxic, Mundo has healthy emotional coping mechanisms—oh, you mean purple goo? Mundo is sure that's fine, too.

36002.name: Mr. Mundoverse
36002.description: Mundo didn't mean to become fitness influencer, but Mundo's gains speak for themselves. Mundo recommends never skipping leg day, eating lots of protein, and smashing that like and subscribe button for more Mr. Mundoverse content.

36003.name: Corporate Mundo

chromas.name: Corporate Mundo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

36003.description: Mundo is not financial advisor. This is not financial advice. But you should buy the skin. Mundo likes the skin.

36004.name: Mundo Mundo
36004.description: Mundo could have dressed as anyone to go trick-or-treating, but this year he went as Mundo. Every year he goes as Mundo. Mundo trick-or-treats as he pleases.

36005.name: Executioner Mundo
36005.description: Executioner Mundo thinks people should not be so scared of him. Executioner Mundo puts on pants and chops up prisoners one leg at a time, just like Mundo pleases.

36006.name: Rageborn Mundo
36006.description: There are many tales of the Rageborn menace: that he's slain dragons with a single cleave, that the mightiest wizards cannot halt his advances, that no noble knight foolish enough to try and stop him has ever come back alive. The accounts often contradict each other, but the one thing they all agree on is this: Where Mundo goes, no one else pleases.

36007.name: TPA Mundo
36007.description: Honoring Lilballz's winning performance as Mundo during the 2012 World Championship.

36008.name: Pool Party Mundo
36008.description: Pool Party Mundo enjoys his hat and ukulele, but what he really loves are his shorts. They're comfy, and easy to wear.

36009.name: El Macho Mundo
36009.description: Probably in a position he'd rather not be in, El Macho will be facing down three of the greatest fighters in modern history for Sunday's no-holds-barred money match. Luckily for him, Mundo has more madness to offer than the federation thinks he's got, and the cream always rises to the top.

36010.name: Frozen Prince Mundo

chromas.name: Frozen Prince Mundo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2018.

36010.description: Once a handsome prince from an outlying region of the Winterlands, Mundo was touched by the curse of Ice King Twitch—corrupting him into a brutish thrall. He's still convinced he's the same statuesque royal as before, and as such… goes where he pleases.

36021.name: Street Demons Dr. Mundo

chromas.name: Street Demons Dr. Mundo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

36021.description: An abstract genius of the highest caliber with a doctorate in fine art, Mundo's reckless and wild finger painting has earned him a lot of respect in the artistic community for its high-concept analysis of the monster/human condition. (Mundo isn't sure what that means; he's just happy that people like his work!)

37001.name: Muse Sona
37001.description: Sona is a goddess of inspiration, compelling her worshippers to create profound works of art for all the world to see. Forgotten with the march of time, she has recently enjoyed a resurgence of followers in the form of coffee-addled waiters working on their 'next big screenplay idea.'

37002.name: Pentakill Sona
37002.description: Never tell Sona of PENTAKILL that keyboards aren't metal. Her instrument is filled with living barbed wire and a sonic scream loud enough to bring other, lesser musical genres crashing to their knees.

37003.name: Silent Night Sona
37003.description: Drifting through the streets as she plays, Sona's beautiful melodies bring out the wonder of fresh snowfalls, quiet evenings by the fire, and time spent with family and friends. She can also weaponize these songs, raining destruction upon those who would spoil the holidays.

chromas.name: Guqin Sona

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

37005.name: Arcade Sona

chromas.name: Arcade Sona

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Arcade event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Arcade event.

37005.description: Being forcefully transported from the real world to fight an army of evil video game bosses is no sweat for Sona. She was the first person to beat Keyboard Solo 4's ultra solo mode on nightmare difficulty—a feat that, by the developers' own admission, should not have been possible.

37006.name: DJ Sona
37006.featuresText:
• Trio of music styles
  • Show-stopping dance moves
  • Light show of effects
  • Music sharing with teammates
  • Three exclusive icons which grant dynamic profile background

37007.name: Sweetheart Sona
37007.description: Sona's quiet elegance and mastery of enchanted music might make the heart go all aflutter, but don't be fooled—she can still cut a man in half at thirty paces with her harp's soundwaves. That's the duality of love: sometimes you win, sometimes you get cut in half by soundwaves.

37009.name: Odyssey Sona

chromas.name: Odyssey Sona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

37009.description: Once member of the Templar Order, Sona was born with the ability to commune directly with ora, and the creatures from which it is harvested. More recently, she has sought out Yasuo, troubled captain of the Morning Star, and joined his ragtag crew—hoping to avert a disaster that could destroy the entire galaxy.

37017.name: PsyOps Sona

chromas.name: PsyOps Sona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: PsyOps Sona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 PsyOps event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 PsyOps event.

37017.description: An immensely powerful psychic, Sona has spent the past several years locked in darkness, subjected to harrowing experiments to further the Black Rose Group's aims of manufacturing the perfect human bioweapon. Freeing herself during the assault on the BRG's research facility, she discovers her power has grown to near-omnipotence, making her less a human than a psychic god.

37026.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Sona

chromas.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Sona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

37026.description: All hail, Sona, the Silent Virtuoso! An artist's soul can change the world, and with the harmonious power of creation at her fingertips, she will prove that what is made can yet be unmade.

37035.name: Star Guardian Sona

chromas.name: Star Guardian Sona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Star Guardian Sona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Star Guardian event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Star Guardian event.

37035.description: Quiet and reflective, Sona spends her time away from the Guardians as a composer of music... and her time with them as a fighter of incredible power, blasting enemies away with sonically charged starlight. Though she cannot speak, she always makes her voice heard through deeds... or her chatterbox familiar-slash-interpreter, Chiizu.

37045.name: Immortal Journey Sona

chromas.name: Immortal Journey Sona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

37045.description: As a newly immortal member of the Radiant Passion School, Sona's power is in building harmony from dissonance. To her, immortality only comes through finding your shared harmony with your fellow people, and she sees her students as strong notes to be built into immortal chords. It is in this shared passion that makes anything possible.

37046.name: Prestige Immortal Journey Sona
37046.description: A virtuoso artist radiating passion in whatever she does, Sona paused her promising music career to enroll in fashion school. Now a graduate, the Gala is the first showing of her debut line, and Sona is more than happy to let her work do the talking. Unlike her classmates, she has no dreams of becoming immortal through her designs. The journey is enough.

37056.name: Victorious Sona

chromas.name: Victorious Sona

descriptions.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 1000 Split Points and reached Bronze rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2024 - Split 2

chromas.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who accumulated at least 80 Split Points and reached Challenger rank in any Summoner's Rift ranked queue in Season 2024 - Split 2

37056.description: Victorious Sona was earned by players who accumulated enough split points in Ranked. Luring the unsuspecting into a false sense of ease with her melodies, Sona is as quick to pluck her allies from the brink of death as she is to send her foes to their grand finale.

38001.name: Festival Kassadin
38001.description: Reigning from his frozen throne on a lonely mountain, Kassadin prepares in secret for a special festival hidden deep in the icy wastes. Whether it's a winter sports festival, none can say… except for the attendees, who think he's being ridiculous.

38002.name: Deep One Kassadin
38002.description: “Kassadin vanished at sea over fifty years ago. Whatever you saw down there—if you did see anything—it can't have been the same man I watched fall into the drink. And if it was… gods help us.”

38004.name: Harbinger Kassadin
38004.description: Kassadin swore vengeance on all gods, good and evil, of his world and of others, when his kingdom was destroyed by an errant thought. Forging armor from the remnants of an ancient living machine, he now sees himself growing closer towards the all-powerful beings he wishes to destroy.

38005.name: Cosmic Reaver Kassadin
38005.description: Born before the kindling of the stars, Kassadin stands alone in space's vast void. He watches over all things, a sentinel awaiting the end of this universe… and the beginning of the next.

38006.name: Count Kassadin

chromas.name: Count Kassadin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

38006.description: A grim, lonely man who lives on a grim, lonely street, Kassadin is the one whom all kids avoid on All Hallows' Eve; for in his presence, there are no treats nor sweets to be found.

38014.name: Hextech Kassadin
38014.description: Engrossed in his work to the point of near-obsession, Kassadin vanished for some time into the bowels of his labyrinthian workshop, disappearing from public life for years. When he emerged, he revealed a shocking hextech innovation to the world: his own body, fully integrated with the technology he so loved.

38015.name: Shockblade Kassadin

chromas.name: Shockblade Kassadin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Shockblade Kassadin

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

38015.description: As high priest of the Shockblade order, Kassadin has a deep connection to the Storm few understand, but all respect. It is the power of his station that allows the Shockblades to follow their targets in and out of the spirit realm, going where no one else can to protect the people under their charge.

38024.name: Dragonmancer Kassadin

chromas.name: Dragonmancer Kassadin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

38024.description: Kassadin scoured the world in search of a missing loved one. He mapped out a path in the stars, following a pattern of constellations only he could read—reaching an open field where the Astral Dragon recognized his purpose. Though his spirit darkens over the possibility his journey may never end, he now harnesses the dragon's brilliance to light his way.

39001.name: Nightblade Irelia
39001.description: In exchange for the power to expel Noxus from Ionia, Irelia struck a bargain with an evil spirit—a decision that would prove costly when her humanity began to slip away...

39002.name: Aviator Irelia
39002.description: Few war pilots were as skilled as Irelia, whose flashy dogfighting earned her a place among the greatest soldiers in history. After the war she continued to fly fighter planes, never once losing her spark.

39003.name: Infiltrator Irelia
39003.description: Using technologically superior cracking devices and hard-light blades, Irelia's nefarious activity is surprisingly hard to follow. She's responsible for a string of heists and high-profile espionage missions.

39004.name: Frostblade Irelia

chromas.name: Frostblade Irelia

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Snowdown event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Snowdown event.

39004.description: An ice sprite hailing from the mythical Winterlands, Irelia's demeanor is surprisingly stoic considering her mischievous brethren. Despite this, she aspires to one day serve in the court of the Poro King.

39005.name: Order of the Lotus Irelia
39005.description: A chance encounter with the Order of the Lotus changed Irelia's life forever, as she opened her mind to the cosmic cycles of death and rebirth over many human lifetimes. She is still a fierce warrior, but now fights knowing her soul can never truly die.

39006.name: Divine Sword Irelia

chromas.name: Divine Sword Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.name: Divine Sword Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

39006.description: Long ago, the demigoddess Irelia challenged a headstrong dragon king to a duel, defeating him before all the members of his assembled court. In his hubris, he lashed out at her, and in return she sealed his power within her sacred blade, so that he might find humility among humankind.

39015.name: iG Irelia
39015.description: Honoring Duke's winning performance as Irelia during the 2018 World Championship. This is Duke's second World Champion skin, following his win with SKT at the 2016 World Championship.

39016.name: PROJECT: Irelia
39016.description: A PROJECT castoff who found sanctuary in the lawless wastes, Irelia has led other outcasts like her as they attempt to survive corporate assassins, murderous old-world technology, and widespread ecological collapse. Knowing Warwick could destroy everything she holds dear, she joins the attack on the City to end PROJECT once and for all.

39017.name: Prestige PROJECT: Irelia
39017.description: There are moments when Irelia and the other outcasts remember who they once were, before PROJECT exiled them into a wasteland filled with sand-blasted monuments to corporate greed. These memories are fleeting, the last flickering images of a long-compromised humanity.

39018.name: High Noon Irelia

chromas.name: High Noon Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

39018.description: A fallen angel who escaped the destruction of Heaven, now tainted by ineffable darkness. Irelia has spent years in hiding, thus her return alongside a newly resurrected Senna attests to the presence of powers who would see the heavenly kingdom restored… perhaps for the continued benefit of man, or perhaps for their final damnation.

39026.name: Sentinel Irelia

chromas.name: Sentinel Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Sentinel Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

39026.description: After the fall of the Ionian Grand Temple, Irelia could not stand idly by while her home was ravaged by the Black Mist. Deputized by the Sentinels, she fights the Ruination as one of their comrades: a natural-born leader who understands the threat that Ruined Karma poses, she will stop at nothing to save the Spirit of Ionia.

39036.name: Prestige PROJECT: Irelia (2022)
39036.description: There are moments when Irelia and the other outcasts remember who they once were, before PROJECT exiled them into a wasteland filled with sand-blasted monuments to corporate greed. These memories are fleeting, the last flickering images of a long-compromised humanity.

39037.name: Mythmaker Irelia

chromas.name: Mythmaker Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Mythmaker Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Lunar Revel event.

39037.description: Irelia was always a bystander in the story of “The Great Beast Galio”, watching from the sidelines each year as the story was told again and again… until the day that the Lunar Players crashed into their myth-world, and she found out that her story could change. Now it's time for Irelia to become the hero she wished she could be and write her own destiny.

39045.name: Porcelain Irelia

chromas.name: Porcelain Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Porcelain Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Lunar Revel event.

39045.description: Irelia was dedicated to the preservation of ancient relics long before she became a protector. Her first year at university, she interned at the renowned Archeology Institute. It was the highlight of her short life... until she was granted mythical powers by the Ram Relic and thrust into a centuries-old war. Schoolwork sort of pales in comparison.

39055.name: Spirit Blossom Irelia

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Irelia

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

39055.description: The Ready Hand was a devoted bodyguard to the Wandering Queen. Yet when her duty to protect was eclipsed by a desire to see her queen happy, calamity followed. The kingdom fell, and the queen died in her arms. Now, as an akana spirit, the Ready Hand roams the endless night, burdened by regret.

40002.name: Hextech Janna
40002.description: Practitioners of Hextech science have historically benefited from the core crystalline matrix's more esoteric properties. Janna's long exposure to such raw materials famously granted her the power of limited flight, and the ability to control the wind.

40004.name: Victorious Janna
40004.description: Victorious Janna was awarded to players who reached Gold or higher in the 2012 season. Armed with a crystalline staff and the best Demacian armor, Victorious Janna unleashes epic gales to blow her enemies away.

40005.name: Forecast Janna
40005.description: Janna has survived the market downswing in televised news for at least the last decade, but even in her relatively cushy position, the viewers are getting older and the weather is getting freakier. Might be time to put her meteorology degree to good use, and… fight the sky!

40006.name: Fnatic Janna
40006.description: Honoring Mellisan's winning performance as Janna during the 2011 World Championship.

40007.name: Star Guardian Janna
40007.description: Soft-spoken and sometimes distant, Janna serves as mentor to her younger team and gently guides them towards a true understanding of their destiny. While she rarely offers information about her mysterious past, her poise and quiet strength are deeply admired by her Star Guardian teammates.

40008.name: Sacred Sword Janna
40008.description: Janna is the guardian of an ancient sword made of the purest jade, hidden at the bottom of a silent lake. Those who wield this weapon are granted immortality, and so she must remain steadfast in order to protect it.

40013.name: Bewitching Janna

chromas.name: Bewitching Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.name: Bewitching Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during 2018.

40013.description: It's Janna's favorite season once again—when dark spirits rise from the earth, and hidden troves of candy are enjoyed by all. Don your best disguise and ride into the night, for the witching hour is upon us!

40020.name: Guardian of the Sands Janna

chromas.name: Guardian of the Sands Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

40020.description: Janna, the desert gale—ancient guardian of the sands, we invoke thee to protect us from an evil of our own making. Let no man tread upon these hallowed grounds, lest your sandstorms consume them whole.

40027.name: Battle Queen Janna

chromas.name: Battle Queen Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Battle Queen Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Battle Queens event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Battle Queens event.

40027.description: Hailing from Aurai, floating high above the Tournament, Queen Janna quite literally looks down on the whole affair. But without a champion in the Coronation, the magic that brings long-life to Aurai's reclusive population will fail, and so Janna descends for yet another showcase exhibition of her power. Anything to protect her people.

40036.name: Crystal Rose Janna

chromas.name: Crystal Rose Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

40036.description: The desire for peace brought about more than just a yearly festival. Born from this universal wish was Janna, a spirit whose magic hangs like a wreath over the night. Though she's regarded by most as a legend, guests sometimes say they see a beautiful woman float by. Maybe it's a trick of the crystal rose's light...

40045.name: Cyber Halo Janna

chromas.name: Cyber Halo Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Cyber Halo Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

40045.description: An experiment from RSM's R&D division, Janna is the only successful use of an android to pilot an exosuit in history. Perhaps it's because she looks so human that most forget the gusts of “wind“ she commands are actually a fleet of nanobots connected directly to both the X09-Zephyr as well as her central processing core.

40046.name: Prestige Cyber Halo Janna
40046.description: Always a breath of fresh air in the fashion world, Janna took a risk working with a new designer for her high-tech red carpet look. That risk was well worth it: the future of fashion is here, and it's looking bright.

40056.name: Heavenscale Janna

chromas.name: Heavenscale Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Heavenscale Janna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Heavenscale event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Heavenscale event.

40056.description: Janna is the most skilled dragon in the kingdom at sorcery (save for the king himself, perhaps), whipping up winds and steering the clouds. The prince asked if she might take him on as a pupil, and Janna happily accepted; but she is looking forward to showing him more whimsical uses of their power. After all, they have a festival to attend.

41003.name: Sailor Gangplank
41003.description:
O, Bilgewater has been my home,
Since last time I was sailing!
But I'll not stay another day,
I'd sooner be out whaling.

41004.name: Toy Soldier Gangplank
41004.description: Gangplank is a model soldier in the toy army, racking up an impressive array of victories against the dolls and stuffed animals. He hopes to one day be named Toy General, leading his troops into glorious battle.

41005.name: Special Forces Gangplank
41005.description: How special are the special forces? Let's put it this way: they're the only unit in the military with unlimited access to oranges.

41006.name: Sultan Gangplank
41006.description: Gangplank is a ruler from a distant land, and tales of his battle prowess and flowing red beard have reached even the farthest-flung city-states. As all rulers from distant lands, he also sports a snappy hat.

41007.name: Captain Gangplank
41007.description: Gangplank was a legendary murderer and cutthroat, prior to having his ship blown up while he was still on it. The silhouette of his famed captain's jacket is still burned into the memory of more than one unlucky sailor... with many convinced the man is somehow still alive.

41008.name: Dreadnova Gangplank

chromas.name: Dreadnova Gangplank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

41008.description: Once a high ranking admiral in the Royal Space Military, Gangplank's reign of terror began when he stole and proliferated blueprints for a former colleague's experimental superweapon. Ending a thousand-year civil war in an instant, he defected with a massive armed battalion and formed the interplanetary criminal network known as the Dreadnova Corps.

41014.name: Pool Party Gangplank

chromas.name: Pool Party Gangplank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

41014.description: Gangplank is the self-crowned King of the Grill, but his summer bod is the real life of the party. There should be a law against those abs.

41021.name: FPX Gangplank

chromas.name: FPX Gangplank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

41021.description: Honoring GimGoon's winning performance as Gangplank during the 2019 World Championship.

41023.name: Gangplank the Betrayer

chromas.name: Gangplank the Betrayer

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

41023.description: Energized by a mysterious amulet containing Viego of Camavor and wielding the Blade of the Ruined King, Gangplank's personality erupted as he raged in search of the long-lost Isolde. Though ultimately freed of the King's influence by a group of heroes, he carries the experience with him... a reminder, perhaps, of true power.

41033.name: PROJECT: Gangplank

chromas.name: PROJECT: Gangplank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

41033.description: Leader of the Command Line with a merciless reputation, Gangplank's access to dangerous PROJECT tech allows him to rule the city with a cybernetic fist. But when an insubordinate program wreaks havoc on his domain, he resorts to manipulating former Outcasts to protect his legacy and wipe the virus out for good.

42001.name: UFO Corki
42001.description: Everyone said this model wouldn't fly, but Corki's never let himself be discouraged by others being reasonable.

42002.name: Ice Toboggan Corki
42002.description: Having broken the land-speed record in most other vehicular sports, Corki has turned his attention to the ice luge—a momentum-based activity that doesn't require a state-of-the-art flying sled with a forward-mounted machine gun. He brought one anyway.

42004.name: Hot Rod Corki
42004.description: Your plane's sheeting was busted, so we replaced it with a bullet-resistant alloy, and four-cylinder external mounted coal engine. Plus we painted flames on the front. No extra charge.

42005.name: Urfrider Corki
42005.description: Defying all laws of physics, Corki rides Urf the Manatee into battle. With gatling guns ablazing, they charge headlong into the war against Urfwick and all other enemies who may threaten the existence of the peaceful and benevolent Urfs.

42006.name: Dragonwing Corki

chromas.name: Dragonwing Corki

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

42006.description: Corki's pit crew made sure to outfit him with a special ship for Lunar Revel, emblazoned with the visage of a dragon to scare off evil spirits. It has been further modified to spray bullets and fire explosives… presumably also to scare off evil spirits.

42007.name: Fnatic Corki
42007.description: Honoring LaMiaZeaLoT's winning performance as Corki during the 2011 World Championship.

42008.name: Arcade Corki
42008.description: The fearless protagonist of a 1980s top-down shooter, Corki resists Veigar's battle bosses the same way he resists being shot down by thousands of glowing bullets—move fast, and shoot everything before it shoots him.

42018.name: Corgi Corki

chromas.name: Corgi Corki

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

42018.description: A dog trainer with some impractical ideas about canine aerodynamics, Corki has entered the world's foremost pet show with a flight-enabled Pembroke Welsh Corgi. Why has he done this? What does he hope to gain? Is he really a Yordle, or just a very small man? These are all important questions.

42026.name: Astronaut Corki

chromas.name: Astronaut Corki

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Astronaut Corki

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

42026.description: Commander Corki is both a veteran of the space program and its fearless leader. After traveling to a new and undiscovered planet with his intrepid crew, he befriended a stray alien meep that became his assistant and ally in exploring the galaxy. Together they fly, holding off the encroaching invasion of evil purple meeps that threaten the cosmos.

43001.name: Sun Goddess Karma
43001.description: An ageless being in whom the sun rises and sets, Karma is the key to an ancient prophecy spelling doom for the world. When she is overtaken by the moon, four titans will rise up from the depths of the earth, annihilating all life.

43003.name: Traditional Karma
43003.description: Created to capture the original feel of Karma, one of our first fully reworked champions.

43005.name: Warden Karma
43005.description: The Protectorate was an order dedicated to enforcing a rigid, unforgiving system of laws, in an attempt to slow the seemingly inevitable rise of the Magelords. Though the order itself was disbanded long ago, Wardens such as Karma still uphold its tenets… and guard its many secrets.

43006.name: Winter Wonder Karma
43006.description: A powerful sorceress at one with the natural world, Karma spreads snow like a soft blanket across the enchanted forests of the Winterlands. A loyal friend of the Poro King—wherever Karma goes, winter follows.

43007.name: Conqueror Karma

chromas.name: Conqueror Karma

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 MSI Event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 MSI Event.

43007.description: Commemorating the 2017 Mid-Season Invitational in Brazil.

43008.name: Dark Star Karma

chromas.name: Dark Star Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

43008.description: Karma was a galaxy-spanning civilization dedicated to pacifism and personal enlightenment, unceremoniously erased from reality and reborn as a star-consuming horror. Devouring entire galactic systems, she enforces a dread order upon the cosmos, meditating in the vast oceans of emptiness where once there were stars.

43019.name: Dawnbringer Karma

chromas.name: Dawnbringer Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was acquired during the 2019 Night & Dawn event. All proceeds went to charity.

chromas.description: This chroma was acquired during the 2019 Night & Dawn event. All proceeds went to charity.
