chromas.description: This chroma was acquired during the 2019 Night & Dawn event. All proceeds went to charity.

chromas.name: Dawnbringer Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was acquired during the 2019 Night & Dawn event. All proceeds went to charity.

chromas.description: This chroma was acquired during the 2019 Night & Dawn event. All proceeds went to charity.

43019.description: Charged with governing the cosmic cycles of death and rebirth, Karma fights to protect the wellspring of souls as they journey to reincarnation. More so than the other cosmic beings, she cares for the mortal souls she shepherds, striving to create a more structured world.

43026.name: Odyssey Karma

chromas.name: Odyssey Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Odyssey Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Worlds event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Worlds event.

43026.description: A High Priestess of the Templar Order, Karma has hired a group of offworld mercenaries to free a number of captured templars from the grip of Aatrox, an infamous and powerful crime lord. She has taken a more interventionist stance towards the rest of the universe following the loss and transformation of her former lover, Zed.

43027.name: Ruined Karma

chromas.name: Ruined Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Ruined Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

43027.description: Surviving the initial ruination of Ionia, Karma is ultimately lost during a second one led by Viego himself. With the Spirit of Ionia itself removed from the continent, the Ionian people must band together to save one another, even as Karma twists the souls of millions to a new, horrific purpose.

43044.name: Tranquility Dragon Karma

chromas.name: Tranquility Dragon Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Tranquility Dragon Karma

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.name: Tranquility Dragon Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2021 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2021 event.

43044.description: As Brand's corruption spread, Karma sought the power to restore peace. When her desperate search throughout the land failed, Karma was left with nowhere left to look but within. After months of quiet contemplation, the fabled Tranquility Dragon greeted her in a vision. She awoke with the dragon's gift, the power to bring tranquil peace to face Brand's raging violence.

43054.name: Faerie Queen Karma

chromas.name: Faerie Queen Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Faerie Queen Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Faerie Court event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Faerie Court event.

43054.description: All hail Her Majesty, Karma, Queen of the Seelie Court of Light and Beauty! Though her selection and subsequent rise to the throne was a surprise to everyone (nobles, laymen, even Karma herself), she is a beacon of poise and power, overseeing the turning of seasons and keeping the balance between the ever-bickering seasonal sub-courts. Long live the Queen!

43061.name: Infernal Karma

chromas.name: Infernal Karma

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

43061.description: Possessed by a spirit of the Infernal flame, Karma was once a powerful pyromancer of the Shadowfire Temple. Believing it possible to control the flame spirit, she captured it hoping to put an end to the Ashen Lord's reign but succumbed to the hellfire like all the rest.

44001.name: Emerald Taric
44001.description: The Knights of the Emerald Chapel are the once-human stewards of the Elderwood—men and women who swore an oath to the land itself, and in return were granted unnaturally long life. Now led by a man named Taric, a handful reside there still, protecting the forest from all manner of invaders.

44002.name: Armor of the Fifth Age Taric

44003.name: Bloodstone Taric
44003.description: Considered to be the most handsome and cunning acolyte of his Bloodstone cult, Taric seized power after the former leader took to the hunt. Now fully in control of his Bloodstone artifact, he uses his powers to maintain his youth and beauty at all costs—even if it means getting his hands a little bloody.

44004.name: Pool Party Taric
44004.description: Always on the alert, Taric will run in cinematic slow motion to save any swimmer in distress. Although, Taric has failed to save a distressing number of them.

44009.name: Taric Luminshield

chromas.name: Taric Luminshield

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

44009.description: A battle cleric who has to simultaneously tank and heal for a pair of bumbling rogues, Taric Luminshield may be the only thing keeping his table from a total party wipe. In-universe he's a devout warrior of the Divine Goddess Targonius, but out of universe he'd rather be in a different campaign.

44018.name: Space Groove Taric

chromas.name: Space Groove Taric

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

44018.description: Taric always found himself wanting more out of life and dreamed of discovering what was beyond his mundane world. His wish was granted when Teemo arrived on his planet and swept him off on an adventure. He's now found a place for himself as Ornn's apprentice as he works to understand the concept of Groove.

44027.name: Fatebreaker Taric

chromas.name: Fatebreaker Taric

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

44027.description: Taric is destined to become another faceless soldier thrown to the endless churn of war, but he would rather spend his days writing poetry and tending to the sick. Now, he seeks an audience with the Fatemakers, eager to prove that the Weave of Fate would be all the more beautiful with one more poet in the world.

45001.name: White Mage Veigar
45001.description: A master of healing magic residing within an ancient cathedral, Veigar self-identifies as a dastardly archvillain rather than the pious cleric he clearly is. His magic has cured ailments and dispelled curses from across the land, much to his chagrin.

45002.name: Curling Veigar
45002.description: Curling is a sport where players slide stones across the ice with a stick. Veigar is an evil yordle obsessed with annihilating the great cities of Valoran. It just makes sense.

45003.name: Veigar Greybeard
45003.description: A suspiciously helpful wizard the party meets early in their adventure, Veigar Greybeard holds a dastardly secret—he's the true villain of Riftquest! Of course, this is obvious to anyone who played the starter campaign, but you still shouldn't spoil it for newcomers.

45004.name: Leprechaun Veigar
45004.description: Contrary to popular belief, Veigar won't grant three wishes, isn't a fairy, and doesn't hide gold coins at the end of a rainbow. He will, however, kill you. Which is none of the things you want out of a magic leprechaun.

45005.name: Baron Von Veigar
45005.description: Ruler of the New Bandle Republic, Veigar considers himself the ultimate dark power of the wasteland—an evil so great that no man, woman, or creature would ever dare challenge his authority. Recently, he fixed up a water purifier and an electric grid for the city, too. An electric grid… OF EVIL!

45006.name: Superb Villain Veigar
45006.description: The villainous Veigar is at it again! Reigning from the top floor of the Veigar Company skyscraper, the criminal mastermind hatches the vilest plans New Valoran has ever seen! Yet even when his schemes are foiled, he always escapes punishment, biding his time until his next chance to strike!

45007.name: Bad Santa Veigar
45007.description: Most Santas wish to bring joy and enchantment to children everywhere, but Veigar wants no such thing. His dark ambitions have grown beyond simply thwarting Snowdown—he schemes to throw the world into chaos, blotting out the holidays with his evil forever.

45008.name: Final Boss Veigar
45008.description: Once merely a mini-boss with a Napoleon complex, Veigar has ripped into the code of Arcade World to summon hundreds of other bosses to his side. Together they'll stop at nothing to reach his ultimate goal: take the world for himself, and give the heroes a final Game Over.

45009.name: Omega Squad Veigar
45009.description: A heavy artillery specialist with a serious chip on his shoulder, Veigar has a troubling habit of calling down huge amounts of explosive ordnance for even the most mundane problems. He thinks of it as “a fun quirk.”

45013.name: Elderwood Veigar

chromas.name: Elderwood Veigar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

45013.description: A small number of the Elderwood's children remain largely unaffected by the growing influence of the Coven, to the relief of scholars and storytellers alike. Unfortunately, those particular children are some of the most whimsical and dangerous, including among their number the insane goblin Veigar and his cursed, hallucinogenic toadstools.

chromas.name: Furyhorn Cosplay Veigar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

45032.name: Astronaut Veigar

chromas.name: Astronaut Veigar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

45032.description: A scientist conducting research on alien energy sources, Veigar ventured too far into empty space... but the Veigar that came back was different from the one that was set adrift. No one is sure why, but something about him is more… evil? And purple.

45041.name: Monster Tamer Veigar

chromas.name: Monster Tamer Veigar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

45041.description: Veigar has big plans. BIG. First, he'll amass an army of monsters, preferably from the darkest, scariest corners of the land. Then he'll use the CORE to create a bond with said monsters and amplify their power. Then he'll take over the world!! Hmm... he might have missed a step.

45051.name: King Beegar

chromas.name: King Beegar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

45051.description: Beegar's waited a whole 10 days (that's a long time in bee-years) for his moment to strike. It's finally here, and the Queen Bee's crown is in his sights. Long live the Bee-sistance!

45060.name: Fright Night Veigar

chromas.name: Fright Night Veigar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.
This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Fright Night Veigar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.
This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

45060.description: In the dreadful, dreary wood, campers scampered about with glee, gathering fallen branches from the gnarled, cursed trees. They tossed them onto a makeshift pyre and read the incantations. From the flames, Veigar erupted, ready to vanquish his competition.

48001.name: Lil' Slugger Trundle
48001.description: Unable to let go of being rejected from the major and minor leagues, Trundle has joined a little league team after saying he was thirteen years old on an admission form. Trundle is an eleven-foot-tall ice troll who enjoys allying with evil wizards and biting people to death. Practice has been… interesting.

48002.name: Junkyard Trundle
48002.description: Self-proclaimed king of the Wasteland's endless, irradiated junk heaps, Trundle saunters about his vast 'kingdom' flanked by a small army of sycophantic thugs. Any travelers discovered in his domain are subjected to painfully theatrical displays of grandeur—then beatings, then death.

48003.name: Traditional Trundle
48003.description: Created to capture the original feel of Trundle, one of our first fully reworked champions.

48004.name: Constable Trundle
48004.description: Constable Trundle's definition of keeping the peace translates to barking insults at jaywalkers, haphazardly placing cones in the street, and perhaps worst of all, plundering doughnuts from all the local bakeries. Needless to say, this behavior results in some very stern browbeatings from Piltover Yard.

48005.name: Worldbreaker Trundle
48005.description: The second of four titans prophesied to shatter the world, it has been foretold that Trundle will appear when the moon smothers the sun. In that darkness, he will rise in the north, blanketing all of creation with frost until the land is cold and silent.

48006.name: Dragonslayer Trundle

chromas.name: Dragonslayer Trundle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

48006.description: The king of a clan of giant trolls, Trundle is a revered dragonslayer. Blessed with the ability to command the raw power of mountain ice, he defends his realm from death and destruction. Over the ages, surviving trolls have looked up to him as their fearsome leader in this world torn asunder by dragon fire.

48012.name: Fright Night Trundle

chromas.name: Fright Night Trundle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

48012.description:
Teenage nightmare Trundle leaves everything distressed
But he won't lift a finger cleaning up his mess
Howling, growling, scowling, his chores he won't address,
For he has a team (or two) of Scareball players to impress!

chromas.name: Esports Fan Trundle

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

50001.name: Northern Front Swain
50001.description: They could have sent an army—twelve helicarriers boasting hypercoil cannons, pulse-jumping shocktroopers, and mechs to carve through the ice. But instead, a lone, grizzled veteran striding across the tundra. Some things are better left to the Grand General.

50002.name: Bilgewater Swain
50002.description: What is a ruthless dictator to do, when he tires of the burdens of empire? It's a pirate's life for Swain, m'hearties! Plying the seas outside Bilgewater, his flagship, the Beatrice prowls—searching for storm wracked and serpent-choked vessels, each carrying the promise of plunder and souls.

50003.name: Tyrant Swain
50003.description: Swain, though a mighty leader of men, was no match for the ancient demon slumbering beneath Noxus. As dark energies flowed through his once-human body, the new Grand General gave his first decree: “Kneel before me, or die.”

50004.name: Dragon Master Swain
50004.description: Seeking to turn the very essence of dragons against them, the great Dragonslayer Swain battled beneath the earth for the souls of ancient, long-dead wyrms. In his hubris, he was consumed by their power, emerging a corrupted thrall of the monsters he once swore to destroy.

50011.name: Hextech Swain
50011.description: The hextech artificer known as Jericho Swain is an almost legendary figure among Piltover's growing upper crust. Though he professes not to meddle in city affairs, he has been quietly integrating various hextech components into his own body… and with them, unparalleled access to the eyes and ears of thousands of artificial creatures.

50012.name: Crystal Rose Swain

chromas.name: Crystal Rose Swain

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Crystal Rose Swain

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

50012.description: Swain knows how important the alliances formed at the Festival of the Crystal Rose are… and how fragile. His determination to see the event go perfectly has gained him a connection with Zyra, the Rose's protector. With her help, he intends this to be the most successful festival ever—and that he will be celebrated as its architect.

50021.name: Winterblessed Swain

chromas.name: Winterblessed Swain

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Winterblessed Swain

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Season 2023 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Season 2023 event.

50021.description: The Hunter Swain made no acknowledgment of his fellow leaders and was the first to put himself forward. He desired the Aurora's blessings to better provide meat and pelts for his people. After making his case, he gave the smallest of bows to Polaris, who watched with a face as serene as moonlit ice. Satisfied, Swain stepped aside and waited for his gift.

50032.name: Chosen of the Wolf Swain

chromas.name: Chosen of the Wolf Swain

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Chosen of the Wolf Swain

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

50032.description: An usurper has joined us, dear Wolf. A man who grasps for power far beyond his reach. He fails to see his folly. How will he adapt to his new surroundings, now that he is no longer in control? We will be watching him closely… as we give chase.

50033.name: Prestige Chosen of the Wolf Swain
50033.description: An esteemed warrior and strategist, Swain brings his refined taste and unparalleled attire to both the hunt and the Gala. Menacing and dignified with a dash of disdain, his competition fears him when he hits the runway. Although he'll do whatever it takes to secure his victory, he lets onlookers know that fashion is what really matters.

51001.name: Resistance Caitlyn
51001.description: Caitlyn has never forgiven herself for letting Viktor's rise to power go unchecked for so long. Determined to fire the shot that ends the war for good, she has personally gunned down hundreds of Battlecast machines in her bloody search for absolution.

51002.name: Sheriff Caitlyn
51002.description: The Old West lies far outside the government's jurisdiction, leaving local peacekeepers to enforce whatever passes for justice on the high frontier. As lone sheriff of the town of Progress, Caitlyn has found that the arm of the law is roughly as long as the range of her rifle.

51003.name: Safari Caitlyn
51003.description: When she isn't attending galas or teaching seminars, Dr. Caitlyn Kiramman can be found exploring ancient ruins in search of historical artifacts. Armed with her trusty rifle, a wealth of esoteric knowledge, and an accident-prone Ezreal, she braves the most mysterious places in the world to bring long-dead civilizations and their secrets into the light.

51004.name: Arctic Warfare Caitlyn
51004.description: Very few snipers can cut it on the Arctic front. The cold is unforgiving, the winds are harsh, and any who dare brave the tundra find themselves at the mercy of Caitlyn, a sniper with deadly aim and a killer instinct.

51005.name: Officer Caitlyn
51005.description: Most people assume that Caitlyn is the "good cop" between her and Vi. What they don't know is that her sharp eyes, quick wit, and dedication make her one of the toughest officers on the force. She doesn't mind being underestimated, especially if it gives her the upper hand.

51006.name: Headhunter Caitlyn
51006.description: Caitlyn's arsenal of alien weaponry isn't meant to level the playing field. It's to ensure that every hunt, every target, and every shot she takes goes exactly the way she wants it to.

51010.name: Lunar Wraith Caitlyn

chromas.name: Lunar Wraith Caitlyn

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

51010.description: A malignant spirit said to appear during Lunar Revel, Caitlyn is known to meddle in the affairs of gods and mortals alike. Her attention has been catastrophic to all who draw it, and even seeing her is considered an ill omen.

51011.name: Pulsefire Caitlyn

chromas.name: Pulsefire Caitlyn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

51011.description: A legendary chrono-law enforcer feared in every age, Caitlyn's mission is to protect the fragile enigma that is time. Those who dare threaten its integrity inevitably find themselves firmly locked in the sights of her temporal plasma blaster.

51013.name: Pool Party Caitlyn

chromas.name: Pool Party Caitlyn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

51013.description: For Caitlyn, nothing says a perfect summer's day like lounging at a luxurious poolside, eating shaved ice and drinking tropical libations. And shooting people. She really loves shooting people.

51019.name: Arcade Caitlyn
51019.description: Acclaimed hero of the “Sniper Cop” rail shooter series, Caitlyn enforced the laws of Arcadia prior to the Battle Boss uprising. She brings her sharp eye and eager trigger finger to the fight to save her world, only stopping long enough to flick her gun off-screen for a reload.

51020.name: Prestige Arcade Caitlyn
51020.description: Appearing most recently in “Sniper Cop 7” as a golden-clad secret character, Caitlyn's popularity has finally transcended games as a medium.

51022.name: Battle Academia Caitlyn

chromas.name: Battle Academia Caitlyn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

51022.description: A feared and respected second year, head of the Luminary Club, and class president of Labrys God-Weapon Academy. Caitlyn enrolled herself in the famously troubled school specifically to whip the delinquents there into prime fighting shape, hoping to one day become the greatest battlefield general in history. With her perfect record, she's not too far off.

51029.name: Prestige Arcade Caitlyn (2022)
51029.description: Appearing most recently in “Sniper Cop 7” as a golden-clad secret character, Caitlyn's popularity has finally transcended games as a medium.

51030.name: Snow Moon Caitlyn

chromas.name: Snow Moon Caitlyn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

51030.description: A tool of chilling acuity, Caitlyn is the Snow Moon's most elite sniper. It was her craving for a calculating nature, stripped of the moorings of sympathy, that drew her to serve. There was once warmth in her heart; in dreams, she sees a figure, wild and untamed, in a world not meant for her.

51039.name: Heartthrob Caitlyn

chromas.name: Heartthrob Caitlyn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

51039.description: I hate the way you walk around, like you're Princess Caitlyn of the mall, and I'm just some gutter rat. I hate the way you look at me when there's no one else around, but wouldn't be caught dead with me in town. Maybe our whole thing was just a huge mistake. So if you want me to go, I'm gone. But ask, and I will stay. -Vi

51048.name: DRX Caitlyn

chromas.name: DRX Caitlyn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during DRX World Championship showcase.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during DRX World Championship showcase.

51048.description: Honoring Deft's winning performance as Caitlyn during the 2022 World Championship.

51050.name: Arcane Commander Caitlyn

chromas.name: Arcane Commander Caitlyn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive drop from The Sanctum.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive drop from The Sanctum.

51050.description: Driven by a newfound desire for revenge, Caitlyn's principles have crumbled, leaving no room for hope or peace as tensions with Zaun continue to escalate. Her single-minded focus is on bringing Jinx to justice. But beneath the grief and guilt, doubt begins to creep in: is the cost of vengeance truly worth it?

51051.name: Prestige Arcane Commander Caitlyn

chromas.name: Prestige Arcane Commander Caitlyn

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Arcane event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Arcane event.

51051.description: As scion of the Kiramman family, Caitlyn knows how to command respect from the moment she enters a room—not only with her sharp appearance, but her even-sharper gaze as well. Having climbed the ranks to lead the city's enforcers, she makes an even stronger asset to the future of Piltover.

53002.name: Goalkeeper Blitzcrank
53002.description: One of the all time greatest keepers for Chaos FC, Blitzcrank has finally taken their place in the Sports Hall of Fame. Their image rests proudly with the likes of Volleyball Dragon, Women's Tennis Scuttle Crab, and Badminton Baron Nashor.

53003.name: Boom Boom Blitzcrank
53003.description: Their fists are named “boom” and “boom,” proving that robots are a perfect facsimile of human life.

53004.name: Piltover Customs Blitzcrank
53004.description: Your robot's legs were busted, so we replaced them with a vintage '32 hot rod, and eight-cylinder external mounted coal engine. Plus we painted flames on his fists. The flames cost extra.

53006.name: iBlitzcrank
53006.description: Built as household assistance automata, thousands of iBlitzcranks were corrupted by Program during a routine software update. With their human owners oblivious to this fact, they continue to help, waiting patiently for the time their new command lines are initiated.

53007.name: Riot Blitzcrank
53007.description: A Riot Games skin obtained by either meeting a Rioter or attending an official Riot event in 2013.

53011.name: Battle Boss Blitzcrank
53011.description: A boss hailing from a popular science fiction shooter, Blitzcrank is well known in the gaming community for cheap mechanics, powerful attacks, and a massive health pool. Veigar fittingly made them the gatekeeper of his personal fortress, because Veigar hates fun.

53020.name: Lancer Rogue Blitzcrank
53020.description: An ancient sentinel corrupted by mysterious black lightning, Rogue Lancer Blitzcrank mercilessly crushes provincial armies, destroying entire castles with kings still on their thrones. What caused its rampage is still uncertain, but for now it seems to be following its dread protocol to the letter.

53021.name: Lancer Paragon Blitzcrank
53021.description: A silent protector of the masses, the artificial paladin Blitzcrank was aroused from the earth by a bolt of mysterious white lighting. It now serves all honorable subjects, defending with true and calculated precision.

53022.name: Witch's Brew Blitzcrank

chromas.name: Witch's Brew Blitzcrank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

53022.description: Once nothing but a simple cauldron, Blitzcrank was enchanted, brought to life in order to assist Miss Fortune in her beguiling bewitchments.

53029.name: Space Groove Blitz & Crank

chromas.name: Space Groove Blitz & Crank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Space Groove Blitz & Crank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Space Groove event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Space Groove event.

53029.description: Blitz and Crank are Cat Planet's fiercest warriors, and work together seamlessly (mostly) to pilot their mech, Blitzcrank. While Crank believes that he can overcome his lack of rhythm with the help of his exuberant copilot, Blitz is… well… he's busy dancing to his own beat. Together they plan to take over Dog Planet and claim its sunbeams for themselves.

53036.name: Victorious Blitzcrank

chromas.name: Victorious Blitzcrank

descriptions.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who reached Platinum rank in Solo/Duo ranked queue

chromas.description: This Chroma was awarded to players who reached Platinum rank in Solo/Duo ranked queue

53047.name: Zenith Games Blitzcrank

chromas.name: Zenith Games Blitzcrank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

53047.description: Originally a bomb defusal robot, Blitzcrank was made a referee because of their ability to make split-second adjustments to stay ahead of the prodigious athletes. Only later did everyone realize that the bot's background made them unusually effective in defusing the intense... disagreements that often arise.

53056.name: Beezcrank

chromas.name: Beezcrank

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

53056.description: Beezcrank has a reputation for getting his bee-infantry into sticky situations. Probably because of that giant honey-comb mech-arm.

54001.name: Shamrock Malphite
54001.description: Malphite is a twenty-ton rock man who used to be part of an even larger rock that was destroyed, leaving him orphaned on a distinctly un-rocklike plane of existence. The guy could use a little luck.

54002.name: Coral Reef Malphite
54002.description: “When I was young, I used to watch our ships sail back to port—but of late can't bring myself to look. For every vessel that docks, another runs aground of coral that was not there before. It's as though even the seabed has turned against us, slowly moving toward some unfathomable end.”

54004.name: Obsidian Malphite
54004.description: As great mountains were ripped from their foundations during the rise of the Ashen Lord, from deep beneath them climbed strange, obsidian creatures, freed for the first time after thousands of years. They seem intent on stopping the Infernals, and are uniquely suited to defeating them.

54006.name: Mecha Malphite
54006.description: Designated M-2, the “Mecha Malphite” unit is a massive, bipedal fortress capable of turning into a planetary drill—making it the ultimate defensive option when faced with new and powerful kaiju. A single punch from its gauntlets can blow holes through thick titanium sheeting, and such attacks have felled countless monsters.

54007.name: Ironside Malphite
54007.description: There are two kinds of mercenaries in the game today: the first being your rank-and-file sellsword, barely worth the stink of grog on his breath. The second is a nigh-indestructible golem, twenty feet tall, and made from the hull of a legendary gunship. Choose wisely.

54016.name: Odyssey Malphite

chromas.name: Odyssey Malphite

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

54016.description: Malphite was once the pit boss of a deep space mining operation, until Jinx cracked the asteroid in half and got them both fired. His enduring loyalty to someone who is very obviously a psychopath has landed him in all kinds of danger across the galaxy, but he honestly doesn't seem to mind.

54023.name: Dark Star Malphite
54023.description: The remnants of a once lush and enormous exo-planet, the Dark Star consumed and reformed the broken cluster of planetary debris into a twisted consciousness, ever pulling others into its orbit, and unleashing oblivion upon all who cross its path.

54024.name: Prestige Dark Star Malphite
54024.description: Gilded by the Dark Star's touch and empowered through its radiance, Malphite barrels across space, demolishing entire systems and consuming the broken remnants into his immense and twisted form.

54025.name: FPX Malphite

chromas.name: FPX Malphite

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

54025.description: Honoring Doinb's winning performance as Malphite during the 2019 World Championship.

54027.name: Old God Malphite

chromas.name: Old God Malphite

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Old God Malphite

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Coven event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Coven event.

54027.description: Appearing to mortals as a Jet-Black Ibex, Malphite was an Old God of the mountain slain by the Eclipse order and cast down onto the rocks below. Death did not claim him, but the mountain did—and now he rises in its hulking earthen form, the land itself twisted with hatred and consumed by new and terrible hungers.

54037.name: Lunar Guardian Malphite

chromas.name: Lunar Guardian Malphite

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Lunar Guardian Malphite

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Lunar Revel event.

54037.description: Malphite was one of three guardians of the Yun Tal Empire, a demi-god of crag and magma, his brothers-in-arms a serpent of water and a spirit of nature. Their friendship ended in an instant, when one guardian's infinitesimal betrayal led to the death of another. Now, Malphite stands alone with unwavering loyalty, desperate to restore his nation's former glory, no matter the cost of lives.

54048.name: Pool Party Malphite

chromas.name: Pool Party Malphite

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

54048.description: He's coarse, he's rough, he's irritating, and he gets EVERYWHERE.

55002.name: Red Card Katarina
55002.description: Is that a regulation uniform? No. Should a referee be holding a large dagger in the middle of a sports game? No. Are you going to argue with a woman in a non-regulation uniform holding a large dagger in the middle of a sports game? I think we both know the answer to that.

55003.name: Bilgewater Katarina
55003.description: To outsiders, the politics of Bilgewater seem a mean mess of villainous scum and dishonorable thieves. But woven throughout are complex loyalties, solemn codes of honor, and a very specific (if bloody) way of doing things. Cutting through it all is Katarina, a master of the blade. She silences the right tongues at all the right moments… for the right price.

55004.name: Kitty Cat Katarina
55004.description: There are times when Katarina deeply questions the parameters of her assassination missions. This is, somehow, not one of those times.

55007.name: Slay Belle Katarina
55007.description: Donning a mishmash of Snowdown fashions to throw targets off her scent, Katarina uses the holidays as a cover for high profile assassinations. If you hear the sound of jingle bells... run.

55008.name: Warring Kingdoms Katarina

chromas.name: Warring Kingdoms Katarina

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

55008.description: In open defiance of her clan, Katarina has left behind the life of a princess to hunt the greatest heroes of the Warring Kingdoms. Striking under shadow of night, she is slowly cutting her way through her foes… one general at a time.

55009.name: PROJECT: Katarina
55009.description: Once an ambitious lieutenant in the G/NETIC rebellion, Katarina returned to the Command Line after a confrontation with Ashe herself. Her hyper edge daggers now serve PROJECT once more, but those rebels who knew her still hold out hope that she fights for them from the inside.

55010.name: Death Sworn Katarina
55010.description: To fully swear oneself to Death's service, a mortal must be prepared to sacrifice the living. A skilled assassin in life, Katarina pledged her sinister blades willingly, and was granted spectral abilities allowing her to pass in and out of the underworld with ease.

55012.name: Battle Academia Katarina

chromas.name: Battle Academia Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.name: Battle Academia Katarina

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Trials event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Trials event.

55012.description: Katarina is a rough-edged loner who stays far away from the politics of Durandal Academy. A 2nd year student with a chip on her shoulder, she is also a top member of the Assassin Club—the only club on campus allowed to kill opponents in school-sanctioned duels. Few other students ever dare approach her.

55021.name: Blood Moon Katarina

chromas.name: Blood Moon Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

55021.description: An honored priestess of the Blood Moon cult, merged with the flesh of her demon as all priestesses are fated to be. Yet the descent of the Blood Moon has changed the nature of demons and humankind, and Katarina has begun her ascent into a newer, darker form.

55029.name: Battle Queen Katarina

chromas.name: Battle Queen Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Battle Queen Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Battle Queens event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Battle Queens event.

55029.description: Katarina won the Schemean crest with a ruthless performance in her queendom's battle pits. For Schema to break free of its humble alliances and become the region's rightful leader, it will take a similarly commanding performance in the Coronation—and Katarina has never been more prepared to cement her fearsome status as the rightful queen of queens.

55037.name: High Noon Katarina

chromas.name: High Noon Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: High Noon Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

55037.description: “My people got swindled. I aim to collect what we're owed,” the Outsider says, pinning her dagger in a wanted poster of the Mechanical Devil. Her eyes burn like stoked coal as she fixes each dusty traveler in her gaze, “And I hear y'all plan on jumpin' the Sulfur Rail, Harbingers. If you're gonna take this devil down, I want in.”

55047.name: Faerie Court Katarina

chromas.name: Faerie Court Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Faerie Court Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Faerie Court event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Faerie Court event.

55047.description: Though Katarina is an official diplomatic envoy hailing from the Unseelie Court of Truth and Shadow, you wouldn't know it from all the side-eyed glances and disapproving frowns she receives from closed-minded courtiers. No matter: with daggers in hand and a mystery afoot, Katarina has her own agenda.

55048.name: Prestige Faerie Court Katarina
55048.description: Don't let the butterflies fool you: otherworldly elegance may be Katarina's game, but that gala-ready look is sharper than her knives. Fashion is a metamorphosis, after all. Try to keep up.

55059.name: Chosen of the Wolf Katarina

chromas.name: Chosen of the Wolf Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

55059.description: An assassin was welcomed into our realm, dear Wolf. Though she moves in shadow, she strikes fear in the hearts of her foes. That caught your attention, didn't it? Her speed. Her violence. Her conviction. A welcome addition to the Eternal Chase.

55060.name: Prestige Masque of the Black Rose Katarina

chromas.name: Prestige Masque of the Black Rose Katarina

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Welcome to Noxus: Act 1 Pass.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Welcome to Noxus: Act 1 Pass.

55060.description: Your mission is confirmed. Strike at the Silken Danse. The eighth night after the new moon, at the manor of House Kythera. Masquerade ball—dress in the attire of Noxian noblesse. Enclosed is an invitation and portrait of the mark. Method is yours to decide. Burn this message and hone your steel. (The letter is unsigned.)

56001.name: Frozen Terror Nocturne
56001.description: Somewhere, hidden beneath the enormous ice caps, lurks a demon fueled by the terror of those foolish enough to enter his domain.

56004.name: Haunting Nocturne
56004.description: Haunting Nocturne would be a lot less haunting without those huge knife arms.

56005.name: Eternum Nocturne
56005.description: Your worst nightmare, embodied in the form of organic metal—it lingers, watching and waiting for the right moment to shroud all of existence in eternal darkness.

56006.name: Cursed Revenant Nocturne
56006.description: In her dreams, the queen was approached by a great shadow whispering of power and infamy beyond the grasp of mortals. Upon the shadow's third visit, she released it into the waking world—and sure enough, it would come to keep its terrible promises.

56007.name: Old God Nocturne

chromas.name: Old God Nocturne

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

56007.description: The great corpses of the Old Gods fed the land, and in time even the Elderwood would come to grow over their putrid rot–hiding it, perhaps, for a time. But the Gods never truly died and, with the resurgence of the Coven, one has risen again–Nocturne, the Eternal Nightmare.

56016.name: Hextech Nocturne
56016.description: Not every part of the Hextech renaissance led to bright innovations. A clandestine experiment to fuse Hextech with demonic energies wrought a living nightmare, a predator rumored to stalk the streets and back alleyways of the city. Authorities report that any such creation would have been terminated along with any such project, and that any missing persons reports are, of course, completely unrelated.

56017.name: Broken Covenant Nocturne

chromas.name: Broken Covenant Nocturne

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

56017.description: As the oldest member of the Aspirants, Nocturne is content to lead from the shadows, having long ago exchanged their physical form for pure Aspira. Within the catacombs, they jealously guard the vast well of Aspira the congregation has filled over the centuries, toiling away at the unholy weapon that will destroy the Neverghaast once and for all.

56026.name: Empyrean Nocturne

chromas.name: Empyrean Nocturne

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Empyrean Nocturne

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Empyrean event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Empyrean event.

56026.description: A nightmarish dimensional parasite, Nocturne was drawn to the Foreglow and—as it burrowed its way to the power's raw form—inadvertently created the first dimensional collapse and the first Empyrean, Pyke. With the Foreglow corrupting its original appearance, Nocturne seeks to experiment further with the Foreglow and find new ways to feed its hunger.

57001.name: Charred Maokai
57001.description: Once a steward of the gentle treefolk, Maokai was consumed along with his people when the Infernals ravaged the world. Now, brimming with rage, he seeks only to spread his anger and misery to anything that crosses his path.

57003.name: Festive Maokai
57003.description: Big, jolly, and possessed by a literal holiday spirit, the living fir tree known as Maokai loves nothing more than to unwrap the presents tucked under him every year. He would prefer to do this away from the fire.

57004.name: Haunted Maokai
57004.description: Few locals dare to trick-or-treat past the forest just outside of town. Too many have vanished within that dreary woodland, where one feels the weight of unseen eyes, and even the trees are driven by a terrible hunger…

57005.name: Goalkeeper Maokai
57005.description: Debuting in the 2014 Soccer Cup, much of Maokai's career has rested on the Order United goalposts growing out of his back. As Maokai is a giant tree, you have to be pretty good to score on him.

57006.name: Meowkai
57006.description: Maokai has, at long last, embraced his role as a giant, haunted scratching post.

57007.name: Victorious Maokai
57007.description: Victorious Maokai was awarded to players who reached Gold or higher in the 2016 season. Victorious Maokai lays down his roots fashionably with vines of golden leaves, and a rich blue and gold robe.

57016.name: Worldbreaker Maokai

chromas.name: Worldbreaker Maokai

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

57016.description: An immense tree-like golem, Maokai grew from the very roots of the world, charred though they were by the last annihilation. Burdened to revive the world after every destructive cycle, he wanders for all eternity, reseeding the earth with his magical saplings, making way for the renewal of life…  only for it to be undone once more.

57024.name: Astronaut Maokai

chromas.name: Astronaut Maokai

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

57024.description: The first tree to grow on planet M33P, Maokai gained sentience due to the latent power of the meeps that took up residence in his trunk. He now fosters life on this new home of his, collecting and caring for young meeps that could use a helping hand (or branch).

57033.name: DRX Maokai

chromas.name: DRX Maokai

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during DRX World Championship showcase.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during DRX World Championship showcase.

57033.description: Honoring Juhan's winning performance as Maokai during the 2022 World Championship.

58003.name: Bloodfury Renekton
58003.description: This blood-crazed killing machine scours the battlefield to sate the Bloodstone. The more he slays, the more he fuels his powers. This in turn feeds his frenzy, creating a never ending cycle of spilt viscera and gore.

58005.name: Scorched Earth Renekton
58005.description: What is an Infernal but the screams beckoning from the darkest corners of mortal imagination? For centuries they were considered nothing more than myth—and yet, now, monstrosities such as Renekton roam freely, punishing us all for the last fleeting gasp of our own hubris.

58006.name: Pool Party Renekton
58006.description: Lifeguard on duty! Seriously though, be careful—you don't want CPR from a nine foot tall crocodile man.

58007.name: Prehistoric Renekton
58007.description: A rare intelligent beast, Renekton is an erudite speaker and skilled wielder of the crescent blade. He's also six stories tall and not particularly friendly. Hunters are advised to make their final arrangements before engaging.

58008.name: SKT T1 Renekton
58008.description: Honoring MaRin's winning performance as Renekton during the 2015 World Championship.

58009.name: Renektoy
58009.description: First produced in 1996, Renektoy quickly and unexpectedly became the must-have gift of the season. Shortages and heightened demand led to online scalping, parents fist fighting in store aisles, and a small number of what police later described as “mall stampedes.”

58017.name: Hextech Renekton
58017.description: As is so often the way, artificers of the Hextech Renaissance pushed too far and too fast into their new science, without fully considering the possible consequences. Renekton—a half-mad monster of flesh and metal—is the result of that shortsightedness.

58018.name: Blackfrost Renekton

chromas.name: Blackfrost Renekton

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

58018.description: In life, Renekton stood against the tyranny of the Ice Witch, fighting an inevitable, endless winter until his last breath. In death, the virtuous warrior was cursed with resurrection—brought back to life as a vicious warmonger cased in rock and ice. Now a general leading the onslaught of the Black Frost army, Renekton loyally serves the very queen he once thought to destroy.

58026.name: PROJECT: Renekton

chromas.name: PROJECT: Renekton

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: PROJECT: Renekton

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 PROJECT event.

58026.description: A hybridized warrior taking inspiration from extinct fauna, Renekton is the perfected version of PROJECT's crossbreed superweapon project. Released to aid the City in its fight against the Program virus, Renekton's seemingly endless rage is useful for now… though his belief that he can “see beyond the soul” is increasingly disconcerting.

58033.name: Dawnbringer Renekton

chromas.name: Dawnbringer Renekton

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

58033.description: In the aftermath of chaos slaying order, two brothers were born: the embodiments of cause, Renekton, and effect, Nasus. As executioner for the Dawnbringers, Renekton has become more frenzied from battling his kin, but he still holds to his view that everything must have a purpose. For what function does chaos serve, if not to cause more chaos?

59001.name: Commando Jarvan IV
59001.description: Yes, those are guns strapped to Jarvan's arms and legs. No, he can't shoot them.

59002.name: Dragonslayer Jarvan IV
59002.description: All are accepted into the ranks of the dragonslayers, from the lowliest peasant to the mightiest king, for dragons would devour all equally. Jarvan IV willingly gave up the throne to join his doomed countrymen and stand against the fury of monsters reborn.

59004.name: Victorious Jarvan IV
59004.description: Victorious Jarvan IV was awarded to players who reached Gold or higher in the 2011 season. As the first Victorious skin ever released, Jarvan shines in silver armor with a flashy gold trim.

59005.name: Warring Kingdoms Jarvan IV

chromas.name: Warring Kingdoms Jarvan IV

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2019 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2019 Lunar Revel event.

59005.description: A fabled warrior of peerless might, Jarvan IV strides across the Warring Kingdoms seeking only the worthiest opponents. All others careless enough to face him are crushed without mercy, the earth erupting beneath his immeasurable strength.

59006.name: Fnatic Jarvan IV
59006.description: Honoring Cyanide's winning performance as Jarvan IV during the 2011 World Championship.

59007.name: Dark Star Jarvan IV

chromas.name: Dark Star Jarvan IV

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Galaxies event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Galaxies event.

59007.description: A mortal emperor unbound by the destruction of his world, Jarvan's essence has since been reforged by the ageless energies of deep space. His humanity and his people now lost forever, he stands ready to welcome the Dark Star incursion, in the final subjugation of all existence.

59008.name: SSG Jarvan IV
59008.description: Honoring Ambition's winning performance as Jarvan IV during the 2017 World Championship.

59009.name: Hextech Jarvan IV
59009.description: The Hextech Renaissance appealed not only to those with backgrounds in science, but also to those looking for an escape from their day-to-day lives. For the young Prince Jarvan, it presented the chance to enhance his martial skill—with technology that would have never been accepted within his father's kingdom.

59011.name: Pool Party Jarvan IV

chromas.name: Pool Party Jarvan IV

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

59011.description: For Jarvan, there's nothing more relaxing than hanging out at the beach. No kingdoms to run, no thrones to sit on (save for his favorite beach chair), just the sound of the waves and, if he listens closely, the faint whistle of a volleyball being spiked directly at him...

59021.name: Lunar Beast Jarvan IV

chromas.name: Lunar Beast Jarvan IV

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

59021.description: Jarvan IV's stubborn refusal to join Ox Clan only relented to his father's stubborn insistence. Though he tries his best to shirk the celebrity status that comes with the role, Jarvan comes from a long line of philanthropists, and has found himself caught up in the thrill of bringing businesslike efficiency to the biggest community event of the year.
