descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

82032.description: Few meet the Mechanical Devil and live to tell the tale. They describe a behemoth: all steel and gears, fueled by hellfire and fierce enough to scare a man's soul from his skin. He is the King of the Sulfur Rail, reigning over the train to Hell from a throne of stolen gold and infernal iron. Eternal, and unassailable.

82042.name: Ashen Graveknight Mordekaiser
82042.description: A warlock said to rule over the dead, who for reasons unknown fought to erase magic from the world. Perhaps Mordekaiser believed his powers would be spared, or perhaps the old knight planned to betray his fellows and reign over their darkened kingdoms. It matters little now, as he awaits the end of death itself.

82044.name: Old God Mordekaiser

chromas.name: Old God Mordekaiser

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Old God Mordekaiser

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2023 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2023 event.

82044.description: Once known as the Horned King, Old God Mordekaiser turned that which was once dead to his cause, using their shambling forms to topple kingdoms and claim their lands as his own. Before he was slain by the Eclipse Knights, he swore that when he returned to this world, they would all bend to his will and take to the frontlines of his undead army.

82054.name: Sahn-Uzal Mordekaiser

skinFeaturePreviewData.description: Start of Game Spawn in Ceremony

82054.description: Before the Immortal Bastion was built and the first Nox'toraa raised, the land that would become Noxus was ruled by the most powerful warlord Runeterra has ever known—Sahn-Uzal the Demonsbane, Unconquered King, Tyrant of the Great Grass Ocean. He united the Noxii tribes with his might, assured he would one day join the gods in the Hall of Bones…

83001.name: Undertaker Yorick
83001.description: The Undertaker is a wretched creature, cursed to shoulder every secret his city has buried. These old, unhappy things tear constantly at his mind, which is itself infected by his queen's unending ambition.

83002.name: Pentakill Yorick
83002.description: Yorick was resurrected with the undying soul of heavy metal inside him for the singular purpose of joining PENTAKILL and melting faces with his bass guitar. He can also summon an army of roadie ghouls, a handy trick for any seasoned stage performer.

83003.name: Arclight Yorick
83003.description: The once-great king Yorick, given the gifts of power and immortality in an age long past, left his mighty kingdom to enforce the will of the divine. Hundreds of years later he returned, his lands naught but dust and ruins, and in his sorrow was consumed by madness.

83004.name: Meowrick

chromas.name: Meowrick

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

83004.description: A cat fancier hailing from the Forsaken Aisles of a Pets Supreme Superstore, Yorick does not have any unresolved issues involving or related to cats. Yorick is a perfectly normal gentleman dressed as a cat, surrounded by cats, who can call upon the esoteric powers of a giant, floating cat. You know, normal gentleman stuff.

83012.name: Resistance Yorick

chromas.name: Resistance Yorick

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

83012.description: With the rise of the Battlecast armies, Yorick found to his horror that the living minds Viktor fused to his machines bound the souls of his victims to their machine bodies. Harnessing his ability to command the dead, Yorick now raises destroyed and defeated Battlecast husks in an attempt to free all these souls from their machine prisons.

83021.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Yorick

chromas.name: Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Yorick

83021.description: All hail, Yorick, the Four-String Fanatic! He bestrides the realms of the living and the dead, and knows the fate that comes to all mortal things. It pays to beware the honorable man...

83030.description: The grove he called home burnt to ashes before his very eyes. While another retreated into solitude, Yorick allowed the rage to consume him. The flowers and trees that bloom in the Spirit of Ruin's wake are haunting, the gardeners that tend to them howling creatures of the night.

83040.name: Dark Star Yorick

83040.description: A somber titan from a long-dead galaxy, Yorick plants a garden of nothingness wherever he roams. He memorializes existence in silence, cultivating a grave in the negative space where matter once bloomed.

83050.name: High Noon Yorick

chromas.name: High Noon Yorick

83050.description: Father Yorick can still feel the whisper of his lost love's stifled breath against his neck. He can't forget the blood on her veil, nor the shot that stole her away, ringing in the vault of the church. But fleeing into the heatsick West ain't enough to outrun her ghost. He shoulders her coffin and ambles onward, warm revolvers dancing in his nightmares.

84001.name: Stinger Akali
84001.description: The Order of the Great Sparrow Bee follows a brutal, time-honored training regimen, teaching students to sting with the ferocity and ceaselessness of a hornet. Akali is their greatest champion, and she intends to take the art to even greater heights.

84002.name: Infernal Akali
84002.description: A djinn summoned from the world below, the Infernal known as Akali will burn her patron's enemies to cinders… though the cost for such service is always dire.

84003.name: All-star Akali
84003.description: A legendary all-star for Chaos FC, Akali was known for her aggressive style on the pitch. These days, she spends most of her time mentoring children and doing commercials for shoes.

chromas.name: Nurse Akali

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

84005.name: Blood Moon Akali
84005.description: Priestesses of the Blood Moon walk their own path, traveling far from the cult to pursue the whispers of their demons. A meditative figure living deep in the snow-dusted wood, Akali was the first woman to embrace her inner darkness, and speak directly with the Blood Moon itself.

84006.name: Silverfang Akali
84006.description: Former second-in-command of an honorable clan of assassins, Akali has broken from their ranks to find her own path. She plies her trade in the darkest corners of the world's largest metropolis, awaiting the day when she can establish a clan of her own.

84007.name: Headhunter Akali
84007.description: Her weapons flaring with alien energy, Akali hunts only the worthy in a dangerous game of life and death. Striking from anywhere at any moment, no living thing can escape her trophy wall.

84008.name: Sashimi Akali
84008.description: She's the fish ninja with speed on her side, the silent slicer, the death strike of deliciousness. Drop your guard and she'll assassinate your palate. It's your favorite and mine, Akali!

84009.name: K/DA Akali
84009.description: Akali's street aesthetic and hard-hitting lyrics inspired a dedicated fandom. She wields a microphone or kama as a hip-hop ninja, revolutionizing the stale scene with her raw talents.

84013.name: Prestige K/DA Akali
84013.description: K/DA Akali is on fire right now, spitting rap solos at the Pop Music Awards—and her prestigious costume is exactly what you'd expect from the new golden child of pop.

84014.name: PROJECT: Akali

84014.description: A cutting-edge PROJECT subject who somehow escaped the City's boundaries, Akali brings dire warnings of an untested superweapon to those living in the wasteland beyond. With time running out and no other options, these outcasts join her in an attempt to take the mega-corporation down… suspicious that their newfound ally might in fact be a double agent.

84015.description: After the worldwide success of K/DA, Akali made it her mission to recruit accomplished and up-and-coming artists to form a new supergroup: True Damage. Never before has a crew been comprised of such diverse talent, ranging from natural lyricists to renowned producers to legendary vocalists—all ready to disrupt the music industry.

84032.name: K/DA ALL OUT Akali

84032.description: Fresh off her success with True Damage, Akali hits the stage full-throttle with her bold edge and fresh new direction. She spits fire with a mic in hand and pushes the band to the bleeding edge, because that's what the baddest do.

84050.name: Crime City Nightmare Akali

chromas.name: Crime City Nightmare Akali

84050.description: A loyal enforcer for the Graves family, Akali took the same deal everyone else did when the Mysterious Gentleman came calling. The power changed her, twisted her into something that hears a siren song echoing from beyond the veil of reality. Now she acts in ruthless, horrific violence, seeking an inscrutable 'balance' even she cannot name.

84060.name: Prestige K/DA Akali (2022)
84060.description: K/DA Akali is on fire right now, spitting rap solos at the Pop Music Awards—and her prestigious costume is exactly what you'd expect from the new golden child of pop.

84061.description: On-again off-again co-captain of a new generation of Star Guardians, Akali's skill in battle is shadowed by her growing realization that the Oath she swore has condemned her to die. Though she fights for the light with all her heart, she finds that darkness is just as powerful... perhaps, even more so...

84070.description: They came to Akali encircling from the tree canopy at an impossible speed, their taunts leading her deeper still into the Elderwood until at last she was lost. Then a voice whispered the choice right into her ear: die in these woods alone or emerge in their charge. And so she walked out of the woods... straight into the arms of the Coven.

84071.name: Prestige Coven Akali
84071.description: Arriving clad in a bold and sporty body suit, Akali's gala attire has us all spellbound. Subversive and on the cutting edge of fashion, she's fierce and redefines how we think of the wicked witch of the woods.

84082.name: Empyrean Akali

chromas.name: Empyrean Akali

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

84082.description: Before her realm's destruction, Akali was rotting away in prison for a failed assassination attempt on a despotic warlord. Now on her own as an Empyrean, she views her newfound freedom as a sign to stop the evil she couldn't before. The realms need a defender, and Akali is determined to fight for them as long as she can.

85004.name: Kennen M.D.

chromas.name: Kennen M.D.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

85004.description: Why run with scissors when you can throw scalpels?

85005.name: Arctic Ops Kennen
85005.description: High Command's public stance towards ninjas are joking-to-nonexistent, as this is a war of modern weapons, not medieval flights of fancy. Privately, they deploy Kennen to hot zones in the deep Arctic, relying on his finely honed ninjitsu and deadly precision.

85006.name: Blood Moon Kennen
85006.description: A kingslaying demon summoned on the night of the Blood Moon, Kennen's purpose is to depose those in power and eliminate every member of their line. He is ruthless in this task, tearing across heavily armed fortress cities in the blink of an eye.

85007.name: Super Kennen
85007.description: Coming to a store near you: the new Super Kennen action figure! At 6″ tall, the new Super Kennen is fully articulated, with dazzling lightning bolt action! Add this fitting tribute to New Valoran's bravest hero to your collection today!

85008.name: Infernal Kennen

chromas.name: Infernal Kennen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

85008.description: A playful spirit of fire, Kennen is not a malevolent being, but can't help igniting his surroundings while zipping about. His lightning quick movements wreak havoc upon any village unfortunate enough to entice the impish spirit to visit.

85023.name: DWG Kennen

chromas.name: DWG Kennen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2021.

85023.description: Honoring Nuguri's winning performance as Kennen during the 2020 World Championship.

85025.name: Astronaut Kennen

chromas.name: Astronaut Kennen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

85025.description: A master mechanic and genius in meep technology, Lieutenant Kennen always keeps the ship balanced. Although he's perpetually bothered by being second in command to Fizz, he never fails to design a plan to protect his team. His quick thinking and deadly precision are enough to keep any threats to planet M33P at bay.

86003.name: Commando Garen
86003.description: Most commandos excel at amphibious attacks and military paragliding. This one spins very fast toward things while holding a giant sword. It's basically the same.

86004.name: Dreadknight Garen
86004.description: Once a valiant hero, Dreadknight Garen fell to the promise of power great enough to save his land. Now, twisted by the corrupting magic of his Master, he commands the frozen legions in their march upon the living. Only desolation remains in his wake.

86005.name: Rugged Garen
86005.description: Also known as “Handsome Garen,” this wandering warrior and extremely original NPC was created by Braum for his Riftquest game. Garen eventually adopted the character as his own, liking the fantasy of himself, but rugged.

86006.name: Steel Legion Garen
86006.description: Garen is a steam-powered knight serving at the head of the Steel Legion's vanguard, feared by his enemies and respected by his allies in equal measure. His blade is one of a kind: a thaumaturgical innovation of science and magic, overflowing with sparking plasma.

86010.name: Rogue Admiral Garen
86010.description: A faded bounty poster from the Demacian naval authorities notes that Admiral Garen is a deadly adversary, and should be engaged with caution, lest he cut off your head and send it back to the capital. Each year, the Demacian naval authorities receive a disconcerting number of human heads.

86011.name: Warring Kingdoms Garen

chromas.name: Warring Kingdoms Garen

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

86011.description: Brave guardian of Azir's ancient fortress, Garen is a mighty warrior who charges fearlessly into even the most hopeless battles. He fights for the glory of his ruler and the safety of his people, a powerful, if headstrong, force for justice.

86013.name: God-King Garen
86013.description: God-King Garen stands as the last scion of an ancient divinity, and the final bulwark against the end of all civilization. He rules the vast kingdom of Demacia with an iron fist, jealously protecting his people as a self-styled messiah, while rooting out and destroying all who would oppose him.

86014.name: Demacia Vice Garen

chromas.name: Demacia Vice Garen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: Demacia Vice Garen

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Demacia Vice event.

86014.description: As chrome eagles cry and steel panthers growl, lightning hot justice is delivered nightly by Detective Garen Stryker on the neon-drenched streets. A black belt in Ionian martial arts, this katana wielding cop pushes it to the limit with every case... for Demacia!

86022.name: Mecha Kingdoms Garen
86022.description: Once a ruthless warlord, Garen led his armies to victory after victory, laying the foundations for the Vercentia Kingdom. When the leviathans appeared out of nowhere, he opted to put aside his dream of uniting all the Great Kingdoms under his rule, and instead to march his newly-fashioned Avalon alongside his former enemies for the sake of humanity.

86023.name: Prestige Mecha Kingdoms Garen
86023.description: Having been elected the leader of the United Great Kingdoms, Garen will stop at nothing until the safety of his people is ensured. Armed with an Avalon upgraded to the teeth, he stands at the forefront of the mightiest warriors from across the land, determined to lead them into battle until the leviathans are no more.

86024.name: Battle Academia Garen

chromas.name: Battle Academia Garen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

86024.description: 'Brother' to Lux, Garen is the only biological child of his family, but was neglected from an early age as his parents spent all their time developing the god-weapon fragment that would one day become their daughter. As he vented his anger in increasingly delinquent ways, Labrys sought him out for enrollment, where he eventually joined the Battle Club.

86033.name: Mythmaker Garen

chromas.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive drop from The Sanctum.

86033.description: As the town's leader in “The Great Beast Galio”, Garen's chief concern is the safety of his people in the face of a fierce enemy. When the story is thrown off, however, Irelia convinces him to help by showing Garen that Galio can be reasoned with, perhaps even stopped entirely if they make a friend out of a foe.

86044.name: Fallen God-King Garen
86044.description: God-King Garen stands as the last scion of an ancient divinity, and the final bulwark against the end of all civilization. He rules the vast kingdom of Demacia with an iron fist, jealously protecting his people as a self-styled messiah, while rooting out and destroying all who would oppose him.

89001.name: Valkyrie Leona
89001.description: Hail the valkyrie, for she will descend upon the field of battle, and raise our greatest warriors into the halls of Valhalla! Those she doesn't take with her go to the underworld, or sometimes the ocean, though they don't tell you that before the whole 'dying in battle' thing.

89003.name: Iron Solari Leona
89003.description: She who bears the Iron Solari into battle bears the weight of history—as iron gives way to steel, and steel to eternity.

89004.name: Pool Party Leona
89004.description: Leona is a former champion surfer, who enjoys spending her downtime relaxing on the beach with a light romance novel. Or pretty much any romance novel, in fact.

89008.name: PROJECT: Leona
89008.description: A heavy armor combatant, Leona has seen the truth behind the neon light of PROJECT, and now stands with Ashe and the G/NETIC rebellion. She carries a mounted ion charge shield, capable of blocking and stunning targets with its variable energy yield output.

89009.name: Barbecue Leona
89009.description: She's the solar pitmaster; the lean, mean, brisket queen. If her flavors don't stun you, that forty pound grill will. Please give a warm welcome to Leona!

89010.name: Solar Eclipse Leona
89010.description: Hearken! We beseech thee, O Cruel Sun, and deign to bless with the cleansing flame of thy celestial majesty. May this shield guard against the scourge of dark enchantments, which choke our land. May this blade be the hammer against the servants of witchery and evil. I, Leona, do take this oath forevermore.

89011.name: Lunar Eclipse Leona
89011.description: Hearken! We beseech thee, O Savage Moon, and deign to bless with the vermillion shadow of thy celestial majesty. May this shield guard against the scourge of dark enchantments, which choke our land. May this blade be the hammer against the servants of witchery and evil. I, Leona, do take this oath forevermore.

89012.name: Mecha Kingdoms Leona

89012.description: Leona grew up as the favored daughter of the Dawnrise Kingdom. When the leviathans appeared on her homeland's shores, she took command of her realm's forces, becoming the matriarch of her people. In return, the grateful scholars of her court gifted her an Avalon, an immense pilotable mech powered by the life essence of the very monsters that threatened her home. Now, she stands fearless, leading vast navies into war.

89021.name: Battle Academia Leona

chromas.name: Battle Academia Leona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

89021.description: An oddly cheery member of Labrys Academy's Battle Club, Leona's dark side comes out in combat, when her motherly, protective persona is utterly replaced by bloodlust. The change is so dramatic that even the most violent students tend to stay on her good side, hoping to avoid her wrath.

89022.name: DWG Leona

chromas.name: DWG Leona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2021.

89022.description: Honoring BeryL's winning performance as Leona during the 2020 World Championship.

89023.name: Prestige Battle Academia Leona
89023.description: After being selected for the yearly cross-academy tournament, Leona sharpened her combat prowess almost every free moment she had, knowing she had to beat out other top-ranking students from rival schools like Durandal, Babylon, Amrita, and Sharur. Her bloodlust now honed and her shield at the ready, she will pummel anyone who challenges her into a meaty pulp.

89033.name: Debonair Leona

chromas.name: Debonair Leona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Debonair event.

89033.description: An enforcer at the exclusive Solari resort, Leona spends her days brutally ejecting unruly patrons from the premises and her evenings schmoozing up the city's ultra-wealthy. Even the rich and powerful know not to trifle with the Solari's chosen, lest they find themselves soaring out of the penthouse suite and down into the sidewalk.

89034.name: High Noon Leona

chromas.name: High Noon Leona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

89034.description: The Lady of House Solari lifts her chin against the scorching wind. Ahead lies her family's salvation: the Sulfur Rail, carrying the stolen family fortune, churning across the desert. The only thing that stands in her way is the Mechanical Devil himself. Her sword hums like cicadas in the gloaming. The butterflies gather. Time for the Harbingers to ride.

89050.name: Crystalis Motus Leona
89050.description: Leona knows what caused the purge: blasphemy. Magic's disappearance was retribution for humanity's arrogance and misuse of it. As a worshipper of the Prismae Crystals, she believes it's her sacred duty to protect them. But she also prays to them in secret, hoping they'll bring back her lost love, Diana, who disappeared after journeying to the north.

89052.name: Battle Lion Leona

chromas.name: Battle Lion Leona

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Battle Lion Leona

89052.description: Leona is Anima Squad's reliable front-line defense, big sister, and official wrangler of its wilder members. Someone has to make sure those fire starters from the demolitions team get safely back to base! Don't think Leona can't bring the pain on her own, though. When it comes to battle, you will hear her roar!

89053.name: Prestige Battle Lion Leona
89053.description: Sporting the latest in fashionable activewear for any on-the-go warrior, Leona defends her title of “Pride of the Runway” as easily as she rocks a bold lip color. Saving the world is important, but doing it with style? That's what Anima Squad is all about.

90003.name: Djinn Malzahar
90003.description: Little is known about the djinn, misinformation leading many to seek out the dark, desolate corners of the world in hopes of finding one to grant their wildest wishes. Instead, they find themselves at the mercy of a powerful spirit that is neither good nor evil and has a penchant for possession.

90005.name: Snow Day Malzahar

chromas.name: Snow Day Malzahar

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Snowdown event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Snowdown event.

90005.description: Prophets of doom love a snow day as much as anybody—perhaps even more, since Malzahar knows everything will one day be swallowed by the Void. Clad in fashionable winter gear and flanked by an army of voidling poros, he's ready to usher in the snowball apocalypse.

90006.name: Battle Boss Malzahar
90006.description: A boss hailing from a long-forgotten game cabinet, Malzahar broke free from the last remaining copy of his game to invade nearby machines. Now he has made his way to Arcade World, shredding the code of his enemies with an army of intelligent viruses.

90007.name: Hextech Malzahar
90007.description: Upon hearing that the origin of hextech lay in his homeland of Shurima, Malzahar ventured out into the wastes alone. There, after suffering a life-changing revelation, he became its greatest messenger, claiming to see prophecies of the coming of a second hextech renaissance.

90009.name: Worldbreaker Malzahar

chromas.name: Worldbreaker Malzahar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

90009.description: With the world revitalized, there came another wave of titans. Most fearsome of all was Malzahar, the once-great protector of animals. Vengeful over the horrors of the previous extinction, the holy shaman succumbed to anger, and there, in the depths of his rage, his magic turned dark, fueling a fury to end all life—from the depths of the seas to the peaks of mountains.

90018.name: Beezahar

chromas.name: Beezahar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

90018.description: Open your true mind, and beelieve.

90028.name: Debonair Malzahar

chromas.name: Debonair Malzahar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Debonair event.

90028.description: An associate of LeBlanc's from her days in Crime City, now established as a mover and shaker in his own right. While the two cross paths on occasion, Malzahar has certain... outside interests to consider, and those business partners have promised him more than any mortal could ever dream of.

90038.name: Three Honors Malzahar
90038.description: As the Order of Solace's leader, Malzahar wants to extend a gentle, guiding hand to all. It was only by following the tenets of the Three Honors that he was able to escape from a pit of cynicism, and while apathy may reign supreme, Malzahar will do whatever it takes to build a better world.

90039.name: Empyrean Malzahar

chromas.name: Empyrean Malzahar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Empyrean Malzahar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Empyrean event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Empyrean event.

90039.description: Malzahar is the self-proclaimed Voice of the Foreglow. Traveling from realm to realm, he announces that the Empyreans are symptoms of a greater sickness, the fever designed to fight an infection festering across the dimensions. Whether Malzahar truly speaks for the neon flame is anyone's guess, but for now, he's only just warming up.

90049.name: Fatebreaker Malzahar

chromas.name: Fatebreaker Malzahar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

90049.description: Malzahar has glimpsed an endless pattern in his dreams every night for as long as he can remember. Over time, his fascination turned to obsession. Only by stealing into the Palace of the Weave and unlocking the secrets of the Scholar's Fractal Library can he reveal the nature of his visions… and the true shape of fate.

91002.name: Crimson Elite Talon
91002.description: The Crimson Elite cannot confirm or deny the existence of the agent known as Talon. The bloody trail left behind him serves as a sinister warning to all. Perhaps more disconcerting are the hundreds of undocumented cases that remain undiscovered.

91003.name: Dragonblade Talon
91003.description: Legend says that Talon's blades were forged in the fire of a shadow dragon, and that he turned against his corrupt masters, cutting through them one by one before vanishing into the night. Many believe he will appear again whenever the strong take advantage of the weak.

91004.name: SSW Talon
91004.description: Honoring PawN's winning performance as Talon during the 2014 World Championship.

91005.name: Blood Moon Talon
91005.description: An anarchic demon summoned on the night of the Blood Moon, Talon was once a human assassin who surrendered his flesh during one of the cult's possession rituals. He now kills indiscriminately, relishing the terror in his victim's dying eyes.

91012.name: Enduring Sword Talon

chromas.name: Enduring Sword Talon

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

91012.description: A haughty dragon king of the south seas, Talon accepted a duel from the demigoddess Irelia, only to be defeated in his own throne room. Humiliated, he lashed out at her… and she sealed his power within her blade, tasking him with finding new purpose in the mortal realm.

91020.name: Talon Blackwood

chromas.name: Talon Blackwood

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

91020.description: The sworn brother of Twitch Shadowfoot, dashing assassin extraordinaire Talon Blackwood is one half of an infamous underworld duo and the only advanced class in the entire party. He's also a brooding dark elf antihero with a tragic backstory, who is fated to one day save the world! Probably.

91029.name: Withered Rose Talon

chromas.name: Withered Rose Talon

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

91029.description: After the alliance his adopted sister Katarina formed at the last festival was broken, Talon swore revenge. He intends to restore their family's honor by exposing and shattering the entire concept of this celebration of glittering finery and sacred vows. Nothing and no one at this year's festival will escape his wrath.

91038.name: High Noon Talon

chromas.name: High Noon Talon

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: High Noon Talon

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

91038.description: “Fate is catchin' up to you, old friend,” Talon says, leaning back in his chair, predator's eyes gleaming under the shadows of his hat. He still moves like a demon, even warped and corrupted by angel blood as he is. His smile, rueful and knowing, has too many teeth: “The end is comin' for us all.”

91039.name: Prestige High Noon Talon
91039.description: Devilishly handsome and wearing the latest in Western chic, Talon is equally ready to rock the runway or ride the open road. Those boots are made for walking, and he'll walk all over anyone standing in his way.

91049.name: Primal Ambush Talon

chromas.name: Primal Ambush Talon

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

91049.description: A ruthless assassin feared and respected by many, Talon roams the world with one goal: eliminate each and every other Favorclaw until only he remains. When he catches wind that a stubborn mercenary was contracted to take down the leader of the Favorclaw before he can complete his mission, he gleefully realizes that a new hunt is about to begin.

91059.name: Grand Reckoning Talon
91059.description: Talon's knife sinks beneath worn armor as his target breathes his last. He glances at the door. There are only moments to escape before guards find the Reckoner dead. Luckily, this man isn't much larger than himself, and if he is seen leaving his room “alive,” they will find the body cold—and Talon long since returned to the Assassin's Guild for payment.

92002.name: Crimson Elite Riven
92002.description: Though officially listed as killed in action, the rogue operative with the broken blade harbors no regrets for abandoning her comrades in their most dire moment. A turncoat become mercenary, she operates in the outer limits of civil society, lending her blade to the highest bidder.

92003.name: Battle Bunny Riven
92003.description: Say “Hoppin' Mad” one more time. She dares you.

92005.name: Dragonblade Riven

chromas.name: Dragonblade Riven

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Lunar Revel missions.

92005.description: One tale of the kingdoms tells of Riven, her sword forged in dragonfire, descending into an enemy enclave in the aftermath of battle. Slaying her foes and freeing their captives, she rampaged across the countryside, crushing any who would enslave the innocent.

92006.name: Arcade Riven

chromas.name: Arcade Riven

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Arcade event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Arcade event.

92006.description: Riven's part-time job at an arcade mostly involved playing dance simulators after her manager went home. Digitally transported to Arcade World by even scarier bosses, she's now using her moves (and some gear from her favorite RPG) to tear up Veigar's regime, one enemy at a time.

chromas.name: Reignited Worlds 2012 Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during a Worlds event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during a Worlds event.

92016.name: Dawnbringer Riven

chromas.name: Dawnbringer Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

92016.description: Born from swirling energies at the dawn of creation, Riven is the living embodiment of order in the cosmos. Fated to clash against the Nightbringer for all time, she awaits a day when her light will finally break his darkness.

92018.name: Pulsefire Riven

chromas.name: Pulsefire Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

92018.description: A worshipper of temporal purity, Riven knows there are many others who would rather see time manipulated in their favor. These heretics give her blade purpose—she can only find true solace in eliminating all who would disturb the natural order.

92020.name: Valiant Sword Riven
92020.description: Riven trained with Morgana in the arts of politics and war for many years, but where Riven walked the path of justice, Morgana envisioned a world ruled by the gods alone—ultimately defeating their master and assuming the title of empress. Now tasked with bringing her friend to heel, Riven must face Morgana in combat… or join her.

92022.name: Prestige Valiant Sword Riven
92022.description: Riven's destiny is greater than she knows. One day she will determine the fate of the heavens, land, and sea, and awaken the slumbering power of the dragon within her.

92023.name: Spirit Blossom Riven

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Spirit Blossom event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Spirit Blossom event.

92023.description: A brave warrior from an ancient land, Riven was ignobly cut down in the heat of battle thousands of years ago, her sword shattering in the process. Unable to find peace, she obsessively scours an otherworldly battlefield for pieces of her broken blade, possessed by a horrific darkness that guides her into oblivion.

92034.name: Sentinel Riven

chromas.name: Sentinel Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Sentinel Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

92034.description: Riven joins the Sentinels hoping to atone for her role in the Noxian invasion of Ionia. After fighting her way out of a rapidly destabilizing City of Noxus, she understands that her time may be fleeting. However, she believes her life is a small price to pay to make amends.

92044.name: Battle Bunny Prime Riven

chromas.name: Battle Bunny Prime Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Anima Squad event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Anima Squad event.

chromas.name: Battle Bunny Prime Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive drop from The Sanctum.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive drop from The Sanctum.

92044.description: Riven volunteered for what would eventually become Anima Squad after losing many comrades in the early days of the Primordian invasion. A string of victories later, she is famous: a war hero looked up to by all. ...So why has she suddenly vanished when the world needs her most?

92045.name: Prestige Valiant Sword Riven (2022)
92045.description: Riven's destiny is greater than she knows. One day she will determine the fate of the heavens, land, and sea, and awaken the slumbering power of the dragon within her.

92055.name: Broken Covenant Riven

chromas.name: Broken Covenant Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

92055.description: Born an Aspirant, Riven had no doubts about the congregation's evils until she discovered Nocturne torturing and feeding Neverghaast to Cho'Gath. Despite being mortally wounded, she escaped with a prisoner, who turned her into a Neverghaast to save her life. Now an exile with an endless hunger, Riven fights to redeem herself and her corrupted family.

92063.name: Primal Ambush Riven

chromas.name: Primal Ambush Riven

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

92063.description: After a fierce bout with Vi left both her weapon and her confidence shattered, Riven was forced to return to her roots. Due to her unyielding bravery, even in the face of defeat, her community bestowed her with a powerful Wildstripe that reforges her blade in times of need. She trains tirelessly for the day that she can prove she's worthy of their gift.

96001.name: Caterpillar Kog'Maw
96001.description: Kog'Maw, ever lost in thought, sat upon his toadstool until he was famished. “Wonderland is full of such delights,” he mused, gulping down the toadstool entirely. “It would be a shame not to devour them all.”

96002.name: Sonoran Kog'Maw
96002.description: Long considered a pest by frontier settlers, Kog'Maw critters have been growing in number as more dangerous beasts are pushed to the brink of extinction. And they are very, very hungry.

96004.name: Reindeer Kog'Maw
96004.description: It is rumored that Kog'Maw stole his glowing nose and deer antlers from a particularly adorable creature he devoured. Whether or not the theory is true, Kog'Maw is now the most famous reindeer of all.

96005.name: Lion Dance Kog'Maw
96005.description: It is unclear if Kog'Maw even understands what Lunar Revel is, but someone seems to have painted him for it. That person has presumably been eaten and digested, but Kog'Maw does look very festive.

96006.name: Deep Sea Kog'Maw
96006.description: “Perhaps my old mind was deceived by the fury of the storm. Yet as we sank, I glimpsed a field of lights beneath the waves, a thousand eyes of wicked alabaster… they were dark things tearing into the flesh of our crew as if all they ever knew was hunger.”

96008.name: Battlecast Kog'Maw
96008.description: Mass-produced artillery units based on the now-extinct Kog'Maw organism, Viktor has invented an ingenious shell delivery system best appreciated from about a hundred miles away—the latest design's maximum range.

96009.name: Pug'Maw
96009.description: Pug'Maw is a nine month old purebred pug with a sweet disposition and possibly some sort of salivary problem. Great with children and pets. Highly food motivated. Has eaten three action figures and one doll, approach with extreme caution.

96010.name: Hextech Kog'Maw
96010.description: A newer Hextech innovation, Kog'Maw constructs are available as pets for wealthy families, delighting Piltover's upper crust with their friendly demeanor and intricately complex design. Though living things, they are viewed among the well-to-do as little more than status symbols.

96019.name: Arcanist Kog'Maw

chromas.name: Arcanist Kog'Maw

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

96019.description: The diminutive familiar of a famed sorcerer, Kog'Maw was mistreated and neglected for years as his master pursued the arcane arts. Thanks to a chance meeting with Zoe, he was released from servitude to travel the land with her… ultimately enrolling in the same school Zoe technically attends.

96028.name: Bee'Maw

chromas.name: Bee'Maw

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

96028.description: Snowballing lane won't bring back your precious honey!

96037.name: Zap'Maw

chromas.name: Zap'Maw

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Zap'Maw

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

96037.description: The Zap'Maw is a curious monster that baffles even the most experienced of Tamers. Sightings are limited to abandoned ruins that only the bravest dare enter. But taming one is an even more challenging task. Only one Tamer has succeeded so far, their bond—and the Zap'Maw's lightning attacks—growing stronger each day.

96046.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Kog'Maw

chromas.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Kog'Maw

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

96046.description: In defiance of the maelstrom's power, the beast Kog'Maw safely rides along its currents thanks to its nigh-unbreakable shell. Perpetually at odds with itself, its tail is addicted to feeding on the maelstrom's energy, while its head simply wants to devour everything in sight. Can anything within the Scrolls sate its growing hunger?

96055.name: Victorious Kog'Maw

chromas.name: Victorious Kog'Maw
