96055.description: Kog'Maw was earned by players who accumulated enough split points in Ranked. Those curious enough to follow the shimmering ooze trailing from the mouth of a crevasse, have but a moment to recognize that same curiosity in Kog'Maw's glittering stare before finding themselves enveloped in his terrible mouth.

98001.name: Frozen Shen
98001.description: Enduring the bitter cold, Shen roams the ice caps with his twin blades, hunting the terrifying demon hidden deep underneath.

98003.name: Surgeon Shen

chromas.name: Surgeon Shen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

98003.description: Rest assured, anesthesia won't be part of the operation.

98004.name: Blood Moon Shen
98004.description: The most indomitable disciple, in mind and body, Shen's loyalty to the Blood Moon cult can never be shaken. He serves as the personal bodyguard of the group's most important figures, executing interlopers with a cool dispassion, suggesting part of his humanity has already been consumed.

98006.name: TPA Shen
98006.description: Honoring Stanley's winning performance as Shen during the 2012 World Championship.

98015.name: Pulsefire Shen

chromas.name: Pulsefire Shen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

98015.description: Over the millennia, Shen has been called many names: warlord, trespasser, conqueror. Even so, his mission to build an army for the ages seems never-ending. Seeking only the smartest and the strongest to join his ranks, he remains untroubled by emotion, casting his timeless gaze over those with hidden potential.

98016.name: Infernal Shen

chromas.name: Infernal Shen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

98016.description: An Infernal warrior risen from the raging depths of the underworld, Shen appears on battlefields in the blink of an eye, shielding his fellow titans from even the most well-organized resistance.

98022.name: PsyOps Shen

chromas.name: PsyOps Shen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: PsyOps Shen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 PsyOps event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 PsyOps event.

98022.description: A psychic soldier and field lieutenant within PsyOps, Shen's power is connected to a phantom child that follows him wherever he goes -- granting him insight into the middens between the living and the dead. Where the boy came from only High Command knows, and they aren't talking.

98040.name: Shockblade Shen

chromas.name: Shockblade Shen

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

98040.description: Once half of an elite operative duo for the Shockblade order, Shen stepped away from combat after he made a mistake that nearly cost the life of his partner, Zed. Now Shen mentors young shinobi training to join their ranks – but his new charge may inspire him to take up his sword and join the fight once more.

98049.name: Ashen Guardian Shen
98049.description: A devotee of the principles of his now slain leader, Shen still walks the castle grounds, wielding his master's blade alongside his own. Perhaps some small part of him recognizes, with each blow to his armor from travelers seeking ancient riches, that his guard is senseless. But life must have meaning. Even life as endless as this.

98051.name: Three Honors Shen
98051.description: Shen is the last surviving founder of the Order of Solace. He shuttered every temple when the world fell into apathy and carelessness, disappearing into obscurity until Malzahar revived the Order. Now returned from the shadows, Shen serves as its most senior teacher, a stoic leader of integrity and grace that all can rely on.

99001.name: Sorceress Lux
99001.description: An aspiring mage from the Demacian Dukedom, Lux has traveled across the land in her quest to lighten the lives of the peasantry with magic. Though her efforts are often met with suspicion at first, tales of her 'miracles' are beginning to reach the ruling class of the Dukedom itself…

99002.name: Spellthief Lux
99002.description: She doesn't pull in coin like the Spellthief's Edge, and can't actually steal spells like Sylas, but technically Lux is learning and reproducing illegal magic. Sadly, “Illegal Spell Learner Lux” doesn't have quite the same ring to it.

99003.name: Commando Lux
99003.description: Soundproof ear protectors, a multispectral heat visor, lace-up knee-high boots, and a double-sided flamethrower that shoots lasers instead of fire? Lux really does have it all.

99005.name: Steel Legion Lux
99005.description: This highly-trained specialist in the Steel Legion uses light-magnifying crystal rods to discharge rays of concentrated energy. Designated Lux, her affinity with the weapons has been quietly observed by several leading scientists within the organization.

99006.name: Star Guardian Lux
99006.description: Cheerful and courageous, Lux shines the brightest among her Star Guardian team. While young and inexperienced, the pink-haired captain's optimism inspires others in their destiny to protect the universe. She truly believes that as long as they fight together, there is no darkness they can't overcome.

99007.name: Elementalist Lux
99007.featuresText:
• Ten distinct elemental forms
  • Combining elements triggers new transformations
  • New elemental effects for all forms
  • Five exclusive icons which grant dynamic profile background

99008.name: Lunar Empress Lux

chromas.name: Lunar Empress Lux

descriptions.description: Bundle exclusive from the 2018 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: Bundle exclusive from the 2018 Lunar Revel event.

99008.description: Groomed from a young age to guard the immortal realm from darkness, the Lunar Empress and her companions are said to stand watch over the world. Lux, though a powerful demigod in her own right, draws aid from the ever-faithful Warwick and Nasus.

99014.name: Pajama Guardian Lux
99014.description: As captain of her Star Guardian team, Lux knows the importance of a little R&R. As host of the party, though, she's still working on the relaxation part. It's hard to cut loose—especially when a certain handsome blond Guardian keeps flashing that charming grin!—but Lux's boundless optimism still lights up any room.

99015.name: Battle Academia Lux
99015.description: A 1st year at the Durandal God-Weapon Academy, Lux maintains an upbeat attitude no matter the odds. Despite her freshman position in the Sorcery Club, Lux wields a tremendous amount of magical power that even the Academy's senior staff can't quite explain.

99016.name: Prestige Battle Academia Lux
99016.description: Now in her second year at Durandal Academy, Lux has been hardened by the harrowing trials, losses, and betrayals that punctuated her freshman experience. Following the climactic clash with a certain Rogue God-Weapon, Lux has mastered her powers and risen to take her place as head of the Sorcery Club, as well as the new class president.

99017.name: Dark Cosmic Lux
99017.description: Once the right hand of Queen Ashe, Lux embraced the darkness in her heart, answering the mad call of the Dark Star. Finally seeing the truth, she rejects the Cosmic Court, instead serving her own dark ambition to quiet the banal noise of creation. For she now knows her true fate—to reign as Queen of a Dark Court, and rightful master of the Dark Star.

99018.name: Cosmic Lux
99018.description: The right hand of Queen Ashe, Lux weaves celestial constellations, bringing order to a universe drifting towards entropy. When the Dark Star began corrupting members of the Cosmic Court, Lux stepped forward to confront Thresh. Yet she harbors a terrible secret—a shard of darkness that has always lived within her heart, whispering temptations…

99019.name: Space Groove Lux

chromas.name: Space Groove Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Space Groove Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Space Groove event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Space Groove event.

99019.description: A normal girl from the Normal World, Lux picked up a groove-enhancing staff to defend her planet from the Harsh Vibes… inadvertently discovering she could channel mighty blasts of concentrated disco music. Sailing into space with her mercenary bodyguard, Samira, Lux now stands as the bubbly bastion of good against an evil alien armada and their terrible taste in music.

99029.name: Porcelain Lux

chromas.name: Porcelain Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Porcelain Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

99029.description: As the current leader of the Protectors and wielder of the Rabbit Relic, Lux is determined to keep up her sunny disposition in spite of everything: her own arduous sorcery training, the newbie archaeologist who stumbled into their ranks, and the sudden threat of an awakened evil now out for vengeance. She's got this… right? Right.

99038.name: Soul Fighter Lux

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

99038.description: On the run from her family, and she figured the best place to hide would be ON TV?! Seriously though, folks, this lady has some trauma... and we all know the ring is *the* place to work that out! Now, if I was a betting man—and I am—I'd say she'd use that soul's desire to make her drama disappear. It's Lux!

99039.name: Prestige Battle Academia Lux (2022)
99039.description: Now in her second year at Durandal Academy, Lux has been hardened by the harrowing trials, losses, and betrayals that punctuated her freshman experience. Following the climactic clash with a certain Rogue God-Weapon, Lux has mastered her powers and risen to take her place as head of the Sorcery Club, as well as the new class president.

99040.name: Prestige Porcelain Lux
99040.description: A leader bends, but never breaks. In the Protectors' pursuit of ancient evil, Lux has navigated her team over obstacles that even the archeologist — in all his unbridled confidence — thought insurmountable. Lux's power, once a dim light in a darkened world, now shines brightly. And her ragtag group of fragile personalities, the Protectors? With her support, deserving of their title.

99042.name: Empyrean Lux

chromas.name: Empyrean Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Empyrean Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 Event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 Event.

99042.description: Forced to live in squalor and shame for her magical abilities, Lux ironically escaped certain death when her realm collapsed. Now with the raw power of the Foreglow, she's free. It doesn't matter that she's on her last legs: she intends to live and experience as much as she can before the fire consumes her.

99061.name: Faerie Court Lux

chromas.name: Faerie Court Lux

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

99061.description: A young sorceress studying under Archmage Milio, Lux is ready to prove that she's not just an idle Lady of the Summer Court. Responsible for splitting sunbeams into rainbows through the morning dew, she has a lot of work to conquer each day before the sun rises—but she is nothing if not determined!

99070.name: Prestige Spirit Blossom Lux
99070.description: When a kind young woman freed a trapped creature—a spirit in disguise—she was offered a single treasure. Among dazzling riches, she chose a plain gray stone, told it could help many. It was no stone at all, but a shell with two glowing pearls. In her hands, they became a staff of light, a gift the Lady of Pearls now uses to guide others through darkness.

101002.name: Battlecast Xerath
101002.description: The question of the human soul has always intrigued Viktor, and so he set to work building a Battlecast machine capable of harnessing it. The resulting Xerath units are twisted, hellish monsters imprisoned in a cage of psychic energy, constantly discharging superheated plasma toward any opponent in range.

101003.name: Scorched Earth Xerath
101003.description: A highly unstable creature born from roiling magma, Xerath possesses a keen intellect, awaiting the day he might ascend through the ranks of the Infernal war machine, and usurp the Ashen Lord himself. For now his ambitions remain secret, but… soon… soon…

101004.name: Guardian of the Sands Xerath
101004.description: Xerath, the liquid light—ancient guardian of the sands, we invoke thee to protect us from an evil of our own making. Let no man tread upon these hallowed grounds, lest you drown them in your purifying radiance.

101005.name: Dark Star Xerath

chromas.name: Dark Star Xerath

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Galaxies event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Galaxies event.

chromas.name: Dark Star Xerath

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

101005.description: As the Dark Star continued on its path across space, it passed through a vibrant system orbiting a supergiant star. Consuming all life and light as it passed , the Dark Star twisted the supergiant into a wrathful corruptant. Thus, Xerath was born—a dark being of malice and annihilation.

101012.name: Arcana Xerath

chromas.name: Arcana Xerath

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

101012.description: Ensnared by his own desires, Xerath leads citizens of Low Arcana to act on their basest urges. The more they are entranced by the forbidden, the more his power grows. But while Xerath believes their temptation will lead to his deliverance, he does not realize that the stronger he becomes, the more tightly his chains bind him.

101021.name: Astronaut Xerath

chromas.name: Astronaut Xerath

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

101021.description: An obsessive chemist driven by power, Xerath discovered the invader meeps and devoted his life to researching how to harness their energy. After an explosion during one of his experiments, his body was permanently mutated. Now, fully consumed by the corrupted meeps, Xerath traverses the galaxy, seeking to spread his malice across the cosmos.

101030.name: Crystalis Indomitus Xerath
101030.description: Once a humble fisherman, Xerath returned from a voyage with a multitude of magical crystals in tow. Their power elevated him to become a leader of his people, ushering in what he hoped would be a new era of the Prismae Crystals' rule. But the cost of such power damaged his mind, leaving him suspicious that no thoughts are to be trusted… even his own.

102002.name: Boneclaw Shyvana
102002.description: Many hunters claim Shyvana holds an unfair advantage when it comes to slaying the giant beasts that roam the land. Shyvana herself cares little about their opinions, preferring instead to channel her rage into her true form—a massive, fire-breathing dragon… that proves the hunters' point.

102003.name: Darkflame Shyvana
102003.description: With her humanity burned away by the Darkflame, Shvyana wreaks havoc upon the battlefield. It is said that any enemy touched by her flame will have their very soul incinerated by its dark magics.

102004.name: Ice Drake Shyvana
102004.description: From the desolate reaches of the North, a dormant drake lay in rest. Upon Shyvana's arrival this behemoth awakened from its slumber and imbued her with the power of the frozen wastes. Now she stalks the tundra, searching for any foolish enough to cross her path.

chromas.name: Worlds 2014 Shyvana

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during a Worlds event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during a Worlds event.

102006.name: Super Galaxy Shyvana
102006.description: By far the most experienced of the entire Super Galaxy team, Shyvana is the leader her teammates sorely need. A transfer pilot from a different (but just as hyperbolically named) defense force, she does sometimes find herself at odds with her allies as much as her enemies—and periodically questions if the ten percent salary bonus was actually worth it.

102008.name: Ruined Shyvana

chromas.name: Ruined Shyvana

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Ruined Shyvana

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.

102008.description: Shyvana's ruination brings a newfound darkness, as well as clarity. Turning swiftly against Demacia for its persecution of magic, and sinking into her more draconic emotions, she appears as an avenging beast of old, ready to topple Demacia for its ignorance.

102017.name: Immortal Journey Shyvana

chromas.name: Immortal Journey Shyvana

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

102017.description: For 100 years, the dragon Shyvana watched over the Sprouting Courage School's gardens, but after saving one of the monk's sons from drowning, she was allowed to train. Transforming into a human, she enjoyed the challenge this new form would bring. Unlike Soraka, Shyvana has no doubt about who she is: a protector of the strongest school of immortality.

103001.name: Dynasty Ahri

chromas.name: Dynasty Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103001.description: Though Ahri's royal blood is obvious in her fashion and poise, she much prefers running across rooftops and causing general mischief to being locked up in a castle. Life's more fun with laughter, don't you think?

103002.name: Midnight Ahri

chromas.name: Midnight Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103002.description: Deep in the snowy forests bordering the kingdom, villagers tell tales of a mysterious icefox who, under the light of the midnight moon, becomes human. What they don't know is that this fox, Ahri, was once a princess. Cursed to live a life as wild as her heart, she runs through the forests during the day, hoping to find someone to break her eternal curse.

103003.name: Foxfire Ahri

chromas.name: Foxfire Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.name: Foxfire Ahri

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

103003.description: A young, talented pyromancer from the Shadowfire Temple, Ahri gave up her quiet life when a faction of extremists unleashed the burning horrors of the Ashen Lord. Now she uses her fire magic to fight against them, even though all hope seems lost.

103004.name: Popstar Ahri

chromas.name: Popstar Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103004.description: Discovered by her record label when she was still a teen, Ahri took the music world by storm when her first five singles hit the Top 100, winning Most Talented New K-pop Artist at the 2013 Pop Shine Awards. She's been stealing hearts and sweeping awards ever since. However, underneath that perfect exterior, Ahri is feeling trapped by increasing demands...

chromas.name: Challenger Ahri

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 MSI Event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 MSI Event.

chromas.name: Challenger Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103006.name: Academy Ahri

chromas.name: Academy Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103006.description: NOTICE FROM THE DEAN: Ahri is henceforth suspended from Academy grounds for behavior including (but not limited to): use of her phone during class, use of her phone during disciplinary hearings about her phone, and escaping disciplinary hearings about her phone.

103007.name: Arcade Ahri

chromas.name: Arcade Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103007.description: Owner of the mysterious six-million-point high score in the infamously difficult beat-em-up Demacia Vice, Ahri is a force of nature on the retro battlefields of Arcadia. Dashing between bosses before ripping them apart with her 8-bit magic, she's already earned the nickname “Queen of the Arcade.”

103014.name: Star Guardian Ahri

chromas.name: Star Guardian Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103014.description: Ahri is a charismatic team captain who leads her group of Star Guardians from the outer cosmos, with the authority of a queen bee and the sly cunning of a fox. She's effortlessly popular, with an irresistible charm that disarms friends and foes alike.

103015.name: K/DA Ahri

chromas.name: K/DA Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103015.description: Setting her old bubblegum pop persona aside, Ahri was determined to shake up her image and reinvent herself as an unstoppable force within the music industry. Five years later, she has returned with a sleek new look and a killer sound—and this time she's not alone.

103016.name: Prestige K/DA Ahri
103016.description: Decked out to dazzle, K/DA Ahri charms her audience in a glittering, golden ensemble specially made for her band's 2019 Pop Shine Awards performance. Her Prestige Edition outfit celebrates the golden success of POP/STARS. Can you feel the rush now?

103017.name: Elderwood Ahri

chromas.name: Elderwood Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: Elderwood Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103017.description: Fables of the trickster spirit Ahri have been part of mankind's history for countless generations. Radiant and eternally youthful, she is portrayed as a curious, quizzical member of the Elderwood's feyfolk… though in recent years her heart has hardened, as she fights a growing corruption within her ancestral home.

103027.name: Spirit Blossom Ahri

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Spirit Blossom event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Spirit Blossom event.

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103027.description: The famed Spirit of Salvation, and the fox all mortals are beckoned towards when their souls arrive to the spirit realm. A capricious, whimsical spirit who sees the fate of the living as a game of chase, she offers the chance for souls to find their final rest… but will not intervene if they stray from the path.

103028.name: K/DA ALL OUT Ahri

chromas.name: K/DA ALL OUT Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: K/DA ALL OUT Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Worlds event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Worlds event.

chromas.name: K/DA ALL OUT Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103028.description: When Ahri steps onto the stage to perform with K/DA, she knows she's surrounded by the best of the best—different women with different personalities, all at the top of their craft. As their leader and as their friend, Ahri is poised to guide these divas to even greater heights and leave their audiences breathless for more.

103042.name: Coven Ahri

chromas.name: Coven Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Coven Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Coven event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Coven event.

chromas.name: Coven Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released in the 2021 Ahri-versary event.

103042.description: They came to Ahri at the first stirrings of dusk—the laughter of the Half-Light Jackal, ever stalking the world as it turned towards its own inevitable entropy. A vicious predator and powerful witch, Ahri sucks the life from all she lures close, siphoning it towards her lord within the gloom.

103065.name: Prestige K/DA Ahri (2022)
103065.description: Decked out to dazzle, K/DA Ahri charms her audience in a glittering, golden ensemble specially made for her band's 2019 Pop Shine Awards performance. Her Prestige Edition outfit celebrates the golden success of POP/STARS. Can you feel the rush now?

103066.name: Arcana Ahri

chromas.name: Arcana Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

103066.description: A trickster and magician whose power is drawn from the grinning moon, Ahri plies her trade rearranging patterns and allowing the Lower World insight into the Higher. Having already set the fated pair Xayah and Rakan careening towards each other, she awaits the resulting chaos with a cynical bemusement.

103076.name: Snow Moon Ahri

chromas.name: Snow Moon Ahri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

103076.description: An ancient and powerful arctic fox spirit, Ahri has been around since the founding of the Snow Moon order. It is a symbiotic arrangement: agents purify themselves by sacrificing their emotions and memories to her appetite. Ahri is the keeper of their lost memories, experiencing the outside world through her devotees, their eyes now vacant and cold.

103085.name: Risen Legend Ahri

tiers.name: Risen Legend Ahri
tiers.description: You've done well, Ahri, to complete my trials with such grace and humility. To become a Risen Legend is no easy feat, and even in the face of failure, you have proven your resilience. Go forth and leave a legacy worthy of the Unkillable Demon King. When you're ready to learn your true potential… heed my call.

tiers.name: Immortalized Legend Ahri
tiers.description: Ahri, you now rightfully bear the seal of The Unkillable Demon King's chosen. You are an Immortalized Legend, an honor that few have ever achieved. Rest assured that your ancestors are proud of your success, as am I. With this and every battle to come, history will never forget you or the power you've fought tirelessly to earn. Welcome to godhood.

103085.description: You've done well, Ahri, to complete my trials with such grace and humility. To become a Risen Legend is no easy feat, and even in the face of failure, you have proven your resilience. Go forth and leave a legacy worthy of the Unkillable Demon King. When you're ready to learn your true potential… heed my call.

104003.name: Crime City Graves
104003.description: Cool, calm, and collected, Malcolm Graves is head of the notorious Graves crime family—and the only non-rat that Twitch will trust. Recent moves in the criminal underworld have put his alliance with the rat-men on shaky ground, and he's keen to find out why.

104004.name: Riot Graves
104004.description: A Riot Games skin obtained by either meeting a Rioter or attending an official Riot event in 2012.

104006.name: Cutthroat Graves
104006.description: Do you want to do extreme damage to someone (or something) in a loud, noticeable fashion? Look no further than Graves and his slippery pal Tobias, two men who will blow up anything (must be destructible) or anyone (must be destructible) for the right price (no ghouls please). Inquire within!

104007.name: Snow Day Graves

chromas.name: Snow Day Graves

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Snowdown event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained from the 2018 Snowdown event.

104007.description: Outfitted with his mighty snowblowing gun and a can-do attitude, Graves enters every snowball fight with the same entrepreneurial spirit that got him out of prison. Which is to say, blowing a lot of things up with little to no regard for his own safety.

104014.name: Victorious Graves

chromas.name: Victorious Graves

descriptions.description: Ranked reward for achieving Gold in Ranked Flex for Season 7.

chromas.description: Ranked reward for achieving Gold in Ranked Flex for Season 7.

chromas.name: Victorious Graves

descriptions.description: Ranked reward for achieving Gold in Ranked Solo for Season 7.

chromas.description: Ranked reward for achieving Gold in Ranked Solo for Season 7.

chromas.name: Victorious Graves

descriptions.description: Ranked reward for achieving Gold in Ranked 3v3 for Season 7.

chromas.description: Ranked reward for achieving Gold in Ranked 3v3 for Season 7.

104014.description: Victorious Graves was awarded to players who reached Gold or higher in the 2017 season. The most wanted outlaw in Bilgewater boasts of his years of skillful heists, by wearing the finest regalia money can buy.

104018.name: Praetorian Graves

chromas.name: Praetorian Graves

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

104018.description: Unleashed upon the multiverse by imperfect Pulsefire technology, Graves is but one of a numberless horde of Praetorian marauders now plaguing spacetime. Its programming is unlike anything from any known past, present, or future—each of its thoughts is so complex, it would take ten lifetimes for a human to comprehend.

104025.name: Battle Professor Graves

chromas.name: Battle Professor Graves

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.name: Battle Professor Graves

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Trials event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Trials event.

104025.description: Graves is a salty ex-soldier who served in the Durandal military before he reluctantly became a professor. Following his discovery of something deep behind enemy lines, he received an offer to teach at the Academy from the God-Weapon itself. His hallmark cigar-munching, dispassionate teaching etiquette is a small price to pay for his decades of experience.

104035.name: Sentinel Graves

chromas.name: Sentinel Graves

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Sentinel Graves

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinel event.

104035.description: Graves could give a damn about saving the world, but the Ruined King is getting in the way of his criminal undertakings, and that he cannot abide. When the Sentinels come calling, Graves reckons he can play the hero for once—long enough to make sure there's a world left to rob, anyway.

104042.name: EDG Graves

chromas.name: EDG Graves

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2022.

104042.description: Honoring Flandre's winning performance as Graves during the 2021 World Championship.

104045.name: Porcelain Graves

chromas.name: Porcelain Graves

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Porcelain Graves

chromas.name: Porcelain Graves

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Lunar Revel event.

104045.description: Not long after gunpowder was invented, the Zodiac searched for a new protector of the Dragon Relic. Though ancient and wise, the gods struggled to find someone worthy, so they settled for Malcolm Graves. Eventually his expertise in firepower was pointed in the right direction (away from all the breakable vases).

105001.name: Atlantean Fizz
105001.description: “When I was very young, my grandfather told me stories of Atlantis—of their high temples and great undersea army, and their great General Fizz. Grandfather remembered it as it was, you see, and not the silent mausoleum it has become.”

105004.name: Void Fizz
105004.description: There's no disputing that Fizz is a deadly creature of the endless Void. But even in the Void, Fizz is widely considered to be extremely irritating for his love of bringing life into existence just to annoy the Watchers.

105008.name: Cottontail Fizz
105008.description: Rising from the fluffiest depths to crush all root vegetable cohorts, Fizz commands the greatest threat carrots have ever known—a killer rabbit with the foulest and cruelest of tempers.

105009.name: Super Galaxy Fizz
105009.description: Nobody is quite sure how Fizz graduated the Super Galaxy academy, but one thing's for certain: no other pilot (or space fish) can summon a mecha-gigalodon from seemingly out of nowhere. Not that anyone should in the first place…

105010.name: Omega Squad Fizz
105010.description: Omega Squad's saboteur, Fizz is skilled in underwater combat. It is unclear what kind of action he saw before joining up, however, as he only ever refers to the sea as “a big bucket of chum.”

105015.name: Prestige Fuzz Fizz
105015.description: There's something deeply unnerving about a bipedal Cocker Spaniel mix running around society unchecked, stabbing pedestrians with a tennis ball grabber, and summoning other, bigger dogs out of the ground. And yet, here we all are. Together.

105016.name: Little Devil Fizz

chromas.name: Little Devil Fizz

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

105016.description: Sea's a dwelling place for demons.

105025.name: Prestige Fuzz Fizz (2022)
105025.description: There's something deeply unnerving about a bipedal Cocker Spaniel mix running around society unchecked, stabbing pedestrians with a tennis ball grabber, and summoning other, bigger dogs out of the ground. And yet, here we all are. Together.

105026.name: Astronaut Fizz

chromas.name: Astronaut Fizz

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

105026.description: Fizz defied all expectations when he successfully tamed an invader meep and resisted its corruption through their link. His unique connection promoted him to captain, a status he uses to pull mischievous pranks on his team. But when he's not tormenting his favorite lieutenant, he's unleashing his tricks on corrupted evildoers to keep planet M33P safe.

105035.name: Rain Shepherd Fizz

chromas.name: Rain Shepherd Fizz

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Rain Shepherd Fizz

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

105035.description: The fiendish Fizz was so jealous of the magical singing voices frogs possess that he taught himself how to sing and summon the rains. Though earsplitting at first, before long his songs were drawing tears from his listeners. With his magical vocals, Fizz is now keen to rain on everyone's parades.

106001.name: Thunder Lord Volibear
106001.description: In an age before man, King Voli ruled the bitter northlands, and he was as harsh and unforgiving as they were. It is said that he waged a terrible war against his brother, the great King Ornn, and that their struggle razed mountains and emptied seas, as the two of them became like beasts themselves.

106002.name: Northern Storm Volibear
106002.description: It's easy to get used to having a bear in the platoon. He never gets cold, he sleeps all the time, and he can tear through a fully armored regiment of enemy soldiers in about six seconds. It's very easy to get used to having a bear in the platoon.

106004.name: Captain Volibear
106004.description: For Volibear's years of service on the Force, he was awarded the honorary title of Captain. For his utter incompetence in the field, it was made certain he would remain on desk duty for the rest of his career. Even so, he and Constable Trundle always end up patrolling the streets with mountains of paperwork left in their wake.

106005.name: El Rayo Volibear
106005.description: The Wrestling Federation of Valoran would like to put these terrible rumors about our beloved El Rayo to bed once and for all. One: he is definitely a bear, and not a man dressed as a bear, as some might claim. Two: bears make amazing wrestlers.

106006.name: The Thousand-Pierced Bear
106006.description: Ancient Freljordian legends speak of spirit walkers consumed by the true spirit of the unrelenting bear—a force older than the Freljord itself. Those who dare to invoke its name cannot fathom the terrible, primal power they call down upon themselves.

106007.name: Duality Dragon Volibear

chromas.name: Duality Dragon Volibear

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

106007.description: Volibear was the greatest terror in the forest, until the nearby volcano erupted. In the frenzy of escape, Volibear came across a child who was similarly trapped, and heeded a strange instinct—he saved the child. The Duality Dragon saw and made the mighty predator an offer: the power to hone the duality of his nature, both fury and compassion.

106009.name: Prestige Duality Dragon Volibear
106009.description: Volibear stands poised between the two drives of his core self—rage and mercy, impulse and restraint, neither overwhelming the other. Balance is an active struggle; each day the predator and protector clash, and each day Volibear's will grows stronger by the grace of the dragon's gift.

106019.name: Inkshadow Volibear

chromas.name: Inkshadow Volibear

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Inkshadow event.

106019.description: A spirit of fury and war, many vengeful souls have made contracts with the Volibear, and only Udyr has survived for longer than a year. Whether his charges succeed in taking revenge or meet violent ends, each one who dies gives him more power. More power means more wayward mortals seek him out for contracts—and thus the bear will never go hungry.

107001.name: Headhunter Rengar
107001.description: Some hunters choose to scale impossible heights, cutting down creatures many times their own size for the sheer rush of the kill. Rengar is clad in the bones of these creatures, a worrying sign to his more human quarry.

107003.name: SSW Rengar
107003.description: Honoring DanDy's winning performance as Rengar during the 2014 World Championship.

107008.name: Mecha Rengar
107008.description: Designated RNGR-7, the “Mecha Rengar” unit is the second stealth-based unit developed for urban combat. Bereft of its own warping technology, the RNGR can transform into a car for additional mobility.

107015.name: Pretty Kitty Rengar

chromas.name: Pretty Kitty Rengar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

107015.description: Once again, the prettiest kitty… is the deadliest.

107023.name: Guardian of the Sands Rengar

chromas.name: Guardian of the Sands Rengar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

107023.description: An assassin of a forgotten order long thought dead, Rengar prowls the tombs, retrieving ancient relics of power for purposes unknown. Far more alarming, he appears to be hunting guardians, his blades enchanted to pierce their ancient magic and defenses…

107030.name: Sentinel Rengar

chromas.name: Sentinel Rengar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinel event.

107030.description: What game is bigger than a King? As a hunter, Rengar could not pass up the opportunity to take on what would be his ultimate prey, and the ultimate trophy. Even with Sentinel weapons in hand, they will need the skills of a true apex predator to take Viego down.

107040.name: Street Demons Rengar

chromas.name: Street Demons Rengar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Street Demons Rengar

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

107040.description: Rengar is a famous artist throughout the city, a master of hiding his work in plain sight, only to have it leap out at viewers when they least expect it. When TagFest rolls around, it's common to see Rengar's fans scouring the streets for his pieces, discovering art in surprising and unconventional places and proudly posting photos to social media.

110001.name: Blight Crystal Varus
110001.description: Wielding radiant mineral bows, three excavators dove into a cave of crystalline monsters. But only the grimly determined Varus emerged. While shattering the horrors that lurked in dark depths, they lost all grasp of time, sense, and self. Varus became an amalgam of crystal, monster, and man—now fracturing the world he once sought to make safe.

110002.name: Arclight Varus
110002.description: The archer Varus, bathed in the transcendental energies of the Arclight, found himself connected to a great cosmic wholeness more ancient than he had ever known. He now enforces this oneness, turning away entire armies long before they can ignite the flames of war.

110003.name: Arctic Ops Varus
110003.description: Varus leaps from the rampart, a hail of arrows flying from his bow and freezing the ground beneath his victims. As they struggle to regroup, he draws a missile—circuits flashing along its spine—and lets fly. Thanks for the archer, High Command!

110004.name: Heartseeker Varus
110004.description: Love hurts, and Varus is ready to prove it with a quiver full of romance and the seasoned eye of a veteran matchmaker. Angelic harps follow him across the world as he searches for unwitting lovebirds, who soon find their chests pierced by deadly heart-shaped arrowtips.

110005.name: Varus Swiftbolt
110005.description: Two archers cursed by an ancient, evil monster, Varus is roleplaying one archer cursed by an ancient, evil monster. It's not much of a departure for him, but Varus is way better at hunting Noxians than playing tabletop games.

110006.name: Dark Star Varus

chromas.name: Dark Star Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Galaxies event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Galaxies event.

110006.description: An interstellar titan containing multitudes within his eldritch mind, Varus serves the all-consuming Dark Star, a dread singularity born in the darkness of deep space. His arrival is a cataclysmic extinction event, erasing entire planetary systems as if they were never there.

110007.name: Conqueror Varus

chromas.name: Conqueror Varus

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 MSI Event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 MSI Event.

110007.description: Commemorating the 2018 Mid-Season Invitational in Europe.

110009.name: Infernal Varus

chromas.name: Infernal Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

110009.description: The Infernal Varus rips massive gouts of magma from the foundation of the earth, before firing them in volleys at those who would fight back against him. Each arrow lands with the ferocity of an exploding volcano, reducing all resistance to ash.

110016.name: PROJECT: Varus

chromas.name: PROJECT: Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: PROJECT: Varus

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 PROJECT event.

110016.description: A replacement for the traitorous Ashe model, Varus is the latest in PROJECT Corporation's biological weapons... and a controversial experiment, with one body inhabited by three sentient minds. A Command Line counter-espionage operative acting on behalf of the PROJECT initiative, they work alongside the resistance to mitigate the risk posed by Mordekaiser to their corporate interests.

110017.name: Cosmic Hunter Varus

chromas.name: Cosmic Hunter Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

110017.description: A young member of the cosmic court, minted in the image of the Dark Star corruptant Varus. Tasked with destroying his monstrous doppelganger, this new Varus seeks his place among the stars after his task is finally complete.

110034.name: High Noon Varus

chromas.name: High Noon Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: High Noon Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

110034.description: Ain't nothin' for a dead angel to do but resign himself to grief. Varus was content to allow Mordekaiser to take him past the infernal gates themselves… Until a ragtag gang of thieves interrupted his mourning. Varus now picks up his bow once more, riding as a Harbinger. It's high time he got revenge for the massacre of Heaven.

110044.name: Snow Moon Varus

chromas.name: Snow Moon Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

110044.description: Blood Moon cultists drove Varus' comrades mad, forcing him to take their lives. Awash with grief, he begged the Snow Moon Order to numb the pain, to make him an instrument of ice cold revenge. The Order attempted to purify him of these heretical emotions… but Valmar and Kai's voices linger in his mind, and vengeance still smolders in his cold heart.

110053.name: Empyrean Varus

chromas.name: Empyrean Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Empyrean Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Empyrean event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Empyrean event.

110053.description: Having lost his family, Varus was already consumed by vengeance when his realm collapsed. Not only did he survive, due to Nocturne's meddling, but two visiting Empyreans, Kai and Valmar, were absorbed into his bow. With the Foreglow stoking his rage, Varus vows to wipe out every last Empyrean, no matter what his new "friends" say.

110060.name: Spirit Blossom Varus

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Varus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

110060.description: As guardian of a peaceful temple, the Archer welcomed a wandering Artist, allowing him to shelter with his beloved monks. But when the Artist painted him, the sorcerous portrait leapt from the canvas and ravaged the temple. The Archer's grief hardened to fury. Now, he hunts the wicked Artist, hoping to bring peace to those he could not save.

111001.name: Abyssal Nautilus
111001.description: “Never once have I sailed these waves looking for missing divers. Something unnatural lives in the depths, and I fear what it does to these lost souls.”

111003.name: AstroNautilus

chromas.name: AstroNautilus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

111003.description: In space, the anchor weighs practically nothing.

111004.name: Warden Nautilus
111004.description: Shock troopers such as Nautilus bound their souls to suits of ancient Warden armor, becoming one with the powerful enchantments worked into the metal. Few of these suits now remain, though their method of creation seems to have been closely tied to a cataclysmic event known only as the Rune War.

111005.name: Worldbreaker Nautilus
111005.description: The first of four titans prophesied to shatter the world, Nautilus is set to rise when the moon smothers the sun. It is said he will emerge from the sea, heralding a great cleansing tide that will wash away all of mankind.

111009.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Nautilus

chromas.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Nautilus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

111009.description: A guardian who helped seal the mad god Jhin within a holy waterfall, as depicted within the mysterious painting known as the Shan Hai Scrolls. Over the millenia, Jhin has whispered of power, freedom, and true godhood to Nautilus, until he finally released him. Now twisted with anger, Nautilus's rivers run not with water, but molten magma.

111018.name: Fright Night Nautilus

chromas.name: Fright Night Nautilus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

111018.description:
Strange and ghoulish screaming woke Nautilus into being
He made his way outside to find them most displeasing
These lousy, no good neighbors, always there sightseeing!
“What kind of butler would I be if I don't send them fleeing?”

111027.name: Cosmic Paladin Nautilus

chromas.name: Cosmic Paladin Nautilus

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

111027.description: A creature found aimlessly wandering between galaxies, no one knows where Nautilus came from, or how he has stayed alive in the space between stars. But his natural resistance to the entropic forces of the Dark Star attracted the attention of Bel'Veth. He has found meaning and purpose as a Paladin, where before he simply drifted amongst the cosmos.

111036.name: Crystalis Indomitus Nautilus
111036.description: Long ago, Nautilus had been a fisherman by his friend Xerath's side. Together the two discovered a mass of powerful crystals, and greed drove his comrade to cast Nautilus into the water to drown. A single crystal sustained him and, as he slumbered, corrupted and empowered his body and mind. But even this could not destroy his strongest desire—revenge.

112001.name: Full Machine Viktor
112001.description: Created from the same circuitry as the Full Metal champion, Jayce, Viktor was cast into the tunnels beneath the robot fighting arenas to serve as a janitoribot—while his twin was groomed for glory, simulcast en español. Upgrading himself with the cast-offs of the destroyed, he has sworn la venganza.

112003.name: Creator Viktor
112003.description: The creator of the Battlecast machine army, Viktor has perfected the art of transplanting living brains into low-tech, mass-produced weapons. But his work is far from complete, and even now he tinkers on newer, deadlier creations to crush all who oppose him.

112004.name: Death Sworn Viktor
112004.description: On a cold, dreary night, a pioneering inventor was tried and hanged for preaching his glorious vision of the future—a world in which the living knelt before the dead. Death had to admire Viktor's conviction, and sent him back into the mortal world, blessed with powers beyond imagination.

112005.name: PsyOps Viktor

chromas.name: PsyOps Viktor

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 PsyOps event.

112005.description: Leader of the rogue military known as the Black Rose Group, Viktor is a psychic technomancer whose vision for a utopian world was abandoned when he suddenly departed High Command decades prior. Obsessed with an alien 'gate' uncovered during the Arctic Ops event, his experiments into human bioweapons would allow him to breach it and upend the global order.

112014.name: High Noon Viktor

chromas.name: High Noon Viktor

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

112014.description: Many a road to Hell was paved with good intent. Dr. Viktor may be the Mechanical Devil's kept engineer now, but his work began as charity: trying to “rehome” the souls of the dead in clockwork bodies, in order to circumvent mortality itself. Shame that Mordekaiser saw the good doctor's kindness and struck him a deal he could not deny.

112024.name: Arcane Savior Viktor
112024.description: Viktor wanted nothing to do with hextech after the death of his assistant, Sky—but the arcane had different plans for him. In the undercity, he found a new purpose as a healer thanks to the hexcore's effect on him. Now he hopes to show everyone the true power and promise of hextech, should they choose to accept it.

113002.name: Darkrider Sejuani
113002.description: Every army of the dead needs its cavalry. From atop the reanimated hulk of a savage drüvask, Sejuani leads hosts of cruel, lost souls, hellbent on shaping the world in Death's image.

113003.name: Traditional Sejuani
113003.description: Created to capture the original feel of Sejuani, one of our first fully reworked champions.

113004.name: Bear Cavalry Sejuani
113004.description: Sejuani has taken to battle on an armored, one-eyed warbear the size of a shed, while swinging a land mine on a chain, wearing a delightfully vintage red-star hat. Good luck out there!

113005.name: Poro Rider Sejuani
113005.description: Stranded as a child in the Poro King's enchanted Winterlands, Sejuani was taken in by the poros and raised as their own. She is now one of their greatest champions, riding a slobbery, snack-obsessed war poro against any who would threaten her adoptive home.

113006.name: Beast Hunter Sejuani
113006.description: A beast tamer as well as hunter, Sejuani rides her trusty mount Bristle into the thick of combat before snaring massive creatures in the chain of her flail. An almost supernaturally strong woman, she can—temporarily—hold down beasts weighing several tons, which is exactly the window her fellow hunters need.

113007.name: Sejuani Dawnchaser
113007.description: Riding her dire lion into the thick of combat, Sejuani Dawnchaser is an intimidating foe for all but the greatest Riftquest threats. Sadly not the most careful roleplayer, she's on her fourth dire lion this campaign.

113008.name: Firecracker Sejuani

chromas.name: Firecracker Sejuani

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

113008.description: Charging forth on her giant pig and swinging a whip made from low-grade explosives, Sejuani has firmly cemented herself as the woman to watch this Lunar Revel. Because if you're not watching her she'll trample you, and you'll die.

113015.name: Hextech Sejuani
113015.description: A merchant tycoon hailing from the top echelons of Piltovan society, Sejuani paved the way for the manufacture of hextech mounts. Often seen atop the back of her trusted stead, Bristech, she surveys the gilded streets of her magnificent city, always on the lookout to recruit young innovators who dare to push the boundaries of science and engineering.

113016.name: PROJECT: Sejuani

113016.description: The leader of a more radicalized sect of the G/NETIC rebels, Sejuani broke off from Ashe's movement when their 'resistance action' failed to turn explicitly violent. Resurfacing amid Program's takeover of the City, she rides a piece of reclaimed pre-collapse technology alongside her ferocious cohort, ready to put down this new threat before it takes root.

113026.name: Solar Eclipse Sejuani

chromas.name: Solar Eclipse Sejuani

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

113026.description: A Knight of the Eclipse who patrols the border of the Elderwood on a great beast. Grim and wild at heart, Sejuani lives for battle with the forces of the Old Gods, caring naught for the reason why.

113036.description: Victorious Sejuani was awarded to players who reached Gold or higher in the 2022 season. After surrendering their strongest warriors and Iceborn to the Winter's Claw, all tribes of the Freljord now bend to the will of Queen Sejuani, clad in the finest gear her kingdom has to offer.

114001.name: Royal Guard Fiora
114001.description: If one dares to gaze upon the crown, they'll immediately catch the careful eye of Fiora, the captain of the Royal Guard. Cunning, keen, and shrewd, she's written her own legend at the tip of her rapier, a legend so large that it's said, as a child, she could slice a falling leaf perfectly in half. Whether or not it's true... Fiora has never told.

114003.name: Headmistress Fiora
114003.description: ATTENTION ALL STUDENTS: Concerning the recent upswing in vandalism and general troublemaking, it has come to my attention these behaviors may be intended to draw the personal attention of our headmistress. The dean reminds students that such encounters can be fatal, and encourages them to re-read the Academy code of conduct.

114004.name: PROJECT: Fiora

chromas.name: PROJECT: Fiora

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 PROJECT event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 PROJECT event.

114004.description: Augmented for speed, Fiora uses her zero-pulse sword to fight alongside Ashe and the other members of G/NETIC. The full-length energy blade allows for flawless attack precision and maximum repel strength, while the spatially controlled atomic tip coating is most suited for single-target combat.

114022.name: Soaring Sword Fiora
114022.description: A pupil of a famous martial arts school, Fiora pined after her fellow student Yi, but was never able to win his heart. Now she pursues him as he searches for the fabled sword of jade, to protect the artifact from the man she once loved.

114023.name: Heartpiercer Fiora

chromas.name: Heartpiercer Fiora

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

114023.description: Fiora fancies herself the ultimate rival in all things romantic—a duelist unsurpassed in swordsmanship and love. How ironic that she finally seems to have met her match…

114031.name: iG Fiora
114031.description: Honoring TheShy's winning performance as Fiora during the 2018 World Championship.

114041.name: Pulsefire Fiora

chromas.name: Pulsefire Fiora

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

114041.description: Fiora joined the Chrono-Enforcers at a young age under the tutelage of her father. When a conflict with a temporal fugitive left him disgraced, her future was thrown into doubt, but Fiora endured. Now, despite having reclaimed her family's reputation, and forged herself into an utter paragon of the Chrono-Enforcers, recent revelations have cast her into doubt once more, but this time about the Remembrancer's true purpose...

114050.name: Lunar Beast Fiora

chromas.name: Lunar Beast Fiora

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.
