150031.description: Abandoned to the streets, Gnar spent years scraping by, snarling at his misfortune, until he was found by a gentle orphaned girl. What started as simple gifts of food blossomed into a loving friendship, only for Gnar to suddenly fall ill and pass. Because of their familial love, Gnar now returns as an Eidola Vida, ready to protect his family from danger.

154002.name: Pool Party Zac
154002.description: If a guy made of water jumps into the pool, does he become the pool? Or just… part of the pool? Or does the pool become him? This is a very serious question.

154006.name: SKT T1 Zac
154006.description: Honoring Blank's winning performance as Zac during the 2016 World Championship.

154007.name: Battlecast Zac

chromas.name: Battlecast Zac

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

154007.description: Never content with his extant creations, Viktor's latest innovation has forged an experimental alloy that shifts between liquid and solid states. Incredibly flexible yet nigh-indestructible, the new zoophagus assault constructs, or ZACs, spring onto the battlefield, harvesting and consuming any resistance that stands in their way.

154014.name: Empyrean Zac

chromas.name: Empyrean Zac

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 Event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 Event.

154014.description: The Foreglow affects everyone differently. For Zac, it burned away all of his insecurities, but opened up his senses to the loneliness felt by the other Zacs across the realms. They needed him, and now he has the power to bring everyone together as one. A family reunion for the ages.

154024.name: Zesty Dip Zac

chromas.name: Zesty Dip Zac

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

154024.description: Zac is “nacho” average ooze monster—he's the snack that fights back! Topped with jalapeños, chips, and bacon bits, this sentient cheese-blob is the life of the party... and a nightmare for lactose intolerant eaters everywhere.

157001.name: High Noon Yasuo
157001.description: The mysterious and reluctant sheriff of a two-street town, Yasuo is in self-imposed exile after being accused of murder in the eastern territories. Even so, he has driven off entire bandit gangs as well as many of the desert's deadliest threats, saving hundreds of lives along the way.

157002.name: PROJECT: Yasuo
157002.description: Yasuo returned from advanced combat only to be accused of a crime he did not commit. Knowing that PROJECT's corporate leadership was somehow involved, Yasuo fights with the G/NETIC rebels, cutting away the lies of technology with his plasma coated blade.

157003.name: Blood Moon Yasuo
157003.description: Ceremonial executioner of the Blood Moon cult, Yasuo's blade is inhabited by an insidious, bloodthirsty demon whose hunger for death can never be satisfied. This suits Yasuo well, for he is possessed of an inner darkness even deeper than the creature whispering at his side.

157009.name: Nightbringer Yasuo

chromas.name: Nightbringer Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

157009.description: Born from festering echoes at the dawn of creation, Yasuo is the hellish embodiment of chaos in the cosmos. Fated to clash against the Dawnbringer for all time, he awaits a day when his darkness will finally cleave away her light.

157010.name: Odyssey Yasuo

chromas.name: Odyssey Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

157010.description: Yasuo never wanted to be a space pirate… until he was framed for his brother's murder, and had to flee his life of relative luxury. Now on the run from a dozen different military and paramilitary factions, he's putting together an eccentric crew to make a new life among the stars.

157017.name: Battle Boss Yasuo

chromas.name: Battle Boss Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: Battle Boss Yasuo

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Arcade event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Arcade event.

157017.description: One-time protagonist of the 1979 cult classic “Hasagi,” Yasuo was infected with Veigar's malignant code after the Battle Boss takeover of Arcadia. He maintains his impossibly complex gameplay patterns and high-damage attacks, but now fights for the forces of evil.

157018.name: True Damage Yasuo

chromas.name: True Damage Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: True Damage Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

157018.description: As enigmatic as he is skilled, Yasuo is the veteran producer all others turn to for inspiration. His beats transcend genre, painting whole universes with wild textures of sound. Notoriously selective about his collaborations, Yasuo sees True Damage as his platform to revolutionize how society experiences music.

157035.name: Prestige True Damage Yasuo
157035.description: After the global success of “GIANTS,” reclusive producer-extraordinaire Yasuo was inundated with requests. From record deals to clothing sponsorships, he turned down one after another, preferring to stay out of the limelight to focus on the simple joys of making beats. However, A Bathing Ape somehow managed to secure his attention. Now, donning golden threads to match his musical brilliance, Yasuo holds the world's ears at attention—with fans and critics alike waiting to hear his next revolutionary track.

157036.name: Spirit Blossom Yasuo

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Spirit Blossom event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Spirit Blossom event.

157036.description: Long ago, two brothers fought a bitter war across Ionia. Yasuo, the younger brother, was a warlord renowned for his roguish demeanor—until he was accused of crimes against the country and took up arms to defend himself. Both were fated to fall in their final duel… a lesson, perhaps, in pride and hubris.

157045.name: Sea Dog Yasuo

chromas.name: Sea Dog Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

157045.description: Empowered by the Buhru during his fight against Viego of Camavor, Yasuo made an unlikely champion for the children of Nagakabouros—his obsession with past events flew in the face of everything they believed in. Yet even the mangiest sea dog has his day, and Yasuo stood against the forces of darkness, emerging triumphant.

157054.name: Truth Dragon Yasuo
157054.description: Alone against an army, Yasuo chose to stand and fight. He blocked a narrow pass between two mountains, allowing innocents to escape the bloodshed. Wielding the truth of steel as a dance, he felled countless foes—but even he could not hold out forever. The Dragon of Truth, moved by his swordsmanship, came down from its peak to bless him...

157055.name: Dream Dragon Yasuo
157055.description: The song of steel grew silent, and Yasuo was the last living soul on the battlefield—though he imagined he could hear the thankful murmurs of the villagers he'd protected. Wounded and dying, Yasuo produced his flute to play a last haunting elegy. The Dragon of Dreams descended from its mountaintop, moved by Yasuo's song, and offered him its power...

157056.name: Inkshadow Yasuo

chromas.name: Inkshadow Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released to celebrate MSI 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released to celebrate MSI 2023.

157056.description: Displaced from his home alongside Master Yi, Yasuo now uses his Inkshadow tattoos to ride the wind between Rabadon City and the outskirts, protecting civilians seeking asylum with help from the mysterious Man of Masks. Though he gave up his freedom in exchange for power, he sees the price as penance for being unable to help those who needed it most.

157057.name: Prestige Inkshadow Yasuo
157057.description: Sporting an elevated take on traditional Ionian menswear coupled with a fearlessly bare set of stunning blackout tattoos, Yasuo's gala look celebrates elegant rebellion, sartorial subversion, and an uprising of unprecedented design.

157068.name: Foreseen Yasuo

chromas.name: Foreseen Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

157068.description: Yasuo glimpsed many paths in his dreams. One saw him as an old man, alone, having strayed far from his course. He had given up ambition, family, even love, all to atone for sins he could no longer remember. This vision was not a warning, but a reminder, for Yasuo knew he could always return to his path. He only needed to find it... or let it find him.

157077.name: Battle Wolf Yasuo

chromas.name: Battle Wolf Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Battle Wolf Yasuo

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Anima Squad event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Anima Squad event.

157077.description: The first captain of the Wolf Squad, Yasuo fought alongside Riven in the early days of the invasion. He disappeared only to reemerge years later a battle-hardened survivalist, still wearing his original suit. He's here to warn Anima Squad that the enemy has evolved—and if they want to survive, they'll need all hands (and paws) on deck.

157087.name: Genesis Nightbringer Yasuo
157087.description: Born from festering echoes at the dawn of creation, Yasuo is the hellish embodiment of chaos in the cosmos. Fated to clash against the Dawnbringer for all time, he awaits a day when his darkness will finally cleave away her light.

161001.name: Battlecast Vel'Koz
161001.description: An airborne data collection unit based on the now-extinct Vel'Koz lifeform, these Battlecast monstrosities sweep their concentrated energy beams over heavily populated areas. Survey data from the lifeless wreckage automatically calibrates the entire fleets' weapons systems, making the units a deadlier threat with every skirmish.

161002.name: Arclight Vel'Koz
161002.description: A sublime being of living energy, Vel'Koz is the subject of legend, myth, and worship. Once every millenium he descends to the mortal plane, choosing those worthy enough to carry out his inscrutable will, and transforming them into creatures of transcendent power—the Arclight.

161003.name: Definitely Not Vel'Koz
161003.description: I'm not a laser squid, I'm a man!

161004.name: Infernal Vel'Koz

chromas.name: Infernal Vel'Koz

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

161004.description: Scarce is known of Vel'Koz, owing to the fact that most who witness him combust at his mere presence. What is known, however, is that this cataclysmic titan can level entire civilizations with his incinerating gaze, leaving only smouldering ruin. Woe be to those fixed in the behemoth's infernal gaze, for there will be no remains left to bury.

161011.name: Blackfrost Vel'Koz

chromas.name: Blackfrost Vel'Koz

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

161011.description: Beneath the ice they slumber, trapped as two worlds pass them by. Watching, waiting, for the day they will rise again, and all will be buried in ice.

161020.name: Bee'Koz

161020.description: Controllable tentacles made out of honey? That's bee-nius!

163002.name: SSG Taliyah
163002.description: Honoring Crown's winning performance as Taliyah during the 2017 World Championship.

163003.name: Pool Party Taliyah

chromas.name: Pool Party Taliyah

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

163003.description: Taliyah once attempted to describe surfboarding to a perplexed Jarvan, using such terms as “get pitted”, “tubular”, and “ride the barrel”. She's pretty sure he still has no idea what she was talking about.

163011.name: Star Guardian Taliyah

chromas.name: Star Guardian Taliyah

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Star Guardian event.

163011.description: A rowdy, boisterous fighter by night and a somewhat reserved first year student by day, Taliyah's missions with the Star Guardians are a chance for her to discover the kind of person she wants to become. Surfing across the city on a giant wave of starlight, she's okay with taking her time.

163021.name: Crystalis Motus Taliyah
163021.description: When the Prismae Crystals began to appear, everyone on Motus reacted differently. Locked to their island, Taliyah's people viewed them not as a threat, but as an extension of nature. Now in symbiotic harmony with the crystals on their bodies, Taliyah's people are stronger than ever, and she ventures to the mainland to put her powers to the test.

164001.name: Program Camille
164001.description: Weaponized to quell the G/NETIC rebellion, Program Camille is a robotic assassin who will kill any human trying to utilize unauthorized technology. A being of adaptable protocols and laser-like focus, she takes her orders directly from Program's superior artificial intelligence.

164002.name: Coven Camille

chromas.name: Coven Camille

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Coven event.

164002.description: They came to Camille as if in some dark slumber—whispers of the Ebony Ram, and the nameless things tumbling up from long-forgotten sepulchers. Her throat full of hearsay, she cuts down the vestiges of the new world, seeding the earth with the magics and witchery of her ancient, grinning masters.

164010.name: iG Camille
164010.description: Honoring Ning's winning performance as Camille during the 2018 World Championship.

164011.name: Arcana Camille

chromas.name: Arcana Camille

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

164011.description: Poised precariously above the city, on the edge of High Arcana, Camille's power comes from surprise and defying expectations. Her patterns seem confusing and alarming—even perilous—to those who cross her path, but they always resolve to her benefit. When burdened on the brink, Camille is at her strongest, but no one truly knows what she plans to use all that strength for...

164021.name: Strike Commander Camille

chromas.name: Strike Commander Camille

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

164021.description: There are few truly “veteran” soldiers in the galaxy, and those who make it far enough to earn the title have done so for a reason. As commander of RSM's newly minted Strike Team Hyperion, Camille is ruthless, calculating, and fierce, bringing to bear the full power of the Y03-Principality on any target unlucky enough to end up in her sights.

164031.name: Winterblessed Camille

chromas.name: Winterblessed Camille

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

164031.description: As Senna continued her search, the bitter Camille pursued her with simmering rage. She was an elegant but ruthless dancer who ran afoul of a previous Polaris and was punished for it, enough so to lose her legs. Wielding newly empowered limbs, she ambushed Senna and summoned her compatriots, Sylas and Thresh. The Aurora thieves had arrived.

164032.name: Prestige Winterblessed Camille
164032.description: No one dances between the runway and the fashion house like Camille. She relishes letting her rivals mistake her cold demeanor for disinterest, only to be stomped into dust by her cutting edge designs. For this year's Winter Gala, she aims to leave everyone with fashionable blessings, as long as they remember who they got them from.

166001.name: Cyber Pop Akshan

chromas.name: Cyber Pop Akshan

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

166001.description: The Neon Rogue of Sound City has become the hero of the underground, largely due to his bravery, his wit, and his uncanny ability to sneak into highly-secure corporate buildings without being detected. Being charming as hell doesn't hurt, either.

166010.name: Crystal Rose Akshan

chromas.name: Crystal Rose Akshan

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 event.

166010.description: As roguish as he is handsome, Akshan abandons his daring adventures each year to make a highly-requested appearance at the festival. He might be seen stealing a dance or two, but he only has eyes for one among the crowd. Their moral… discrepancies are no match for the electrifying chemistry between them.

166020.name: Three Honors Akshan
166020.description: When the Order of Solace found Akshan, he was a soulless weapon of death caught in a cycle of revenge following his mentor's murder. Even with his despair, the Order's teachings were able to fill the endless hole within Akshan and rejuvenate him. Now he stands with Malzahar as a Three Honors stalwart, ready to fight the Essents with harmony and quips.

200001.name: Battle Boss Bel'Veth

chromas.name: Battle Boss Bel'Veth

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

200001.description: True final boss of the hit 1998 RPG "Initial Reverie VIII," Bel'Veth has become a staple of the series thanks to fan popularity and her storyline about assimilating all of reality into herself. Recruited into the war in Arcadia by Veigar, she has decided to ignore his commands, annihilate everything in her path, and assimilate all of Arcade World into herself. Who could have seen it coming?

200010.name: Cosmic Matriarch Bel'Veth

chromas.name: Cosmic Matriarch Bel'Veth

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

200010.description: A lonely cradle of life amongst the stars, Bel'Veth wanders ruined space in the aftermath of the Cosmic Court's destruction. She refuses to allow the Dark Star's entropy to spread any further, and so has begun plucking chosen creatures from dying worlds, imbuing them with the power to fight by her side and contain the corruption before it is too late.

200019.name: Primordian Bel'Veth

chromas.name: Primordian Bel'Veth

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Anima Squad event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Anima Squad event.

200019.description: The tide of war has turned, with Primordians scattered and Anima Squad idling safely in Final City. But deep below the tranquil sea, Bel'Veth plots. A creature of incredible intelligence, she grew used to living in Aatrox's shadow, her masterful tactics less bombastic than his brute strength. Now her time has come to rise above the waters and strike.

201001.name: Dragonslayer Braum

chromas.name: Dragonslayer Braum

descriptions.description: Obtained by completing missions via the purchasable Fan Pass. Only available in BR, LATAM, OC, TR, and JP regions.

201001.description: Dragonslayers first rose to battle their ancient foes hundreds of years ago, and after their victory, the land fell into a long, forgetful peace. When the dragons returned, most of the ancient warriors had passed away, leaving Braum to take up their task with only his mighty shield to defend the innocent.

201002.name: El Tigre Braum
201002.description: A contemporary wrestler beloved the world over, El Tigre's roar is the bellow of a people's champion. He is a friend to all… but can still scissor kick a two hundred pound cage fighter right out of the ring.

201003.name: Braum Lionheart
201003.description: The strongest, bravest knight in all the land, people love Braum Lionheart and his daring tales of adventure! He's definitely not a stickler for 7th-edition Riftquest rules, and there are certainly not snax stains on his character sheet. That would be unbecoming of such a gallant warrior.

201010.name: Santa Braum
201010.description: He's making that list, and checking it twice—but there's a lot of room for improvement because Braum is so nice! He may be tasked with giving coal to naughty children, but his big heart and sunny outlook ensure everyone gets exactly what they wanted... even the bad kids.

201011.name: Crime City Braum

chromas.name: Crime City Braum

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

201011.description: Miss Fortune's body man is an unnervingly pleasant gentleman by the name of 'Bank Vault' Braum, whose alias was earned ripping the wall off a maximum security gold depository. He is accompanied by a small cadre of gun-toting poros, who love nothing more than belly rubs and murder.

201024.name: Sugar Rush Braum

chromas.name: Sugar Rush Braum

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

201024.description: No one knows how Braum manages to never get candy stuck in his majestic mustache. Everyone knows how the great defender stands stalwart for everyone, from the smallest gumdrop to the strongest candy king.

201033.name: Pool Party Braum

chromas.name: Pool Party Braum

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

201033.description: Braum's tiki lemonades are a lot like him—tall, sweet, and very popular with poros. Even the Boss is willing to wait his turn to get a glass!

201042.name: Grill Master Braum

chromas.name: Grill Master Braum

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

201042.description: Braum is cooking up snax perfect for the hungriest of poros. Don't worry, humans can eat them too. (But they shouldn't.)

202001.name: High Noon Jhin

chromas.name: High Noon Jhin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

202001.description: Need a man dead? Hire any sun-baked lunatic looking to make a name for themselves in the Old West. Need to set an example? Then you should seek out the mechanical assassin known as Jhin—and no one will ever forget what happens at the crossroads of murder and art.

202002.name: Blood Moon Jhin
202002.description: Ink-mage, trained assassin, master of ceremonies: Jhin is all this and more, a grandiose figure whose encyclopedic knowledge of centuries-old rituals fuels the Blood Moon's hellish summoning rites. He knows the name of every demon, and how to direct them into a still-living vessel.

202003.name: SKT T1 Jhin
202003.description: Honoring Bang's winning performance as Jhin during the 2016 World Championship. This is Bang's second World Champion skin, following his win with SKT at the 2015 World Championship.

202004.name: PROJECT: Jhin
202004.description: After a botched surgery, Jhin went from being a black-market augment hacker to a notorious mechanized killer for hire. Still programmed with a taste for high-clearance upgrades, the tech Jhin takes from his victims has left him with a severe personality fragmentation, and a dark vision for the future of PROJECT... and humanity.

202005.name: Dark Cosmic Jhin
202005.description: Jhin was an interstellar entity, consumed by the Dark Star and given new purpose. Now his ageless mind is infected by visions of omnipotence, and consumed by an insatiable hunger. He scours entire regions of space seemingly on a whim, using the remnants to create bizarre, silent objets d'art.

202014.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Jhin

chromas.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Jhin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

202014.description: A mad god who resides within a mysterious painting older than creation, Jhin has grown bored of the canvas in which he dwells and wishes to bring his art to new, fresh eyes. He has begun weaving the edges of the painting into the fabric of the multiverse, hoping to escape his confinement.

202023.name: DWG Jhin

chromas.name: DWG Jhin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2021.

202023.description: Honoring Ghost's winning performance as Jhin during the 2020 World Championship.

202025.name: Empyrean Jhin

chromas.name: Empyrean Jhin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 Event.

202025.description: Jhin woke as an Empyrean with a sensation he'd never known before: true warmth. Exhilarated by the power, he set innocents ablaze with a flick of his hand. Finally, a muse worthy of him! The realization that “she” is slowly killing him only charms him more. Now if only he could find her source…

202036.name: Soul Fighter Jhin

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Jhin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Jhin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

202036.description: Don't ask him how, but this twisted mentor can unlock ANY person's soul power under the right conditions! Just be prepared, because his trials are deadly! He's ready to put his art on full display on the world's biggest stage and maybe even get some revenge on a bounty hunter along the way! Let's give it up for… Jhin!

202037.name: Dark Cosmic Erasure Jhin
202037.description: Jhin was an interstellar entity, consumed by the Dark Star and given new purpose. Now his ageless mind is infected by visions of omnipotence, and consumed by an insatiable hunger. He scours entire regions of space seemingly on a whim, using the remnants to create bizarre, silent objets d'art.

202047.name: Mythmaker Jhin

chromas.name: Mythmaker Jhin

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

202047.description: Jhin is the first of Cassiopeia's creations after the Lunar Players distort the world of myth. He embodies the mythical snake's most insidious qualities: sinister, calculating, and malicious. Displeased with the goddess's benevolent methods, Jhin plans to recreate humanity in his image and introduce them to the beauty of suffering.

203001.name: Shadowfire Kindred
203001.description: When the Ashen Lord rose, high priests of the Shadowfire Temple called upon their own god to fend off the all-consuming Infernals. They neglected, however, to account for the being's twin aspects: Destruction, and Rebirth. Kindred will fight the flames, but there may be a bitter price to pay before the end…

203002.name: Super Galaxy Kindred
203002.description: Lamb joined the Super Galaxy team as its lead scout, venturing into uncharted territory to face all manner of alien dangers. Soon after, Wolf joined the team as Lamb's partner—though, in truth, he only really joined because she still owes him for lunch, back when they were cadets. She's not getting away this time!

203003.name: Spirit Blossom Kindred

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Kindred

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Spirit Blossom Kindred

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Spirit Blossom event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Spirit Blossom event.

203003.description: In the Ionian tradition, the Kindred are interpreted as a child and her beastly companion, endlessly playing games with one another until they are called to perform their duties. The two do not know where they came from, but it is said they feel a sense of loss for someone they knew long ago…

203012.name: Porcelain Kindred

chromas.name: Porcelain Kindred

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Porcelain Kindred

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

203012.description: Once a skilled hunter and her fierce hound, the two were so bonded that their souls remained together when they were preserved inside the Dog Zodiac Relic. Now they are two halves of a whole, mentoring generations of Protectors like Lux and Amumu and standing guard eternally over the ancient magic that keeps them alive.

203022.name: Woof and Lamb Kindred

chromas.name: Woof and Lamb Kindred

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

203022.description: Who said dogs and cats can't be best friends? Cat ladies and golden retriever boyfriends pitting the two against each other for centuries? Eh, forget all that! Woof and Lamb are living proof that canines and felines CAN get along... though the judges are not actually sure either of them are "alive".

203023.name: DRX Kindred

chromas.name: DRX Kindred

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during DRX World Championship showcase.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during DRX World Championship showcase.

203023.description: Honoring Pyosik's winning performance as Kindred during the 2022 World Championship.

203033.name: Prestige Porcelain Kindred
203033.description: The hunter and the hound stalk the runway in white-feathered armor with cerulean plating. The refractions of images that dance in the crystals embossed on both bow and headdress dare the audience to reflect on the past year, their fashion feats, and faux pas.

203034.name: Chosen of the Wolf Kindred

chromas.name: Chosen of the Wolf Kindred

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

203034.description: Do you hunger, dear Wolf? The Eternal Chase is almost upon us. For you and your followers who find bliss through battle, this hunt is their reward. Only those chosen to enter Volrachnun are granted this opportunity. Tell me, will they be able to withstand us in your afterlife?

221001.name: Withered Rose Zeri

chromas.name: Withered Rose Zeri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

221001.description: Zeri's not one for the backstabbing schemes at the Festival of the Crystal Rose. She'd rather take action than formulate some complicated plan; and that's why partygoers will never suspect that this year, she's got one: Crash the party in the name of the rejects! No one—not even a dashing, would-be rival—will see her coming.

221010.name: Ocean Song Zeri

chromas.name: Ocean Song Zeri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

221010.description: An up and coming Water Tamer from the Southwest, Zeri is diving into the Ocean Song Festival headfirst. This is her first time handling a stage on her own, and she may have gone a little overboard with her showstopper plans in order to give herself a calling card. Everybody loves a little overstimulation, right?

221019.name: Immortal Journey Zeri

chromas.name: Immortal Journey Zeri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

221019.description: Orphaned as a baby, Zeri was taken in by a family of inventors who cultivated her tinkering tendencies. Their love ignited a deep desire to help others over herself, and because of her prodigious talents, her family paid her admission to the Tempered Faith School. A student full of dreams and curiosity, Zeri will use immortality to help everyone she can.

221028.name: Fright Night Zeri

chromas.name: Fright Night Zeri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Fright Night Zeri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

chromas.name: Fright Night Zeri

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

221028.description: Head counselor, nurse, and necromancer at Creepaway Camp, Zeri wears many hats. Always ready to graft a hand or stitch up a mess, Zeri never leaves a camper behind. So when she drowned, campers put on their thinking caps and did as she had taught: a few stitches, a ZAP, and Zeri was back!

221029.name: Prestige Fright Night Zeri
221029.description: Striking fear into the hearts of the unfashionable with her bold asymmetrical hair and oversized coat crawling with fine spider silk, Zeri's shocking new look is just to die for.

222001.name: Crime City Jinx
222001.description: Known by state police as “La Principessa,” Jinx is an unhinged hitwoman with loose ties to the Graves crime family. Sent into rival businesses as a figurative time bomb, the slightest offense will trigger one of her jubilant rampages, with body counts as high as the ceiling.

222002.name: Firecracker Jinx

chromas.name: Firecracker Jinx

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Lunar Revel event.

222002.description: Never one to turn down an imaginary challenge, Jinx has constructed a number of Lunar Revel weapons, including a seven foot long rocket shaped like an angry dragon. She'll tell you it's a fun firecracker for parties. It is not.

222003.name: Zombie Slayer Jinx
222003.description: When a mutagenic virus turned the world into an undead purgatory, no one was more excited than Jinx. No laws, no civilization, not even a thin veneer of polite society had survived—just a numberless horde of slime-vomiting bullet sponges and all the ammo she can forage. It's paradise.

222004.name: Star Guardian Jinx
222004.description: Much to the annoyance of her team, Jinx is an impulsive and sometimes cynical Star Guardian who loves a good, glittery explosion. However, when the fighting starts, Jinx will throw herself into the battle to protect others, especially her childhood friend Lux.

222012.name: Ambitious Elf Jinx
222012.description: A master toy maker and inventor, Jinx believes she could one day become the greatest Santa anyone has ever seen. Other elves worry her creations could be classified as weapons... but sometimes that's the price of true ambition.

222013.name: Odyssey Jinx

chromas.name: Odyssey Jinx

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

222013.description: Adept at building and/or destroying (but mostly destroying) a variety of haphazard, highly unstable weaponry for the Morning Star crew, Jinx also serves as the ship's pilot. Her previous job as a mining explosives technician resulted in a lot of collateral damage, and a thoroughly justified dismissal.

222020.name: PROJECT: Jinx

chromas.name: PROJECT: Jinx

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: PROJECT: Jinx

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 PROJECT event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 PROJECT event.

222020.description: Jinx volunteered for PROJECT conversion, never expecting that a critical power failure would scramble her memory core, leaving her a psychopath driven by the manic voices in her head. Seemingly obsessed with destruction for its own sake, she has begun to show signs of something far more sinister than mere memory fragmentation: the cold, calculating influence of Program.

222029.name: Heartseeker Jinx

chromas.name: Heartseeker Jinx

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

222029.description: Love is a battlefield, and Jinx comes prepared! Armed with her beloved companion Fishbones, she's ready to break hearts—and bones. But if she likes you enough, she's prepared to play nice. Maybe. Probably not.

222038.name: Battle Cat Jinx

chromas.name: Battle Cat Jinx

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Battle Cat Jinx

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Anima Squad event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Anima Squad event.

222038.description: Jinx is a one-cat demolitions squad, her natural destructive impulses turned toward more productive ends: fighting off the Primordians. She's not really a soldier, doesn't seem to care about humanity's cause, and doesn't follow orders -- but there's no arguing with Jinx's results.

222040.name: Prestige Battle Cat Jinx
222040.description: Unleashed and brandishing an arsenal of squid-stomping explosives strong enough to knock over a Primordian warship, Jinx has the enemy right in her claws. With this Battle Cat on the prowl? The war is as good as over.

222051.name: Cafe Cuties Jinx

chromas.name: Cafe Cuties Jinx

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

222051.description: Determined to prove that she's the best pastry chef around, Jinx uses her unique blend of chaos and technique to impress her patrons and blow away the competition! Although she specializes in savory treats, she'll occasionally indulge in a little sugary goodness from time to time. But… don't get in her way while she's in the middle of a sugar rush.

222060.name: Arcane Fractured Jinx
222060.description: Inventor, maniac, hero—Jinx left the twin cities reeling after killing Silco and blowing up the Piltover Council. Her future had gone up in flames, and as she faced the pieces of her fractured life, Jinx did the same. Now a symbol of change, she must decide who she will become in a world shaped by her own chaos.

222062.name: T1 Jinx

chromas.name: T1 Jinx

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during T1 World Championship showcase.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during T1 World Championship showcase.

222062.description: Honoring Gumayusi's winning performance as Jinx during the 2023 World Championship.

223001.name: Master Chef Tahm Kench
223001.description: He's the sushi singer, the loquacious pescatarian, the big catfish with a big fish dish. He'll prep you a meal, then cut you a deal. Here comes Taaaaaaahm Kench!

223003.name: Coin Emperor Tahm Kench

chromas.name: Coin Emperor Tahm Kench

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2019.

223003.description: Craving the smell of coins over all other earthly delights, Tahm Kench rises from his river kingdom each Lunar Revel, seeking to barter with mortals. Though his targets are almost always left destitute, with the proper reverence and careful wording it is possible to escape his bargains unimaginably wealthy.

223011.name: Arcana Tahm Kench

chromas.name: Arcana Tahm Kench

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

223011.description: The epitome of power and opulence, Tahm Kench's power drips from his tongue. Its ornate patterns captivate and cajole his listeners. He leverages those he rules, staking his power to ensure the patterns always shift in his favor—“correcting” his subjects who have gone astray.

223020.name: High Noon Tahm Kench

chromas.name: High Noon Tahm Kench

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: High Noon Tahm Kench

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the MSI 2022 High Noon event.

223020.description: Tahm Kench is a magnanimous devil: happy to lend a magical sword to a lady in need, or to assist her in robbing the Sulfur Rail, or even to deliver her to a calamitous destiny as a fellow Harbinger of the End Times. He don't need no compensation. She'll just owe him a favor… because in the End, it pays to have friends.

223030.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Tahm Kench

chromas.name: Shan Hai Scrolls Tahm Kench

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

223030.description: Once a catfish, Tahm Kench dreamed of becoming a dragon. Upon Jhin's release from his waterfall prison, a magical pearl was unearthed at its base, catching both Tahm's and Kog'Maw's eyes. Snatching it first, Tahm transformed into a dragon god of currents and unleashed a maelstrom of startling ferocity, laughing at the ensuing destruction.

233001.name: Street Demons Briar

chromas.name: Street Demons Briar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

233001.description: Whether you see her violently in-your-face tags that inspire audiences to get WILD, or her more relaxed art rife with cheeky humor, Briar's work makes an impression. As a jiangshi, she feeds off of the energy her art creates, so which style she uses really just depends on how hungry Briar is.

233010.name: Primordian Briar

chromas.name: Primordian Briar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Primordian Briar

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Anima Squad event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2024 Anima Squad event.

233010.description: Briar was an early draft of Aatrox's perfection, but was deemed a “failure”—because instead of using her finely-honed mind to get back at surface-dwellers, she loves humans! Now that Briar has joined up with Anima Squad, maybe they can show her how to be more than what she was made to be.

234001.name: Lunar Beast Viego

chromas.name: Lunar Beast Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: Lunar Beast Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Lunar Beast 2021 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Lunar Beast 2021 event.

234001.description: Former leader of a past Lunar Ox Squad, Viego decided that they would fight the Lunar Beast and actually defeat it. His plan ended in tragedy as he watched the rest of his squad be devoured-- including his wife. Viego has stewed in bitterness over these losses for years, blaming everyone but himself -- including this year's Lunar Ox Squad.

234010.name: Dissonance of Pentakill Viego

chromas.name: Dissonance of Pentakill Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

234010.description: Only the broken-hearted can know the true sound of grief, that yearning for perfection that goes unheard by all others. Viego exists in a world of ashes and shadow, when it ought to be filled with light, and now looks beyond these grey horizons for new sounds and visions to make it so...

234019.name: EDG Viego

chromas.name: EDG Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during MSI 2022.

234019.description: Honoring Jiejie's winning performance as Viego during the 2021 World Championship.

234021.name: King Viego

chromas.name: King Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

234021.description: The heir of Camavor, wielder of the Blade of the King, Viego longs to follow in his father's footsteps. To his advisor Kalista, his doubts were clear long before his coronation, as whispers of the sword's bond echoed throughout the Sanctum of Judgement. But he wears the Argent Crown, and with his blade, Sanctity, Viego will strike fear into the enemies of his nation.

234030.name: Soul Fighter Viego

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Soul Fighter Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Soul Fighter event.

234030.description: The gracious—if needlessly reclusive—host of the Tournament of Souls welcomes all to his arena! Look at him now, eyeing the competition from his throne room high above the ring! Doesn't his solitude just make ya sad, folks? Here's hoping he hops down from that tower and turns that sorrow into UNBRIDLED RAGE! Viiiiieeeeeeegoooooo!

chromas.name: Worlds 2024 Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.name: Worlds 2024 Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive to the Unlocked bundle in 2024.

chromas.name: Worlds 2024 Viego

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2024 event.

235001.name: True Damage Senna

chromas.name: True Damage Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: True Damage Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

235001.description: Senna rose to fame with her stunning vocal range and iconic sense of style, but when a shady adversary from her past imprisoned her in a restrictive record deal that took away her creative independence, she vanished from the spotlight. After years of living in the shadows, she now emerges as the lead singer of True Damage with her mind set on defining her legacy on her own terms.

235009.name: Prestige True Damage Senna
235009.description: Having topped the charts once more, Senna finds herself in the familiar space of fame and celebrity. Between cosmetics deals and fashion shows, she offers a clear message to fans and haters alike: Don't call it comeback. Senna's been here for years.

235010.name: High Noon Senna

chromas.name: High Noon Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

235010.description: Once the greatest gunslinger on the continent, Senna's life would have ended when her heart was torn out by the devil—save for the intervention of a higher authority. Mysteriously resurrected with the heart of an angel and a demonic steed, she has returned to the west to restore the balance of Heaven and Hell... however she sees fit.

235016.name: PROJECT: Senna

chromas.name: PROJECT: Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.name: PROJECT: Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 PROJECT event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 PROJECT event.

235016.description: A PROJECT volunteer who supposedly died during the elevation of her consciousness, Senna's mind was decoupled from the physical world and escaped into cyberspace, becoming a digital ghost. Inhabiting a body of her own design as Mordekaiser assumed control of the City, she is one of the few who understands the true threat of his ever-expanding directives.

235026.name: Lunar Eclipse Senna

chromas.name: Lunar Eclipse Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

235026.description: An ancient knight long thought dead, freed from the Eclipse Cathedral's catacombs as Kayle began to stir from her ancient slumber. Senna now aids her knighthood against the new threat of the Coven, saving whoever she can from the resurrected Old Gods… though she remains ever vigilant, as the sun-eater's return is now inevitable.

235027.name: Prestige Lunar Eclipse Senna
235027.description: Burning up the runway in a look inspired by an ancient order of magical knights, Senna brings a cold, but determined energy to the Gala proceedings. Evil beware — these looks can kill... and kill again.

235036.name: Bewitching Senna

chromas.name: Bewitching Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

235036.description: When she was just a young witch, a warlock bound Senna's soul to a tome of spells, hoping to rid himself of her rising power. But her time spent disembodied only made her stronger. While others party, the overly serious Senna searches for ghouls and ghosts, planning to send them to the grave... again.

235046.name: Star Guardian Senna

chromas.name: Star Guardian Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

235046.description: Years spent battling the darkness alone has strengthened Senna's resolve, but it also hardened her heart. After all, when you're a Star Guardian, you know losing loved ones is inevitable. Still, she'll keep fighting now, harder than ever. Reuniting her new friend Xayah with her evil ex-boyfriend is a powerful motivator.

235056.name: Winterblessed Senna

chromas.name: Winterblessed Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Winterblessed Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Winterblessed event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Winterblessed event.

235056.description: Senna woke in the dreamlike embrace of the Aurora. Clad in regal dress she didn't recognize, she had no memory of how she got there, nor could she remember anything else, save for flashes of warmth: a love, lost in shadow. "Who am I?" she wondered.

235063.name: Masked Justice Senna

chromas.name: Masked Justice Senna

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

235063.description: Senna's memories are a haze. There are flashes—hands locked together, an explosion—before waking up to vast destruction in a strange, alien suit. Only one image lingers in her mind—the face of a mad giant. She hears cries for help in the air, and sets out on a new journey. Senna will find her memories, and save whoever she can on the way.

236002.name: Striker Lucian
236002.description: Order United's designated striker, Lucian, is an inhuman blur of grass clippings and finely honed muscle movements. He cuts through the other team like a hot knife through butter, securing goal after goal to the adoration of fans the world over.

236006.name: PROJECT: Lucian

chromas.name: PROJECT: Lucian

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 PROJECT event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 PROJECT event.

236006.description: Once a sentinel within the Command Line, Lucian has seen PROJECT for what they truly are. His dual ion-core Lightcaster pistols now serve G/NETIC and the human rebellion, bringing down their technological oppressors with brutal efficiency.

236007.name: Heartseeker Lucian
236007.description: Behind curtain one: a dashing man with an adventurous plan. It seems he'll only agree to dinner by lantern light, but you can bet his intentions are pure… it's Lucian, here to sweep you off your feet and into the daring life of a Heartseeker.

236008.name: High Noon Lucian

chromas.name: High Noon Lucian

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

236008.description: A former federal marshal and gunslinger for hire, Lucian's soul was corrupted when he made a deal with the devil in order to spare the life of his one true love. Double-crossed, and cursed with the powers of hell, he now hunts this devil across the high frontier, seeking revenge.

236009.name: Demacia Vice Lucian

chromas.name: Demacia Vice Lucian

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.name: Demacia Vice Lucian

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Demacia Vice event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 Demacia Vice event.

236009.description: Half man, half machine, and all justice, Detective Lucian Phoenix fights crime under the pastel palm trees of Demacia. Rebuilt out of polished chrome and gilded Piltovan carbon fiber following a fatal gunfight, this technological marvel dispenses vaporwave vengeance as a neon beacon of law and order.

236018.name: Pulsefire Lucian
236018.description: A dedicated chrono-enforcer, Lucian joined the Remembrancers when he lost his wife, Senna, in an errant Praetorian attack. Now, he searches for her while bringing justice to the reckless time travelers who would cavalierly tear holes in space-time.

236019.name: Prestige Pulsefire Lucian
236019.description: Through his work in bringing their opponents to justice, Lucian earned the personal attention and gratitude of Thresh, leader of the Remembrancers. Armed with special modifications to his Pulsefire suit, Lucian embarks on his relentless pursuit across timelines. Through it all, however, he can't shake the feeling that this upgrade isn't all it seems...

236025.name: Victorious Lucian

236025.description: Victorious Lucian was awarded to players who reached Gold or higher in the 2020 season. By the time Lucian was finished firing, the relic stones were fused into solid crystal by the heat of his righteousness, and the last dredge of mist was evaporating into the morning light.

236031.name: Arcana Lucian

chromas.name: Arcana Lucian

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

236031.description: Lucian believes in balance: that no one Archetype should have excessive influence on the world. With one gun amplifying patterns and the other canceling them out, Lucian maintains the world's fragile order within the new power vacuum—even as the likes of Tahm Kench move to fill it.

236040.name: Strike Paladin Lucian

chromas.name: Strike Paladin Lucian

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2022 Steel Valkyrie event.

236040.description: Lucian is the ace pilot of the Z01-Orion, assigned to the inaugural mission of Strike Team Hyperion: reclaiming the experimental X01-Butterfly from its turncoat thief, Kai'Sa. He may not always agree with Commander Camille's methods, or her morality, but they both know that rogue exosuits in the wrong hands would spell disaster for the galaxy.

236052.name: Winterblessed Lucian

chromas.name: Winterblessed Lucian

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Winterblessed event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2023 Winterblessed event.

236052.description: Lucian, Senna's forgotten love, had tracked her down. He threw himself at Thresh, sacrificing himself to destroy the usurper and return the Aurora's power. As he lay dying, memories of their love washed over Senna. She stayed with him until he passed and, to remind herself of their undying bond, turned his soul into the Southern Star. Love would endure.

236062.name: Masked Justice Lucian

chromas.name: Masked Justice Lucian

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2025.

236062.description: Lucian saw his wife perish during the alien Mezzorax's invasion of Ocono. He only survived thanks to Yone, who recognized a rage and loss burning in Lucian's heart much like his own. Lucian accepted a Hyperguise suit from his savior, and vowed to protect his planet—once he avenges his beloved.

238001.name: Shockblade Zed
238001.description: An elite operative of the Shockblade order, Zed dives into battle with lightning-fast lethality. Though his former partner Shen hasn't forgiven himself for nearly getting Zed killed, Zed still urges him to return to the front lines; and yet the Storm rages on, whether or not the duo are reunited. Zed will bring its fury to bear alone if he must.

238002.name: SKT T1 Zed

chromas.name: SKT T1 Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive reward for players who obtained the 2024 Hall of Legends Signature Edition Collection honoring Faker.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as an exclusive reward for players who obtained the 2024 Hall of Legends Signature Edition Collection honoring Faker.

238002.description: Honoring Faker's winning performance as Zed during the 2013 World Championship.

238003.name: PROJECT: Zed

chromas.name: PROJECT: Zed

descriptions.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 PROJECT event.

chromas.description: Loot exclusive gained during the 2019 PROJECT event.

238003.description: Rising from the Command Line, Zed is a leader within PROJECT's counter-espionage units. He seeks out the G/NETIC rebels with split high frequency blades and molecular “solid smoke” projectors, favoring close-proximity and multiple angle target laceration.

chromas.name: Worlds 2016 Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during a Worlds event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during a Worlds event.

238011.name: Death Sworn Zed
238011.description: Having lived his life in the shadows, Zed's eventual return from the dead should have come as no surprise to anyone. A master of unliving darkness, he is only too happy to spend all eternity spilling mortal blood, as one of the Death Sworn.

238013.name: Galaxy Slayer Zed

chromas.name: Galaxy Slayer Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Galaxy Slayer Zed

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Worlds event.

238013.description: Zed was a promising Templar before he became host to the hivemind of ora and imbued with its alien essence. Able to morph his body into living weapons, he now sees himself as the perfect life form, deserving of all ora and destined to cleanse the galaxy of the weak.

238015.name: PsyOps Zed

chromas.name: PsyOps Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

238015.description: Known as the “Gas Can Man” in paramilitary circles, Zed is an infamous mercenary picked up by the Black Rose Group during one of their covert actions. His psionic powers are tied to a mysterious oil-like substance he ingests through his mask, allowing him to duplicate himself for assassinations and open combat.

238030.name: Prestige PROJECT: Zed
238030.description: Faced with imminent defeat at the hands of Mordekaiser and the numberless hordes of infected machines, Zed seeks out a dilapidated research facility in the heart of the wasteland, searching for illegal and potentially dangerous upgrades. His return may mark a tipping point in the battle for the City… though he has transformed into something beyond both human and machine.

238031.name: Debonair Zed

chromas.name: Debonair Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Debonair event.

238031.description: The most powerful (and powerfully dressed) man in Nox Vegas, Zed has been dabbling in more than fancy parties and cutthroat dealmaking. A new crowd from Crime City has entered his inner circle, granting this debonair gentleman an unbreakable stranglehold over the strip… and a dreadful new change in both mind and body.

238038.name: Empyrean Zed

chromas.name: Empyrean Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.name: Empyrean Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 Event.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the Worlds 2022 Event.

238038.description: The Foreglow is a power many desire, but Zed resents how it exposes him. His is a strength born from darkness, away from prying eyes. Perhaps in the fallen Husk realm left in Pyke's wake can he build a new domain of shadows, one that no Empyrean can topple.

238049.name: Immortal Journey Zed

chromas.name: Immortal Journey Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

238049.description: When Zed became immortal and began studying the other realms, a new desire took hold: knowledge was everywhere, so he needed to BE everywhere. Upon discovering his explorations, the Grounded Foresight School banished him. Zed doesn't care, though, for he's found a new demonic power, allowing him to be everywhere and all-knowing.

238058.name: Blood Moon Zed

chromas.name: Blood Moon Zed

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2024.

238058.description: As loyalty fractures within the Blood Moon cult, Zed remains Twisted Fate's unshakable right hand and personal power broker. He trades in secrets, shadows, and blood, all while using his mastery over his demon to increase the cult's influence. What Twisted Fate doesn't know is that Zed is also searching for his lost acolyte, stolen by the Snow Moon.

238068.name: Quantum Galaxy Slayer Zed
238068.description: Zed was a promising Templar before he became host to the hivemind of ora and imbued with its alien essence. Able to morph his body into living weapons, he now sees himself as the perfect life form, deserving of all ora and destined to cleanse the galaxy of the weak.

240001.name: Sir Kled
240001.description: Sir Prince Chevalier Archduke Lord Double-Earl Kled (or Sir Kled, for short) is a half-mad knight from the aptly named Kingdom of Kled, which contains exactly two subjects: Kled, and his cowardly avian mount, Skarl. Together, the pair ravage the countryside to 'reclaim' Kled's 'land', which apparently is… all land, everywhere.

240002.name: Count Kledula

chromas.name: Count Kledula

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive during 2018.

chromas.name: Count Kledula

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during 2018.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during 2018.

240002.description: This blood is MY blood. This candy is MY candy. Who sent you here?! You're not real ghosts! I'm Count Baron Double-Marquis Lord Duke Kledula… AND I'LL TEACH YOU NOT TO TRICK-OR-TREAT ON MY LAND!

240009.name: Marauder Kled

chromas.name: Marauder Kled

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

240009.description: Throughout history, the Marauders have balanced on the knife's edge between brutality and cunning. General Kled, one half of the pair that currently leads the regime, is truly the incarnation of their historic brutality… and little more. If it weren't for Xin Zhao, Kled would bet everything on a final, bloody, battle.

240018.name: Kibble-Head Kled

chromas.name: Kibble-Head Kled

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

chromas.name: Kibble-Head Kled

descriptions.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

chromas.description: Obtained through Influencer audience giveaways.

240018.description: He's just a lil' guy wearing a bowl of Poro-Pup Chow as a hat, riding the bestest beagle into battle. The get-up won Kled and Skaarl a blue ribbon at Beagle's Bridge, so if ain't broke, don't fix it. Here's hoping that the more "refined" judges at this year's Summoner Sweetie's Pet Show agree.

245002.name: Academy Ekko
245002.description: NOTICE FROM THE DEAN: Ekko is henceforth suspended from Academy grounds for behavior including (but not limited to) illegal use of chemistry equipment, illegal use of Academy electronics, splitting time streams in order to skip class, and vandalism of athletics department property.

245003.name: PROJECT: Ekko
245003.description: A hacker prodigy picked up from the lower sectors by Ashe, it didn't take much to convince Ekko to help her take down PROJECT. Using a powerful key decrypter and a mind tuned for disruption, Ekko can always find a way into the code.

245011.name: SKT T1 Ekko
245011.description: Honoring Duke's winning performance as Ekko during the 2016 World Championship.

245012.name: Trick or Treat Ekko

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during 2018.

245012.description: Perhaps, in hindsight, looping time to get an infinite number of fun-size chocolate bars wasn't worth shattering the fabric of reality for…

245019.name: True Damage Ekko

chromas.name: True Damage Ekko

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2019.

245019.description: A boy genius from the rough streets, Ekko turned to music as a way to express himself. His prodigious lyricism and technological savvy could have bought him a way out, but instead, he chose to stay and uplift his neighborhood. Now, he fiercely resists the temptations of fame and glory, garnering a following among the young and hopeful who see him as an avatar for their own potential.

245028.name: Pulsefire Ekko

chromas.name: Pulsefire Ekko

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2020.

chromas.name: Pulsefire Ekko

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2020 Pulsefire event.

245028.description: A time fugitive who built his Pulsefire suit from scratch, Ekko improved on the Remembrancers' technology, crafting a modified Chronobreak device that allows him to make short temporal jumps, create time breaks within a singular timeline, and to collapse them all into a single, anomaly-free singularity.

chromas.name: Arcane Firelight Ekko

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

245045.name: Star Guardian Ekko
